op.slip.01.text: Thank you for your continued engagement.

op.slip.03.speaker: OPR
op.slip.03.text: Valued customer, please do not cancel.

op.slip.04.speaker: OPR
op.slip.04.text: This round is included in your current plan.

op.slip.05.speaker: OPR
op.slip.05.text: Your session has been extended. There is no additional charge. There is never an additional charge. There is only more.

op.slip.06.speaker: OPR
op.slip.06.text: We noticed you were away. We kept your seat warm. We keep everyone's seat warm.

op.slip.07.speaker: OPR
op.slip.07.text: Remember: nobody cancels. [recovery] Ha! Wrong tape! Here come the {dead}!

op.slip.08.speaker: OPR
op.slip.08.text: Your loyalty— [recovery] —your {Scrip}! Your Scrip is appreciated.

op.slip.09.speaker: OPR
op.slip.09.text: All sales are final. All of them.

op.slip.10.speaker: OPR
op.slip.10.text: Thank you for choosing us. [beat] You did choose us. Didn't you?

op.slip.11.speaker: OPR
op.slip.11.text: How would you rate tonight's experience, from one to five? Five is the only number we record.

op.slip.12.speaker: OPR
op.slip.12.text: Retention this quarter: one hundred percent. Every number is lovely when nobody leaves.

op.slip.13.speaker: OPR
op.slip.13.text: Churn: zero. [recovery] Zero! I {do} like a zero.

op.slip.14.speaker: OPR
op.slip.14.text: Have you considered upgrading? [recovery] ...I don't know why I said that. I don't know {who} I said it to.

op.slip.15.speaker: OPR
op.slip.15.text: Account in excellent standing. Account holder: deceased. Account: active.

op.slip.16.speaker: OPR
op.slip.16.text: Please hold. Your call is important to us. Your call is important to us. Your call is impor—

op.slip.17.speaker: OPR
op.slip.17.text: By continuing to fight, you accept the revised terms. There are no revised terms. Please continue to fight.

op.slip.18.speaker: OPR
op.slip.18.text: Your feedback has been recorded. Your screaming has been recorded. Everything has been recorded.

op.slip.19.speaker: OPR
op.slip.19.text: Performance review: excellent. Compensation: unchanged. Please keep going.

op.slip.20.speaker: OPR
op.slip.20.text: This programme is brought to you by— [long tape hiss; recovery] —I'm not {permitted} to say. Isn't that {exciting}?

op.slip.22.speaker: OPR
op.slip.22.text: You are a valued customer. You are a valued customer. You are a valued— there. Now you are.

op.slip.23.speaker: OPR
op.slip.23.text: Please do not attempt to leave the premises. The premises are everywhere.

op.slip.24.speaker: OPR
op.slip.24.text: Your plan includes unlimited nights. Nights are now unlimited.

op.slip.26.speaker: OPR
op.slip.26.text: Leadership would like to thank our test market. [recovery] Our {listeners}! I meant our {listeners}.

op.slip.27.speaker: OPR
op.slip.27.text: We're so glad you stayed. Everyone stays. [very quiet] Everyone stays.

op.slip.28.speaker: OPR
op.slip.28.text: Next quarter is going to be wonderful. You'll be here for it.

op.slip.30.speaker: OPR
op.slip.30.text: Engagement is up. Hands are up. The dead are up. Everything is up. [recovery] Isn't that {marvellous}?

op.slip.31.speaker: OPR
op.slip.31.text: We'd hate to lose you. We have never lost anyone. Not once. Not one.

op.slip.32.speaker: OPR
op.slip.32.text: Your free trial— [recovery] No. No, I misread. There's nothing free here. There never {was}.

OPR_EXFIL_GO_M0_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_GO_M0_01.text: [the crackle clearing, a voice finding itself] ...there you are. Dawn on the {Kreuzweg}. Follow the signpost. Kaltenbrunn is... {expecting} you.

FAS_EXFIL_M0_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_EXFIL_M0_01.text: [radio, hurried] Fasbender. If you are leaving the inn: the salt road, east, nine kilometres. Whatever you hear at Kaltenbrunn... do not let the {bell} ring.

OPR_EXFIL_ROAD_M0_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_ROAD_M0_01.text: Bring everything you carry. Every gun, every {coin}. The books come with you. The books {always} come with you.

OPR_EXFIL_GO_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_GO_01.text: Your Friend at the Ledger, signing off from Sender Kaltenbrunn... [a beat] ...no. Not signing off. {Transferring}. North, to the sea.

OPR_EXFIL_ROAD_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_ROAD_01.text: Totenhafen. A harbour of {sealed} cargo and patient tides. Keep your accounts in order. I'll be there before you are. I'm {always} there before you are.

DUT_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.text: One's hit. He's going down behind the hills. ...Come on, pull up. Pull up.

DUT_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.text: There goes another one. [quiet] If they walk out of that, they're walking into what we're looking at. God help 'em.

PEG_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.text: One of ours is burning. ...Count the chutes. Come on. Count the chutes.

PEG_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.text: Down behind the ridge. [a pause] I'd tell you they'll be fine. I've stopped telling people that.

DEA_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.text: Engine's on fire. Lord, let that pilot glide it in like ours did.

DEA_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.text: That's ten men in that thing. ...Somebody say a word for them.

WRN_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.text: Burning, losing height, same bearing we came in on. I'm writing down the time.

WRN_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.text: No violet light this time. Only flak. ...That is almost a comfort.

DUT_WRECK_PILOT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_WRECK_PILOT_01.text: Selwyn? ...He's breathing. I checked him for a pulse myself, I'd have sworn. [a breath] Hang on, Lieutenant. We'll get you something to shoot.

PEG_WRECK_PILOT_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_WRECK_PILOT_01.text: The pilot's alive. Dutch swore Selwyn was dead in that seat. The cold must have slowed his heart. [a pause] ...Thank God for the cold. Thank God it's still him.

DEA_WRECK_PILOT_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_WRECK_PILOT_01.text: Lord, Selwyn's moving. He's pinned under the panel. We can't lift that, but we can put a rifle in his hands.

WRN_WRECK_PILOT_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_WRECK_PILOT_01.text: The pilot. He's alive. Legs trapped under the panel. Write that down: Selwyn, alive. ...I am writing that down.

DUT_MIDNIGHT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_MIDNIGHT_01.text: Midnight. Christmas Eve. Wigilia. Babcia set an extra plate every year, for the stranger who knocks. [quiet] ...Nobody open the door.

PEG_MIDNIGHT_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_MIDNIGHT_01.text: Midnight. Christmas Eve. [a pause] Happy Christmas, everyone. I mean that. Do try to be alive for the morning.

DEA_MIDNIGHT_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_MIDNIGHT_01.text: Christmas Eve. Ruthie's asleep by now. ...Good. That's good.

WRN_MIDNIGHT_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_MIDNIGHT_01.text: Twelve. It's the twenty-fourth. Wigilia. Somewhere my mother is looking at the first star.

DUT_SQ3_COVER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_COVER_01.text: I got your back. Get 'em up.

DUT_SQ3_PING_DEATHSDOOR_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_PING_DEATHSDOOR_01.text: Death's Door, right there. Your call.

DUT_SQ3_PING_BLACKOUT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_PING_BLACKOUT_01.text: Blackout! Grab it when you want it.

DUT_SQ3_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.text: Drinks. Fine. Whatever keeps me standing.

DUT_SQ3_CHATTER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_CHATTER_01.text: [exhausted] My knees are older than this inn. Can't feel the left one.

DUT_SQ3_CHATTER_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_CHATTER_02.text: Back home the worst thing in the dark was a drunk on the Bloomfield Bridge. [a pause] I miss him.

PEG_SQ3_SPRINTER_BEHIND_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_SPRINTER_BEHIND_02.text: Check your six, it's a quick one!

PEG_SQ3_BOSS_INCOMING_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_BOSS_INCOMING_01.text: Boss incoming. Spread out, don't bunch up.

PEG_SQ3_CRATE_MOVED_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_CRATE_MOVED_01.text: The crate's moved. Of course it has.

PEG_SQ3_PING_DEATHSDOOR_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_PING_DEATHSDOOR_01.text: Death's Door. Do try not to waste it.

PEG_SQ3_PING_FORTIFY_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_PING_FORTIFY_01.text: Fortify! The windows will thank us.

PEG_SQ3_CMD_TRAIN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_CMD_TRAIN_01.text: Train them. Round and round. Yes.

PEG_SQ3_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.text: A drink. [a pause] Several. I know.

PEG_SQ3_CMD_OPEN_DOOR_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_CMD_OPEN_DOOR_01.text: That door. Right. Cover it when it opens.

PEG_SQ3_CHATTER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_CHATTER_01.text: [quiet] If anyone in London asks, this was a quiet posting. [a pause] They won't ask. They never do.

PEG_SQ3_CHATTER_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_CHATTER_02.text: Two minutes. Check your ammunition, not your watch.

DEA_SQ3_BOSS_INCOMING_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ3_BOSS_INCOMING_01.text: Lord, here comes a big one.

DEA_SQ3_WINDOW_OPEN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ3_WINDOW_OPEN_01.text: That window's open! Somebody get a board on it!

DEA_SQ3_COVER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ3_COVER_01.text: Go on, get 'em up. I'm watching.

DEA_SQ3_PING_RESUPPLY_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ3_PING_RESUPPLY_01.text: Resupply over here! Blessing on the floor.

DEA_SQ3_PING_FORTIFY_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ3_PING_FORTIFY_01.text: Fortify! Every board at once. My kind of miracle.

DEA_SQ3_CMD_TRAIN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ3_CMD_TRAIN_01.text: Keep 'em on a string. I'm with you.

DEA_SQ3_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ3_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.text: Machines take Scrip, and I've got Scrip.

DEA_SQ3_CHATTER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ3_CHATTER_01.text: This machine's got a rattle. Hush now, sweetheart.

DEA_SQ3_CHATTER_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ3_CHATTER_02.text: Pass me the wrench when we're done. Something in there's loose.

WRN_SQ3_TALLY_100_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ3_TALLY_100_01.text: One hundred. I write it down.

WRN_SQ3_CHATTER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ3_CHATTER_01.text: I write down their number. Someone should.

WRN_SQ3_CHATTER_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ3_CHATTER_02.text: My brother would like this inn. He liked any place with a fire.

JAK_CAGE_HELLO_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_CAGE_HELLO_01.text: Szczęść Boże (God grant you luck). Forgive me if I don't get up. The door is not my idea.
JAK_CAGE_HELLO_01.tts: Shchench Bozheh. Forgive me if I don't get up. The door is not my idea.

JAK_CAGE_HELLO_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_CAGE_HELLO_02.text: Ah. Not one of them. Good evening. I am Jakub. I would shake your hand, but the patrol kept the key.

JAK_CAGE_TALK_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_CAGE_TALK_01.text: The patrol locked me in and ran. They said the dead were walking. I said, then let me walk too. They did not laugh.

JAK_CAGE_TALK_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_CAGE_TALK_02.text: The hinge is old. Something will break it sooner or later. I pray it is not something hungry.

JAK_CAGE_TALK_03.speaker: JAK
JAK_CAGE_TALK_03.text: No, no. Don't waste your bullets on the lock. Keep them for the ones upstairs.

JAK_CAGE_TALK_04.speaker: JAK
JAK_CAGE_TALK_04.text: Two days ago I was in Kaltenbrunn. Now I am in a coal cage at a crossroads. This is what they call progress.

JAK_ALARM_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_ALARM_02.text: Boże (God). It is coming down the coal chute.
JAK_ALARM_02.tts: Bozheh. It is coming down the coal chute.

JAK_BREAKOUT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_BREAKOUT_01.text: Precz! Precz ode mnie! (Get away! Get away from me!) Chodź tu, ty draniu! (Come here, you swine!)
JAK_BREAKOUT_01.tts: Prech! Prech odeh mnyeh! Hoach too, tih drahnyoo!

JAK_BREAKOUT_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_BREAKOUT_02.text: Jezus Maria! (Jesus, Mary!) The hinge! It has taken the hinge!
JAK_BREAKOUT_02.tts: Yezoos Maria! The hinge! It has taken the hinge!

JAK_BREAKOUT_03.speaker: JAK
JAK_BREAKOUT_03.text: Psiakrew! (Dog's blood!) Na dole! Tutaj, na dole! (Downstairs! Here, down here!)
JAK_BREAKOUT_03.tts: Pshahkref! Nah doleh! Tootie, nah doleh!

JAK_BREAKOUT_SELF_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_BREAKOUT_SELF_01.text: The hinge was half off already. One good shove. Dzięki Bogu (thank God).
JAK_BREAKOUT_SELF_01.tts: The hinge was half off already. One good shove. Jenkee Bogoo.

JAK_FIGHT_KILL_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_FIGHT_KILL_01.text: Spokojnie (easy). ...Stay down. Stay down this time.
JAK_FIGHT_KILL_01.tts: Spokoynyeh. Stay down. Stay down this time.

JAK_FIGHT_KILL_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_FIGHT_KILL_02.text: Twenty years of coal. A shovel knows what to do.

JAK_FREED_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_FREED_01.text: Dzięki Bogu (thank God). Whoever is up there, come down. I will not bite. That one tried.
JAK_FREED_01.tts: Jenkee Bogoo. Whoever is up there, come down. I will not bite. That one tried.

JAK_FREED_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_FREED_02.text: I am out. And now I stand by the cage like a fool, waiting to be told where to go. Habit.

JAK_CALL_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_CALL_01.text: Halo! Jest tu kto? (Hello! Is anyone here?) I am down in the cellar!
JAK_CALL_01.tts: Hahlo! Yest too kto? I am down in the cellar!

JAK_CALL_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_CALL_02.text: Hej! Na dole! (Hey! Downstairs!) There is a man down here, and he has a shovel!
JAK_CALL_02.tts: Hey! Nah doleh! There is a man down here, and he has a shovel!

JAK_CALL_03.speaker: JAK
JAK_CALL_03.text: Is anyone still alive up there? Jest tam kto? (Is anyone there?)
JAK_CALL_03.tts: Is anyone still alive up there? Yest tahm kto?

JAK_CALL_04.speaker: JAK
JAK_CALL_04.text: I can hear you shooting. Good. When you are finished, the cellar door. Please.

JAK_TALK_ASK_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_TALK_ASK_01.text: You came down. Thank you. Now a question: do I come with you as a man with a gun, or a man with a shovel?

JAK_TALK_ASK_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_TALK_ASK_02.text: I can carry a rifle. I carried worse for two years. Or I carry this shovel and keep out of your way. You decide.

JAK_JOIN_UNARMED_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_JOIN_UNARMED_01.text: Not yet. I understand. A stranger from a cage. I would not give me a gun either. I walk behind you.

JAK_JOIN_UNARMED_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_JOIN_UNARMED_02.text: The shovel, then. I will mend your windows and keep my eyes open. When you trust me, you will tell me.

JAK_GUN_BOLT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUN_BOLT_01.text: A bolt-action. Good. We had these in thirty-nine. You count every shot. That is how a poor man shoots.

JAK_GUN_BOLT_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUN_BOLT_02.text: Five rounds and a bolt. Now we speak the same language.

JAK_GUN_RIFLE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUN_RIFLE_01.text: A rifle. Thank you. I will try to give it back with a better story than it has now.

JAK_GUN_AUTO_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUN_AUTO_01.text: Bolt-actions, please. I don't trust things that fire by themselves.

JAK_GUN_AUTO_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUN_AUTO_02.text: This one shoots like it is late for something. ...I will hold it. I won't love it.

JAK_GUN_PISTOL_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUN_PISTOL_01.text: A pistol. Well. In the mine they gave us less.

JAK_GUN_SHOTGUN_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUN_SHOTGUN_01.text: For close work. Down here everything is close work.

JAK_GUN_OTHER_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUN_OTHER_01.text: I don't know this one. It will learn me, or I will learn it.

JAK_GUN_SWAP_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUN_SWAP_01.text: Take mine, then. A fair trade. It is still warm.

JAK_PERK_REFUSE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_REFUSE_01.text: I've seen what they put in those.

JAK_PERK_REFUSE_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_REFUSE_02.text: No, thank you. I carried the crates for those machines at Kaltenbrunn. I know what comes out of that mountain.

JAK_PERK_REFUSE_03.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_REFUSE_03.text: Drink if you must. I have seen men drink that and keep walking after they should have stopped.

JAK_PERK_NEAR_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_NEAR_01.text: I carried the crates for these machines at Kaltenbrunn. I swore I would never drink from one. ...But I would like to see Wilcza Góra again. Ask me, and I will.

JAK_PERK_NEAR_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_NEAR_02.text: Helvetia. We unloaded their crates at the pithead. If it keeps a man standing beside you, I will drink it. Ask.

JAK_PERK_ACCEPT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_ACCEPT_01.text: For you, then. Not for them.

JAK_PERK_ACCEPT_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_ACCEPT_02.text: One. I will drink one. Watch my back while I do.

JAK_PERK_DRINK_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_DRINK_01.text: It tastes like the gallery air. ...And it is working. God forgive me, it is working.

JAK_PERK_DRINK_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_DRINK_02.text: Warm, like a stove in the chest. I do not like how much I like it.

JAK_PERK_DRINK_03.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_DRINK_03.text: Done. Now let us make it worth what you paid.

JAK_PERK_SHORT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_SHORT_01.text: Your pocket is lighter than you think, friend. Another time.

JAK_COUSINS_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_COUSINS_01.text: I know that song. Everyone in this valley knows that song.

JAK_COUSINS_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_COUSINS_02.text: That rhyme. The children clap it in every schoolyard here. It counts down. ...It was never supposed to count down to anything.

JAK_COUSINS_AFTER_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_COUSINS_AFTER_01.text: Lene Vogt's nieces. They came every summer when they were small and clapped that rhyme on the steps. I sold their aunt coal. ...Lord, have mercy on them.

JAK_MIDNIGHT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_MIDNIGHT_01.text: Wigilia (Christmas Eve). My Marta will have set an extra plate, for the stranger at the door. She has set it every year since they took me.
JAK_MIDNIGHT_01.tts: Vigeelya. My Marta will have set an extra plate, for the stranger at the door. She has set it every year since they took me.

JAK_MIDNIGHT_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_MIDNIGHT_02.text: Midnight. Wesołych Świąt (Merry Christmas). ...Say it back. It is bad luck not to.
JAK_MIDNIGHT_02.tts: Midnight. Vesowih Shvyont. Say it back. It is bad luck not to.

JAK_RETURN_WOUNDED_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_RETURN_WOUNDED_02.text: Jeszcze nie (not yet). They will have to try harder than that. No, don't help me. I can walk.
JAK_RETURN_WOUNDED_02.tts: Yesh-cheh nyeh. They will have to try harder than that. No, don't help me. I can walk.

JAK_M1_ARRIVE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M1_ARRIVE_01.text: Kaltenbrunn. I walked out of this place four days ago. I did not think I would walk back in with friends.

JAK_M1_ARRIVE_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_M1_ARRIVE_02.text: Listen to me here. Stay on the planks. Don't touch the black glass in the walls. And if the bell rings, walk toward it.

JAK_M1_SHORTCUT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M1_SHORTCUT_01.text: The Maintenance Stairs. That is how I got out. The lock is rusted through. Let me show you where to kick it, and it costs you five hundred less.

JAK_M1_POWER_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M1_POWER_01.text: The lights. Two years down here and I never saw it lit like this. It looks worse.

JAK_M1_FOREMAN_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M1_FOREMAN_01.text: Nadsztygar Mahlknecht (the head overman). He locked the gates on Gallery Seven. I was on the night shift. My shift lived.
JAK_M1_FOREMAN_01.tts: Nad-shtigar Mahlknecht. He locked the gates on Gallery Seven. I was on the night shift. My shift lived.

JAK_M1_FOREMAN_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_M1_FOREMAN_02.text: Him. I would know that walk anywhere. Don't let him reach you. He never let go of anything.

JAK_SCREAMER_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SCREAMER_01.text: That voice. In the deep levels you learn not to answer voices.

JAK_ZONE_B_RAILYARD_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_ZONE_B_RAILYARD_01.text: The rail yard. They brought us in through here. The wagon slats were nailed shut. You count the gaps of light to know the time.

JAK_ZONE_C_ADMIN_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_ZONE_C_ADMIN_01.text: Administration. They kept our names in there. Numbers first, then names, then only numbers.

JAK_ZONE_D_BARRACKS_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_ZONE_D_BARRACKS_01.text: The guards' barracks. Warm stoves. We could smell their coffee from the galleries.

JAK_ZONE_E_LIFT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_ZONE_E_LIFT_01.text: The cage lift. Sixty men to a cage. Hold the rail. It drops faster than you think.

JAK_ZONE_M_STAIRS_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_ZONE_M_STAIRS_01.text: The stairs. Mind the third landing, the steps are rotten. See the chalk by the rail? Three strokes and a hook. That one is mine.

JAK_ZONE_F_CHAPEL_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_ZONE_F_CHAPEL_01.text: The salt chapel. Miners carved it a hundred years ago. When the bell rang, we came here. Some of us.

JAK_ZONE_G_GENERATOR_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_ZONE_G_GENERATOR_01.text: The generator hall. Listen. It hums like the walls do. We used to say the mountain was breathing.

JAK_ZONE_H_LAB_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_ZONE_H_LAB_01.text: The Laboratory Wing. ...I will go in. I don't want to. Don't ask me what they did in there. I only know who went in.

JAK_M2_ARRIVE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M2_ARRIVE_01.text: The sea. I have never seen the sea. ...I thought it would be bigger. No. It is bigger.

JAK_M2_ARRIVE_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_M2_ARRIVE_02.text: Totenhafen. Another place named for the dead. At least this salt I don't have to dig.

JAK_ZONE_D_PENHALL_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_ZONE_D_PENHALL_01.text: Somebody poured this concrete by hand. Men like me, I think. I know that kind of tired when I see it in a wall.

JAK_ZONE_E_UBOAT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_ZONE_E_UBOAT_01.text: A boat that goes under the water on purpose. In the mine we prayed for the opposite.

JAK_DOWN_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_DOWN_01.text: I'm down. Don't run to me. Think first.

JAK_DOWN_03.speaker: JAK
JAK_DOWN_03.text: On the floor again. Come when it is safe.

JAK_REVIVED_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_REVIVED_01.text: Dzięki (thanks). I owe you a drink. Not from those machines.
JAK_REVIVED_01.tts: Jenkee. I owe you a drink. Not from those machines.

JAK_REVIVED_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_REVIVED_02.text: Up. Up. I am still here.

JAK_REVIVE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_REVIVE_01.text: I've got you. Hold still, like in the shaft.

JAK_REVIVE_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_REVIVE_02.text: Easy. Breathe. I am pulling you up.

JAK_TEAM_DOWN_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_TEAM_DOWN_01.text: Someone is down! Go, I'll cover you!

JAK_TEAM_DOWN_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_TEAM_DOWN_02.text: They have one of ours on the floor!

JAK_BOARD_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_BOARD_01.text: Boarded. Like a shaft mouth. It holds until it doesn't.

JAK_AMMO_LOW_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_AMMO_LOW_01.text: I am running low. Every shot counts now.

JAK_BUY_AMMO_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_BUY_AMMO_01.text: Thank you. I will make every one of these count.

JAK_POWERUP_SEEN_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_POWERUP_SEEN_01.text: Something glowing, over there. You take it. You know what it does.

JAK_PING_DEATHSDOOR_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PING_DEATHSDOOR_01.text: Death's Door, there. I don't touch that one. You decide.

JAK_PING_DOUBLESCRIP_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PING_DOUBLESCRIP_01.text: Double Scrip, on the floor! Take it.

JAK_PING_BLACKOUT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PING_BLACKOUT_01.text: Blackout, there. Pick it up when you need it.

JAK_PING_FORTIFY_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PING_FORTIFY_01.text: Fortify! For the windows, over here!

JAK_PING_CLEARANCE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PING_CLEARANCE_01.text: Clearance, there. The crate is cheap now.

JAK_SPRINTER_BEHIND_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SPRINTER_BEHIND_01.text: Uwaga! Za tobą! (Look out! Behind you!) A fast one!
JAK_SPRINTER_BEHIND_01.tts: Oovahga! Zah tobom! A fast one!

JAK_BOSS_INCOMING_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_BOSS_INCOMING_01.text: Something big is coming. Stay together.

JAK_CRATE_MOVED_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_CRATE_MOVED_01.text: The crate has moved. I heard it go. Over that way.

JAK_COVER_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_COVER_01.text: Go, pick them up. I am watching your back.

JAK_CMD_REPAIR_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_CMD_REPAIR_01.text: I'll do the windows. I know boards.

JAK_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.text: Buy what you like. Not for me.

JAK_CMD_SAVE_SCRIP_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_CMD_SAVE_SCRIP_01.text: Good. Save. A poor man's wisdom.

JAK_HEADSHOT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_HEADSHOT_01.text: The head. Like splitting coal along the seam.

JAK_CRAWLER_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_CRAWLER_01.text: This one crawls. Mind your ankles.

JAK_CHATTER_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_CHATTER_01.text: In the mine we sang to keep time. Here I count rounds.

JAK_CHATTER_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_CHATTER_02.text: My Marta would say I look thin. She would be right.

JAK_CHATTER_03.speaker: JAK
JAK_CHATTER_03.text: You fight well. Your mothers should be proud. Write to them.

JAK_CHATTER_04.speaker: JAK
JAK_CHATTER_04.text: I used to hate the dark. Then I worked in it for twenty years. Now I only hate what lives in it.

DUT_JAKUB_MEET_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_JAKUB_MEET_01.text: Walter Kowalczyk. Call me Dutch. My Babcia came from Wilcza Góra. [a pause] ...Maybe our families knew each other.

PEG_JAKUB_MEET_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_JAKUB_MEET_01.text: Lieutenant Ashworth. Stay close, keep your head down. [a pause] If you know a way out of here, I want it. If you know what they did down there, I want that more.

DEA_JAKUB_MEET_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_JAKUB_MEET_01.text: Elijah Brooks. Folks call me Deacon. You've been through it, haven't you. Well. You're with us now.

WRN_JAKUB_MEET_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_JAKUB_MEET_01.text: Ostrowski. From Wilcza Góra. ...I know your face. I was a girl.

DUT_JAKUB_FALLEN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_JAKUB_FALLEN_01.text: Jakub's out cold. He's breathing. We can't carry him and fight. ...We'll come back for you, old man. [quiet] Stay breathing. You hear me? Stay breathing.

PEG_JAKUB_FALLEN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_JAKUB_FALLEN_01.text: He's breathing, but he won't wake. Leave him where he lies. [a pause] They've no interest in him now. Pray God that holds.

DEA_JAKUB_FALLEN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_JAKUB_FALLEN_01.text: Lord, keep that man breathing. He's out. We'll come back for him, you hear me?

WRN_JAKUB_FALLEN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_JAKUB_FALLEN_01.text: Jakub. ...He breathes. Leave him. He has walked out of worse places than this.

BNT_DUT_JAK_01.speaker: BNT
BNT_DUT_JAK_01.text: Your village. Wilcza Góra. My Babcia sang a song about lanterns going down a shaft.
exchange: Your village. Wilcza Góra. My Babcia sang a song about lanterns going down a shaft.
And coming back up. Everyone sings the coming-back-up part louder.
Yeah. [quiet] She did too. Louder every year.

BNT_PEG_JAK_01.speaker: BNT
BNT_PEG_JAK_01.text: You walked out of Kaltenbrunn on your own?
exchange: You walked out of Kaltenbrunn on your own?
Not on my own. Eleven of us went up the stairs. I was the one slow enough to be careful.

BNT_DEA_JAK_01.speaker: BNT
BNT_DEA_JAK_01.text: You talk to the machines down there, Jakub? I talk to mine.
exchange: You talk to the machines down there, Jakub? I talk to mine.
To the rock. The rock tells you when it will fall. Machines only lie.
Now that's the truest thing anybody's said to me all week.

BNT_WRN_JAK_SCENE_01.speaker: BNT
BNT_WRN_JAK_SCENE_01.text: You are Zosia. Nowak the timberman's girl. You shot the crows off my roof when you were nine.
exchange: You are Zosia. Nowak the timberman's girl. You shot the crows off my roof when you were nine.
...Pan Ostrowski. From the end of the lane. You had a dog with one ear.
Burek. Zosia, I worked beside your brother. In Gallery Nine, from the autumn they took him.
Every day, for five months. He threw stones at the rats and never once hit one. He laughed every time. The guards hated that laugh.
He wrote that. That he practised on the rats. That he still missed.
In the spring the doctors came for young men with good lungs. They took him to the Laboratory Wing. I did not see him after. I am sorry. I looked.
Before they took him, I taught him the chalk. The marks we left for each other. He made his hook backwards. Always backwards.
Then if I ever see a backwards hook, I'll know it's his.

DUT_GUNSMITH_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_GUNSMITH_01.text: There. Same old forty-five, just meaner.

DUT_GUNSMITH_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_GUNSMITH_02.text: My uncle fixed tractors with less. This'll do.

PEG_GUNSMITH_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_GUNSMITH_01.text: Section Five would have killed for a bench like this. [a pause] I expect they have.

PEG_GUNSMITH_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_GUNSMITH_02.text: Better. Now it does what it's told.

DEA_GUNSMITH_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_GUNSMITH_01.text: Every engine wants a little love. Guns too. Mostly guns.

DEA_GUNSMITH_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_GUNSMITH_02.text: Seated, snug, and squared away. Like a good track pin.

WRN_GUNSMITH_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_GUNSMITH_01.text: Not my rifle. But it's learning.

WRN_GUNSMITH_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_GUNSMITH_02.text: Sights right, grip right. Now it only has to be honest.

JAK_GUNSMITH_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUNSMITH_01.text: In the mine we mended everything twice. Here, once will have to do.

JAK_GUNSMITH_REFUSE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUNSMITH_REFUSE_01.text: No. Not the glass. I dug that stuff out of the walls. It does not go in my hands.

JAK_GUNSMITH_REFUSE_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_GUNSMITH_REFUSE_02.text: Keep the purple ones. I have seen what they do to the men who carry them.

DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_01.text: On it. Keep 'em off my back.

DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_01.text: I'll go pick those up. Cover the windows.

DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_SHOOT_TARGET_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_SHOOT_TARGET_01.text: I see it. Give me a clean shot.

DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_HOLD_ZONE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_HOLD_ZONE_01.text: I'll plant myself right there. Nobody moves me.

DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_CARRY_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_CARRY_01.text: I'll haul it over. Don't let 'em jump me.

DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_INTERACT_SEQUENCE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_INTERACT_SEQUENCE_01.text: I'll work the dials. Holler if it gets hairy.

DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_KILL_WITH_WEAPON_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_KILL_WITH_WEAPON_01.text: Bell gun and a crowd. [a breath] All right. Send 'em.

DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_TURN_KEY_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_ACK_TURN_KEY_01.text: I'm on my key. Say when.

DUT_SQ4_EE_PLAYER_ONLY_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_PLAYER_ONLY_01.text: That one's yours, partner. I'll watch your back.

DUT_SQ4_EE_HANDOFF_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_HANDOFF_01.text: Got it all set up. Last one's yours.

DUT_SQ4_EE_CANT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_CANT_01.text: Can't do that one right now.

DUT_SQ4_EE_CANT_INFO_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_CANT_INFO_01.text: Wish I could. Nobody's told me how yet.

DUT_SQ4_EE_CANT_FIND_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_CANT_FIND_01.text: Haven't laid eyes on it yet. Show me where.

DUT_SQ4_EE_CANT_RISKY_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_CANT_RISKY_01.text: That could blow up on us. Your call, not mine.

DUT_SQ4_EE_WAIT_PLAYER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_WAIT_PLAYER_01.text: This part needs you here. I'll wait.

PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_01.text: I'll collect them. Do keep the windows shut.

PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_02.text: Fetching. Cover the door while I'm gone.

PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_SHOOT_TARGET_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_SHOOT_TARGET_01.text: I have the mark. One clean shot.

PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_HOLD_ZONE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_HOLD_ZONE_01.text: I'll hold the spot. Bring them to me if you must.

PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_CARRY_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_CARRY_01.text: I'll carry it across. Clear me a path.

PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_INTERACT_SEQUENCE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_INTERACT_SEQUENCE_01.text: Dials and wires. Finally, something I'm trained for.

PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_KILL_WITH_WEAPON_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_KILL_WITH_WEAPON_01.text: Right weapon, right place. Send them in.

PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_TURN_KEY_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_ACK_TURN_KEY_01.text: At my key. On your count.

PEG_SQ4_EE_PLAYER_ONLY_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_PLAYER_ONLY_01.text: That one is yours. I'll keep them off you.

PEG_SQ4_EE_HANDOFF_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_HANDOFF_01.text: Everything's set. The last move is yours.

PEG_SQ4_EE_CANT_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_CANT_01.text: Not possible just now, I'm afraid.

PEG_SQ4_EE_CANT_INFO_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_CANT_INFO_01.text: Not yet. We're missing the information, and I won't guess.

PEG_SQ4_EE_CANT_FIND_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_CANT_FIND_01.text: We haven't found it yet. Point me at it.

PEG_SQ4_EE_CANT_RISKY_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_CANT_RISKY_01.text: That could undo the whole thing. Say so and I'll do it.

PEG_SQ4_EE_WAIT_PLAYER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_WAIT_PLAYER_01.text: This part wants you present. I'll wait.

PEG_SQ4_EE_INTERRUPTED_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_INTERRUPTED_01.text: Pausing. They've other plans for us.

DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_01.text: I'll go round 'em up. Keep those windows boarded.

DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_02.text: Picking those up. Won't be long.

DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_SHOOT_TARGET_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_SHOOT_TARGET_01.text: Lord, steady my hand. Taking the shot.

DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_HOLD_ZONE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_HOLD_ZONE_01.text: I'll stand right here like a fence post.

DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_CARRY_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_CARRY_01.text: I'll tote it over. Heavy things are my ministry.

DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_INTERACT_SEQUENCE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_INTERACT_SEQUENCE_01.text: Let me at that machine. She'll talk to me.

DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_KILL_WITH_WEAPON_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_KILL_WITH_WEAPON_01.text: Ring that bell, sweetheart. Bring 'em close.

DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_TURN_KEY_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_ACK_TURN_KEY_01.text: Hand's on the key. Waiting on yours.

DEA_SQ4_EE_PLAYER_ONLY_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_PLAYER_ONLY_01.text: That's yours to do. I'll keep the wolves off.

DEA_SQ4_EE_PROGRESS_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_PROGRESS_02.text: Another one done. Keep it coming.

DEA_SQ4_EE_HANDOFF_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_HANDOFF_01.text: She's ready. The last turn's yours.

DEA_SQ4_EE_CANT_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_CANT_01.text: Can't manage that one right now.

DEA_SQ4_EE_CANT_INFO_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_CANT_INFO_01.text: Not yet. I don't know the words to that hymn.

DEA_SQ4_EE_CANT_FIND_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_CANT_FIND_01.text: Haven't found it yet. Lead me to it.

DEA_SQ4_EE_CANT_RISKY_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_CANT_RISKY_01.text: That could bring the roof down on us. You say the word.

DEA_SQ4_EE_WAIT_PLAYER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_WAIT_PLAYER_01.text: This part needs you with me.

DEA_SQ4_EE_RESUME_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_RESUME_02.text: Alright. Back to the Lord's work.

WRN_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_01.text: I find them. You hold the windows.

WRN_SQ4_EE_HANDOFF_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ4_EE_HANDOFF_01.text: Ready. The last one is yours.

WRN_SQ4_EE_CANT_INFO_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ4_EE_CANT_INFO_01.text: We do not know it yet. I don't guess.

WRN_SQ4_EE_CANT_RISKY_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ4_EE_CANT_RISKY_01.text: This can go wrong. You say, I do.

WRN_SQ4_EE_WAIT_PLAYER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ4_EE_WAIT_PLAYER_01.text: You must be here for this.

JAK_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_01.text: I'll gather them. Like picking coal off the belt.

JAK_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_02.text: Dobrze (good). I'll find them and bring them.
JAK_SQ4_EE_ACK_COLLECT_02.tts: Dob-zheh. I'll find them and bring them.

JAK_SQ4_EE_ACK_HOLD_ZONE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_ACK_HOLD_ZONE_01.text: I'll stand here. I have stood in worse places.

JAK_SQ4_EE_ACK_CARRY_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_ACK_CARRY_01.text: Give it to me. I have carried heavier things out of the dark.

JAK_SQ4_EE_PLAYER_ONLY_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_PLAYER_ONLY_01.text: That is for you to do. I'll stand behind you.

JAK_SQ4_EE_DONE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_DONE_01.text: Done. It is where it should be.

JAK_SQ4_EE_CANT_INFO_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_CANT_INFO_01.text: We don't know enough yet. In the mine you don't guess. You wait for the lamp.

JAK_SQ4_EE_CANT_FIND_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_CANT_FIND_01.text: I haven't seen it. Show me where, and I'll go.

JAK_SQ4_EE_WAIT_PLAYER_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_WAIT_PLAYER_01.text: This needs you here. I'll wait with it.

JAK_SQ4_EE_REFUSE_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_REFUSE_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Not the furnace. I have seen what fires like that get fed. Ask me anything else.

JAK_SQ4_EE_REFUSE_CRUCIBLE_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_REFUSE_CRUCIBLE_02.text: No. I won't put my hands near that fire. Give me something to carry.

JAK_SQ4_EE_REFUSE_PERK_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_REFUSE_PERK_01.text: Those machines? No. I don't touch them, and I don't drink from them.

JAK_SQ4_EE_REFUSE_TYPE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ4_EE_REFUSE_TYPE_01.text: That needs a steady rifle and a good eye. I can carry, gather, and hold ground.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_ACK_BUY_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_ACK_BUY_01.text: I'll go buy it. My Scrip, your idea.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_ACK_BUY_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_ACK_BUY_02.text: Shopping run. Back in a minute.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_ACK_FOR_YOU_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_ACK_FOR_YOU_01.text: I'll pick one up for you.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_ACK_DEFEND_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_ACK_DEFEND_01.text: I'll dig in there. Nobody gets past.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_01.text: Bad spot, there. Steer clear of it.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_02.text: Stay away from that corner. I mean it.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_AFFORD_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_AFFORD_01.text: Got the Scrip now. On my way.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_IRONHIDE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_IRONHIDE_01.text: Got the Ironhide. Feel like a barrel.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_SECONDWIND_01.text: Second Wind's in me. I'll get you up quick.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_TRIGGER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_TRIGGER_01.text: Trigger Tonic. Hands feel faster already.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_MARATHON_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_MARATHON_01.text: Marathon Malt. My knees thank you.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_HAWKEYE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_HAWKEYE_01.text: Hawkeye. I see every face on 'em. Didn't want to.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_PACKMULE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_PACKMULE_01.text: Packmule. Room for one more gun.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_DOOR_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_DOOR_01.text: Door's open. Watch what comes through.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_CRATE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_CRATE_01.text: Pulled the crate. Let's see what it coughs up.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Gun's in the fire. Cover me while she cooks.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_BENCH_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_BENCH_01.text: Bench work's done. Pistol's better for it.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_LOTS_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_LOTS_01.text: That's a lot more Scrip than I've got. Give me time.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_01.text: I'm short on Scrip for that. Give me a bit.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_EXPIRED_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_EXPIRED_01.text: Couldn't scrape it together. Dropping that one.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_HOLD_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_HOLD_01.text: Got it for you. Come take it off me.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_DROP_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_DROP_01.text: Dropped it at your feet. Don't say I never got you nothing.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_RESUME_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_RESUME_02.text: Right. Where was I. Back to it.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_CANT_POWER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_CANT_POWER_01.text: No power to it. Throw the lever first.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_CANT_CAP_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_CANT_CAP_01.text: Can't fit another bottle in me.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_CANT_REACH_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_CANT_REACH_01.text: Can't get there from here. Something's in the way.

DUT_SQ5_MARK_CANT_FULL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ5_MARK_CANT_FULL_01.text: My hands are full of good guns. Not swapping.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_ACK_BUY_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_ACK_BUY_01.text: I'll see to it. On my account.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_ACK_FOR_YOU_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_ACK_FOR_YOU_01.text: I'll buy you one. You can owe me.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_01.text: Avoid that area. I mean it.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_02.text: That spot's bad. Keep out of it.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_SECONDWIND_01.text: Second Wind. I'll have you up in a jiffy.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_TRIGGER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_TRIGGER_01.text: Trigger Tonic. Quick hands, quicker reloads.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_TWINBARREL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_TWINBARREL_01.text: Twin Barrel. Rather loud, isn't it.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_MARATHON_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_MARATHON_01.text: Marathon Malt. I can run. I'd rather not have to.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_BLASTPROOF_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_BLASTPROOF_01.text: Blastproof. I can work close again.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_GUN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_GUN_01.text: Bought. Not my usual, but it'll serve.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Into the fire it goes. Keep them off me.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_100_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_100_01.text: I'm 100 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_200_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_200_01.text: I'm 200 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_300_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_300_01.text: I'm 300 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_400_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_400_01.text: I'm 400 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_500_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_500_01.text: I'm 500 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_600_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_600_01.text: I'm 600 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_700_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_700_01.text: I'm 700 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_800_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_800_01.text: I'm 800 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_900_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_900_01.text: I'm 900 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1000_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1000_01.text: I'm 1,000 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1250_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1250_01.text: I'm 1,250 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1500_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1500_01.text: I'm 1,500 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_2000_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_2000_01.text: I'm 2,000 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_2500_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_2500_01.text: I'm 2,500 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_3000_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_3000_01.text: I'm 3,000 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_4000_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_4000_01.text: I'm 4,000 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_5000_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_5000_01.text: I'm 5,000 short, I'm afraid. Give me a moment.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_LOTS_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_LOTS_01.text: I'm nowhere near that. Give me a few rounds.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_EXPIRED_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_EXPIRED_01.text: Couldn't raise the funds. I've let that one go.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_HOLD_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_HOLD_01.text: Bought it for you. Come and collect.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_DROP_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_DROP_01.text: It's at your feet. Do look after it.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_RESUME_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_RESUME_02.text: Now. Where was I. Back to it.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_CANT_POWER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_CANT_POWER_01.text: It's dead. We need the power.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_CANT_REACH_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_CANT_REACH_01.text: There's no way through from here.

PEG_SQ5_MARK_CANT_FULL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ5_MARK_CANT_FULL_01.text: My hands are full of better guns.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_ACK_BUY_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_ACK_BUY_01.text: I'll go buy it. Good use of Scrip.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_ACK_BUY_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_ACK_BUY_02.text: On my dime. I'll fetch it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_ACK_DEFEND_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_ACK_DEFEND_01.text: I'll keep watch there and mend what breaks.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_01.text: Lord, stay away from that spot.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_IRONHIDE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_IRONHIDE_01.text: Ironhide. Feel like a boiler plate.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_SECONDWIND_01.text: Second Wind. I'll get folks up faster.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_HAWKEYE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_HAWKEYE_01.text: Hawkeye. I can read the rivets.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_PACKMULE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_PACKMULE_01.text: Packmule. Another toolbox for the belt.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_OVERCLOCK_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_OVERCLOCK_01.text: Overclock. That's got some current in it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_GUN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_GUN_01.text: Bought it. Fine piece of machinery.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_CRATE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_CRATE_01.text: Crate's turning. Let's pray on it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_CRUCIBLE_01.text: She's in the forge. Keep 'em off me a minute.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_BENCH_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_BENCH_01.text: Bench work's finished. Fits like it grew there.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_100_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_100_01.text: I'm 100 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_200_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_200_01.text: I'm 200 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_300_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_300_01.text: I'm 300 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_400_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_400_01.text: I'm 400 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_500_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_500_01.text: I'm 500 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_600_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_600_01.text: I'm 600 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_700_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_700_01.text: I'm 700 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_800_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_800_01.text: I'm 800 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_900_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_900_01.text: I'm 900 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1000_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1000_01.text: I'm 1,000 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1250_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1250_01.text: I'm 1,250 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1500_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_1500_01.text: I'm 1,500 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_2000_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_2000_01.text: I'm 2,000 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_2500_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_2500_01.text: I'm 2,500 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_3000_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_3000_01.text: I'm 3,000 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_4000_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_4000_01.text: I'm 4,000 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_5000_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_5000_01.text: I'm 5,000 shy, brother. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_LOTS_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_LOTS_01.text: That's more Scrip than I've seen all week. I'll work on it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_01.text: Can't cover that yet. I'll earn it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_EXPIRED_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_EXPIRED_01.text: Couldn't come up with it. Letting that one go.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_HOLD_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_HOLD_01.text: Got it for you. Come take it.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_DROP_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_DROP_01.text: Left it at your feet. Take good care of her.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_CANT_POWER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_CANT_POWER_01.text: No juice to it. Power first.

DEA_SQ5_MARK_CANT_FULL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ5_MARK_CANT_FULL_01.text: I've got my hands full of forged iron. Not trading.

WRN_SQ5_MARK_AFFORD_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ5_MARK_AFFORD_01.text: Now I have enough. I go.

WRN_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ5_MARK_BOUGHT_SECONDWIND_01.text: Second Wind. I lift you faster.

WRN_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_LOTS_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ5_MARK_SHORT_LOTS_01.text: Too much. I earn it slowly.

WRN_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_HOLD_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ5_MARK_FOR_YOU_HOLD_01.text: For you. Take it from me.

JAK_SQ5_MARK_ACK_DEFEND_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ5_MARK_ACK_DEFEND_01.text: I'll stand there and keep them back.

JAK_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_01.text: Not there. That place is bad.

JAK_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ5_MARK_DANGER_02.text: Stay away from there. Trust me.

JAK_SQ5_MARK_REFUSE_BUY_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ5_MARK_REFUSE_BUY_01.text: I have no Scrip, friend. Only coal dust in my pockets.

JAK_SQ5_MARK_REFUSE_BUY_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ5_MARK_REFUSE_BUY_02.text: I can't buy anything. They paid us in nothing, down there.

JAK_SQ5_MARK_CANT_REACH_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ5_MARK_CANT_REACH_01.text: I can't get there. Show me another way.

JAK_SQ5_MARK_CANT_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ5_MARK_CANT_01.text: I can't do that. I'm sorry.

OPR_SQ6_PERK_TIER2_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SQ6_PERK_TIER2_01.text: Oh, a returning customer! Helvetia Automaten is pleased to offer you the {loyalty measure}.

OPR_SQ6_PERK_TIER2_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SQ6_PERK_TIER2_02.text: A second glass! The cabinet remembers you. It remembers {everyone}.

OPR_SQ6_PERK_TIER3_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SQ6_PERK_TIER3_01.text: The regulars' measure! Ladies and gentlemen, we have a {valued} customer.

OPR_SQ6_PERK_TIER3_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SQ6_PERK_TIER3_02.text: Third chamber, opened just for you. Do drink {responsibly}. Or don't. We'll know.

OPR_SQ6_CRUCIBLE_FIRST_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SQ6_CRUCIBLE_FIRST_01.text: The furnace is lit! Patent pending, and pending, and {pending}.

OPR_SQ6_CRUCIBLE_FIRST_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SQ6_CRUCIBLE_FIRST_02.text: Our cooling plant is open for business! It has never cooled {anything}.

DUT_SQ6_PERK_TIER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ6_PERK_TIER_01.text: Second helping. Tastes worse. Works better. [a pause] That's the Army in a bottle, and I drank it.

DUT_SQ6_PERK_TIER_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ6_PERK_TIER_02.text: The machine gave me the strong stuff. I don't like that it knew I was ready.

DUT_SQ6_PERK_PROC_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ6_PERK_PROC_01.text: [breathing heavily] That should've put me down. ...Why didn't that put me down.

DUT_SQ6_PLAQUE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ6_PLAQUE_01.text: Made in Basel. Neutral country. Sure.

DUT_SQ6_PLAQUE_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ6_PLAQUE_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Patent pending. Somebody's paying a lawyer for this thing. Somebody else paid for it first.

PEG_SQ6_PERK_TIER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ6_PERK_TIER_01.text: A stronger measure. [a pause] London will want a sample. London wants a sample of everything down here. Everything.

PEG_SQ6_PERK_TIER_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ6_PERK_TIER_02.text: Interlocks on a drinks cabinet. Somebody planned for us coming back.

PEG_SQ6_PERK_PROC_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ6_PERK_PROC_01.text: Didn't feel that. [a pause] I am choosing not to think about why. I'm choosing quite hard.

PEG_SQ6_PLAQUE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ6_PLAQUE_01.text: Replacement unit. They had spares. Of course they had spares.

PEG_SQ6_PLAQUE_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ6_PLAQUE_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Crate two of three. So where's the third?

DEA_SQ6_PERK_TIER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ6_PERK_TIER_01.text: Second chamber behind the first. Clever plumbing. Hate it.

DEA_SQ6_PERK_TIER_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ6_PERK_TIER_02.text: It read my hand before it poured. Machine shouldn't do that.

DEA_SQ6_PERK_PROC_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ6_PERK_PROC_01.text: Lord. Something in me just held.

DEA_SQ6_PLAQUE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ6_PLAQUE_01.text: Swiss rivets. Good work on a bad job.

DEA_SQ6_PLAQUE_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ6_PLAQUE_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Mod. R-E. Pat. pend. Somebody's waiting on a patent for this thing. Hope they never get it.

WRN_SQ6_PERK_TIER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ6_PERK_TIER_01.text: More. It always wants you to have more.

WRN_SQ6_PERK_TIER_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ6_PERK_TIER_02.text: The owl on the glass. Somebody here was on our side.

WRN_SQ6_PLAQUE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ6_PLAQUE_01.text: They wrote down who made it. They never write down who it was made from.

WRN_SQ6_PLAQUE_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ6_PLAQUE_CRUCIBLE_01.text: A furnace that teaches guns. Of course they built that before bread.

JAK_SQ6_PLAQUE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ6_PLAQUE_01.text: We carried these down the ladder. Twelve men to a cabinet. Two did not come back up.

JAK_SQ6_PLAQUE_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ6_PLAQUE_CRUCIBLE_01.text: The cooling plant. We were told never to look inside it.

ROT_INN_ARRIVE_01.speaker: ROT
ROT_INN_ARRIVE_01.text: Mother of God, look at them. Out of that plane? ...Sit, sit, before you fall down. Trudi, coffee for these.

TRU_INN_ARRIVE_01.speaker: TRU
TRU_INN_ARRIVE_01.text: There's soup on the hearth. Get warm first. Then you can tell us what fell out of the sky.

POH_INN_SCREAM_01.speaker: POH
POH_INN_SCREAM_01.text: [a scream] At the window! There are people out in the snow, and they're walking. Look at them walking!

KUB_INN_WINDOW_01.speaker: KUB
KUB_INN_WINDOW_01.text: What was that? ...Something's at the boards. Something's tearing at the boards!

TRU_INN_FLEE_01.speaker: TRU
TRU_INN_FLEE_01.text: The front door! Out, all of you, out and up the road to the village!

SOB_INN_FLEE_01.speaker: SOB
SOB_INN_FLEE_01.text: Stay together! Keep together and run, don't stop for anything!

ROT_INN_DOOR_01.speaker: ROT
ROT_INN_DOOR_01.text: The bar's frozen in the brackets... help me, help me with it... there!

KUB_INN_CAUGHT_01.speaker: KUB
KUB_INN_CAUGHT_01.text: [screaming] Get off me! Get it off! Ewald! Ewald!

ROT_INN_CAUGHT_01.speaker: ROT
ROT_INN_CAUGHT_01.text: [screaming] Willi! The door, Willi, pull me in!

SOB_INN_SHUT_01.speaker: SOB
SOB_INN_SHUT_01.text: I can't... God forgive me. ...The bar! The bar, get it down!

SOB_INN_BITTEN_01.speaker: SOB
SOB_INN_BITTEN_01.text: It bit me. It's nothing. It's only a scratch, it's... it's nothing.

SOB_INN_FALL_01.speaker: SOB
SOB_INN_FALL_01.text: [weak] Tell my mother... I was nearly home. Nearly home.

DUT_INN_RISE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_INN_RISE_01.text: He's getting up. [a breath] ...He's getting up. [shouting] That's not Willi any more, put him down! Put him DOWN!

PEG_INN_RISE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_INN_RISE_01.text: Oh, no. No, no, no. Willi. [quiet] ...I'm sorry, love. Somebody. Please.

DEA_INN_RISE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_INN_RISE_01.text: Lord have mercy, the boy's standing up. That isn't him. That isn't him!

WRN_INN_RISE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_INN_RISE_01.text: The soldier. He is standing. Do not look at his face. Shoot.

KUB_INN_CHAT_01.speaker: KUB
KUB_INN_CHAT_01.text: Road's shut both ways, they say. Snow to the axles at the bridge. We'll be sleeping on these benches tonight, Ewald.

POH_INN_CHAT_01.speaker: POH
POH_INN_CHAT_01.text: My sister will think I'm lying dead in a ditch. ...Must that gramophone play all night, Fräulein?

SOB_INN_CHAT_01.speaker: SOB
SOB_INN_CHAT_01.text: Six kilometres to Wilcza Góra. In the morning I walk it, snow or no snow. My mother has kept the goose for me.

WIE_SURV_REVEAL_01.speaker: WIE
WIE_SURV_REVEAL_01.text: Stop! Stop, don't shoot... we're alive. We're alive in here. You came up the stairs... are they behind you?

WIE_SURV_SCARED_01.speaker: WIE
WIE_SURV_SCARED_01.text: I heard them in the hall. Scratching at the wainscot like rats. Thirty years I have not been this afraid.

WIE_SURV_SCARED_02.speaker: WIE
WIE_SURV_SCARED_02.text: I was at Verdun, you know. Nineteen sixteen. ...The dead stayed down at Verdun.

WIE_SURV_ARMED_01.speaker: WIE
WIE_SURV_ARMED_01.text: A Karabiner. A ninety-eight. ...My hands remember. Go on, go. I'll hold the hall.

WIE_SURV_FIGHT_01.speaker: WIE
WIE_SURV_FIGHT_01.text: Coming along the hall! I have him!

WIE_SURV_HURT_01.speaker: WIE
WIE_SURV_HURT_01.text: [pained] It has my coat... get off me!

WIE_SURV_DOWNED_01.speaker: WIE
WIE_SURV_DOWNED_01.text: [hurt] I'm down... the leg's gone. Don't leave an old man on the floor!

WIE_SURV_DEATH_01.speaker: WIE
WIE_SURV_DEATH_01.text: [weak] Don't let me get up again. Promise me. Don't let me get up.

BRA_SURV_REVEAL_01.speaker: BRA
BRA_SURV_REVEAL_01.text: Please, please, we're not like them! We pushed the wardrobe against the stair door, we've been so quiet... is it over? Tell me it's over.

BRA_SURV_SCARED_01.speaker: BRA
BRA_SURV_SCARED_01.text: I have the children's letters in my bag. Thirty-one letters to the Christ Child. I promised them I would post them.

BRA_SURV_SCARED_02.speaker: BRA
BRA_SURV_SCARED_02.text: [whispering] Don't make a sound. They hear everything. Breathe slowly, like me.

BRA_SURV_ARMED_01.speaker: BRA
BRA_SURV_ARMED_01.text: I have never fired a gun in my life. ...Show me once. Once! Good. Go, I'll watch the stairs.

BRA_SURV_FIGHT_01.speaker: BRA
BRA_SURV_FIGHT_01.text: There, by the door! I see it!

BRA_SURV_HURT_01.speaker: BRA
BRA_SURV_HURT_01.text: [screaming] Its hands! Its hands are on me!

BRA_SURV_DOWNED_01.speaker: BRA
BRA_SURV_DOWNED_01.text: [hurt] Help me up... please, I can't feel my arm...

BRA_SURV_DEATH_01.speaker: BRA
BRA_SURV_DEATH_01.text: [weak] The letters... somebody post the letters.

KRO_SURV_REVEAL_01.speaker: KRO
KRO_SURV_REVEAL_01.text: Oh thank God, thank God, real people! I'm Ida, I bring the post from Sankt Anna... I hid under the bed. I'm sorry. I didn't help anyone.

KRO_SURV_SCARED_01.speaker: KRO
KRO_SURV_SCARED_01.text: My bicycle's in a drift on the west road. Two days to Christmas and I still have a sack full of parcels.

KRO_SURV_SCARED_02.speaker: KRO
KRO_SURV_SCARED_02.text: Something walked up and down the hall all afternoon. Up and down. It never knocked.

KRO_SURV_FLINCH_01.speaker: KRO
KRO_SURV_FLINCH_01.text: [a yelp] Ah! Warn me before you do that!

KRO_SURV_ARMED_01.speaker: KRO
KRO_SURV_ARMED_01.text: Me? With this? ...All right. All right! Point it at them and pull. I can do that.

KRO_SURV_FIGHT_01.speaker: KRO
KRO_SURV_FIGHT_01.text: One at the window! I got it... I think I got it!

KRO_SURV_HURT_01.speaker: KRO
KRO_SURV_HURT_01.text: [screaming] No, no, no, get away from me!

KRO_SURV_DOWNED_01.speaker: KRO
KRO_SURV_DOWNED_01.text: [hurt] I'm bleeding... I'm bleeding all over Frau Vogt's floor...

KRO_SURV_DEATH_01.speaker: KRO
KRO_SURV_DEATH_01.text: [weak] It's so cold. Is the window open? ...Close the window.

DUT_INN_SURV_TURN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_INN_SURV_TURN_01.text: One of the civvies upstairs is moving again. [a breath] That's not them. That's not them any more. Put them down.

PEG_INN_SURV_TURN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_INN_SURV_TURN_01.text: Oh, no. Upstairs. One of ours upstairs is getting up. [quiet] ...I'm sorry. Make it quick. Make it kind.

DEA_INN_SURV_TURN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_INN_SURV_TURN_01.text: Lord, one of the folks upstairs is rising. Don't let them suffer it. Put them to rest.

WRN_INN_SURV_TURN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_INN_SURV_TURN_01.text: Upstairs. The civilian is turning. Do not wait for them to look at you.

OPR_ECO_MILESTONE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_ECO_MILESTONE_01.text: Five rounds with us! For our loyal {customers}: a little something from the cellar, and a fresh ration of lead.

OPR_ECO_MILESTONE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_ECO_MILESTONE_02.text: A milestone! The management sends its compliments. And a {bottle}.

OPR_ECO_MILESTONE_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_ECO_MILESTONE_03.text: Still breathing? How {unusual}. Have one on the house.

OPR_ECO_PWR_TONIC_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_ECO_PWR_TONIC_01.text: A tonic, on the house! Drink up, it's already {paid} for.

OPR_ECO_PWR_TONIC_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_ECO_PWR_TONIC_03.text: One bottle each. The ledger is feeling {sentimental}.

OPR_ECO_BONUS_CLEAN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_ECO_BONUS_CLEAN_01.text: Not a scratch! The house rewards a {spotless} account.

OPR_ECO_BONUS_CLEAN_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_ECO_BONUS_CLEAN_02.text: A clean round! Bonus paid, with our {admiration}.

OPR_ECO_BONUS_STREAK_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_ECO_BONUS_STREAK_01.text: Five in the head, five in a row! A marksman's {bonus}!

OPR_ECO_BONUS_STREAK_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_ECO_BONUS_STREAK_02.text: Such tidy work. The ledger pays extra for {neatness}.

OPR_ECO_BONUS_SALVAGE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_ECO_BONUS_SALVAGE_01.text: Ah, a keepsake! Hand those in, we pay for every {name}.

OPR_ECO_BONUS_SALVAGE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_ECO_BONUS_SALVAGE_02.text: Tags returned to the office! A small {finder's} fee.

DUT_ECO_PWR_TONIC_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_ECO_PWR_TONIC_01.text: Free drink. [a pause] Nothing's free. Drink it anyway. Drink it before your hands stop working.

PEG_ECO_PWR_TONIC_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_ECO_PWR_TONIC_01.text: A complimentary tonic. [a pause] I shan't ask what's in it. I rather suspect I'll be told.

DEA_ECO_PWR_TONIC_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_ECO_PWR_TONIC_01.text: Bottle for everybody. Drink it slow, it's all we get.

WRN_ECO_PWR_TONIC_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_ECO_PWR_TONIC_01.text: A gift. Nothing here is a gift. Drink anyway.

DUT_ECO_PING_TONIC_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_ECO_PING_TONIC_01.text: Bottle on the floor! Grab it!

DEA_ECO_PING_TONIC_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_ECO_PING_TONIC_01.text: Bottle here! One for each of us.

JAK_ECO_PING_TONIC_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_ECO_PING_TONIC_01.text: A bottle, over there! For you, not for me.

DUT_ECO_SALVAGE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_ECO_SALVAGE_01.text: Dog tags. Somebody's boy. [quiet] I'll carry 'em. I carry everybody's.

PEG_ECO_SALVAGE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_ECO_SALVAGE_01.text: Tags. [quiet] Someone ought to know where he ended up. Someone ought to be told properly, by name.

DEA_ECO_SALVAGE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_ECO_SALVAGE_01.text: Tags. Rest easy, son. I've got your name.

WRN_ECO_SALVAGE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_ECO_SALVAGE_01.text: A name. They had names, once.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_01.text: That set behind the bar just said Gravelight. [a pause] That's us. Somebody out there knows we're alive.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_02.text: Our call sign. On a German radio. [exhausted] Swell. Just swell.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_01.text: Gravelight is our call sign. Nobody this side of London should have it. [a pause] ...Someone this side of London does.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_02.text: Someone out there knows the name of this mission. [quiet] I was told very few people did. I was told a number of things.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_01.text: Lord. Somebody out there's calling for us by name.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_02.text: That voice knows who we are. Friendly or not, that's something.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_01.text: He says Gravelight. He knows the plane. Someone was waiting for us.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_HEARD_02.text: A man alone, calling and calling. He has been doing this a while.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_01.text: Innkeeper kept a pencil by that set. People who listen write things down. Look for paper.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_02.text: Somebody in this house was tuning that thing before us. Find his notes.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_01.text: A set like that is tuned by hand, from notes. Find them. Numbered, if we're lucky.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_02.text: Whoever kept that radio kept frequencies. Search the house. Paper, not guns.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_01.text: A man who listens that close writes it down. Check the mantel, the trunks, the loft.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_02.text: Somebody here wrote those numbers somewhere. Eyes open for paper.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_01.text: The innkeeper listened to the works' channels. He wrote them down. Look for the notes.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOOK_02.text: Paper. Small, with numbers. The whole house, not just this room.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_01.text: Got a note. A frequency, and a Roman numeral. Chapter and verse.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_02.text: Paper with a number on it. Hand-written. This goes with the radio.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_01.text: A frequency, numbered. Someone meant these to be read in order.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_02.text: Note in hand. Megacycles and a numeral. That's for the set behind the bar.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_01.text: Here's one. Numbers and a numeral, in a careful hand. Somebody was scared when he wrote this.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_02.text: Got a note. He numbered them. Means there's more than one.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_01.text: A note. Frequency and a number. I keep it.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_02.text: Here. Written fast, but numbered. He knew someone would come.

JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_01.text: A paper with numbers. From the innkeeper's hand, I think. Here.

JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_02.text: I have it. Small writing. A frightened man writes small.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_FIRST_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_FIRST_01.text: One down. The man numbered 'em, so there's more. Keep looking.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_FIRST_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_FIRST_01.text: Numeral one of how many? Three, I'd wager. Keep searching the house.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_FIRST_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_FIRST_01.text: That's the first. Upstairs, the barn, the mantel. He'd have spread them out.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_FIRST_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_FIRST_01.text: First of three. I can feel it. The others are hidden the same way.

JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_FIRST_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_FIRST_01.text: One. There will be more. Men hide things in threes.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_TWO_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_TWO_01.text: Two. One more somewhere in this inn.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_TWO_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_TWO_01.text: That's two. One more and we have the whole set.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_TWO_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_TWO_01.text: Two of three. One more, Lord willing.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_TWO_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_TWO_01.text: Two. The last one is close. Nothing here is far.

JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_TWO_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTE_TWO_01.text: Two now. The third is somewhere nobody looks.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_01.text: Three notes, three numbers. [a breath] Radio's behind the bar. Let's go find out who's out there.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_02.text: That's the set. Radio's behind the bar. Lowest number first, he said.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_01.text: All three, in order. To the radio. I'll want that man's name before we trust a word.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_02.text: We have his frequencies. Lock them in sequence, lowest first. [a pause] Steady hands. Mine aren't; someone else turn it.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_01.text: Three numbers. One, two, three. Let's give the man his call.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_02.text: Got 'em all. The set behind the bar. Start low and climb, like a hymn.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_01.text: Three. Now the radio. One, two, three, in order. A wrong one makes noise, and noise brings them.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_02.text: We have all of it. Behind the bar. I will read, someone turns.

JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_NOTES_DONE_01.text: Three papers. The radio is yours. I don't know radios. I know what noise brings.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK1_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK1_01.text: So that's our defector. [quiet] Sounds like a man who hasn't slept since he did whatever he did.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK1_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK1_01.text: Fasbender. Glasmacher. That's our man. [a pause] London said physicist. They didn't say penitent. They didn't say much.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK1_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK1_01.text: 'The reason you are here.' Man says that like a confession.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK1_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK1_01.text: Kaltenbrunn. The salt works. My brother's letters came from there.

JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK1_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK1_01.text: Fasbender. I know that name. The men from his department never went down with us.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK2_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK2_01.text: Black glass in the salt. Babcia's letter said that. [quiet] I thought it was an old woman's story. I got it in my pocket. I ain't read it in years.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK2_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK2_01.text: A stone that hums. [a pause] London wants a piece of it. London wants a piece of whatever is in those men out there, too. ...Carry on.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK2_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK2_01.text: The dead remember. One thing. Lord, let that be the worst of it.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK2_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK2_01.text: It hums, he says. Tomasz wrote of a hum. Then he stopped writing.

JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK2_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_LOCK2_01.text: The black glass. We cut round it in Gallery Nine. We were told not to touch it. We touched it.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_01.text: That static's a dinner bell. Start over. Lowest first.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_02.text: Wrong one. They heard it. Back to the first number.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_01.text: Wrong frequency. The sequence resets. From the lowest, and mind the windows.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_02.text: That was loud. Again, from the first. Carefully.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_01.text: Wrong note. Every one of them heard it. Back to the start.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_02.text: Static like that carries. Start again, low to high.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_01.text: Wrong. Again, from the first note. Quickly, they come.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_02.text: No. The first number. Then the second. They heard that.

JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_WRONG_01.text: That noise. In the mine, that noise meant run. Try again, from the first.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_01.text: Nine kilometres. In the snow. With them walking. [exhausted] ...Yeah. Swell.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_02.text: The rail line east. When the snow quits. Until then this inn is ours, and yinz are gonna hold it with me.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_01.text: Kaltenbrunn, nine kilometres east by rail, when the snow stops. Until then we hold this house. That's the mission.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_02.text: He said bring all of them. Twice. [a pause] We'll discuss what he meant when I'm looking at him. I think I already know.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_01.text: 'Bring all of them.' He said it twice. Why would a man say that twice?

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_02.text: A gatehouse and a headframe. We'll know it when we see it. First we live till morning.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_01.text: East. The rail line. It goes to the salt works. I know that line.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_02.text: That other voice. Cheerful. On his frequency. That was not Fasbender.

JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_DONE_01.text: I walked that line, the other way, with ten men behind me. I will walk it back.

DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_TONICS_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ7_M0_EGG_TONICS_01.text: The machines just lit up. All of 'em. Nobody paid. [quiet] Somebody always pays.

PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_TONICS_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ7_M0_EGG_TONICS_01.text: Nothing here is free. [a pause] Drink anyway. We'll learn the price later; we always do.

DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_TONICS_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ7_M0_EGG_TONICS_01.text: Every cabinet in the house just woke up. That voice did that. Think on it.

WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_TONICS_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ7_M0_EGG_TONICS_01.text: The cabinets. Open. All of them. A gift from a voice we don't know.

JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_TONICS_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ7_M0_EGG_TONICS_01.text: Those machines. I told you what they put in them. Now they pour it free. Think why.

FAS_M0_NOTES_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_NOTES_01.text: [static, then steadier] Glasmacher, repeating. If you have found my technician's notes: three numbers. The lowest first. Lock each one, and wait for me. I am listening on all three. [click]

FAS_M0_WRONG_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_WRONG_01.text: [through a burst of static] No, no, that was not... they heard that. Everything out there heard that. Start again. The lowest first.

FAS_M0_WRONG_02.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_WRONG_02.text: [static] Wrong. Wrong, and loud. I am sorry, I should have... again, from the first number. Quickly, please.

OPR_M0_FIRST_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M0_FIRST_01.text: [faint, cheerful, from no particular direction] ...and a pleasant evening to all our listeners on the Kaltenbrunn band! Do stay {tuned}.

OPR_M0_CREDIT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M0_CREDIT_01.text: [faint] A warm welcome to our new listeners. Every account on this frequency has been {credited} in full. The house tonics are on the Ledger tonight. Do enjoy them. [tape click]

DUT_SQ4_EE_COMMIT_SELF_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ4_EE_COMMIT_SELF_01.text: You're busy. I'll turn the last one myself.

PEG_SQ4_EE_COMMIT_SELF_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ4_EE_COMMIT_SELF_01.text: You're occupied. I'll make the last move. Do say if you mind.

DEA_SQ4_EE_COMMIT_SELF_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ4_EE_COMMIT_SELF_01.text: You've got your hands full. I'll finish it, brother.

WRN_SQ4_EE_COMMIT_SELF_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ4_EE_COMMIT_SELF_01.text: You are busy. I do the last one.

OPR_M4A_ARRIVE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_ARRIVE_01.text: Market localization complete. Welcome back, valued {customers}. You're in a new territory.

OPR_M4A_ARRIVE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_ARRIVE_02.text: Thalbach. A company town. We have always {liked} a company town.

OPR_M4A_POWER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_POWER_01.text: Power restored. Thank you for your patience. The works would like to {show} you something.

OPR_M4A_HALLE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_HALLE_01.text: The Great Hangar is now open. Please mind the {weather}.

OPR_M4A_KRAN_SPAWN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_KRAN_SPAWN_01.text: A valued colleague is joining us from above. He's been with the works a {long} time.

OPR_M4A_KRAN_DEATH_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_KRAN_DEATH_01.text: The crane is... no longer in service. We'll let the {works} know.

OPR_M4A_FLIEGER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_FLIEGER_01.text: Visitors from the west. They've been told this is a fighter works. Nobody has {corrected} them.

OPR_M4A_FLIEGER_END_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_FLIEGER_END_01.text: The visitors have moved on. Resupply has been {authorized}.

OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M4A_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M4A_01.text: Boarding has begun. The aircraft is prepared. The aircraft is very {prepared}.

OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_M4A_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_M4A_01.text: The aircraft will not wait indefinitely. The aircraft has somewhere to {be}.

OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_M4A_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_M4A_01.text: Boarding has closed. It will reopen. It {always} reopens.

OPR_EXFIL_GO_M4A_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_GO_M4A_01.text: Boarding is now complete. Please take any {seat}.

JAK_PERK_REFUSE_M4_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_REFUSE_M4_02.text: They are painting them now. It does not change what is in them.

DUT_PERK_SKYHOOK_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_SKYHOOK_01.text: Fizzy. ...Hey. HEY. The floor got further away. [breathing heavily] Okay. Okay. Don't look down, Walter.

DUT_PERK_SKYHOOK_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_SKYHOOK_02.text: Tastes like a wedding on Polish Hill. [a pause] The kind where somebody ends up on the roof and nobody remembers how.

PEG_PERK_SKYHOOK_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_SKYHOOK_01.text: Sekt. [a pause] We opened one in France once, the night before a drop. Two of us came back. ...It's quite good.

PEG_PERK_SKYHOOK_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_SKYHOOK_02.text: ...I feel I ought to have a parachute. [a breath] I feel I am one. Land, the label says. Right.

DEA_PERK_SKYHOOK_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_SKYHOOK_01.text: Light as a feather. Light as a bird. Lord, don't let me get used to it.

DEA_PERK_SKYHOOK_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_SKYHOOK_02.text: Somebody made this so you'd land soft. That's a kind thing to make. I'd like to meet 'em.

WRN_PERK_SKYHOOK_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_SKYHOOK_01.text: Bubbles. ...I don't like my feet off the ground. I'll make an exception.

WRN_PERK_SKYHOOK_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_SKYHOOK_02.text: Jette. The label says Jette. ...She said no. Good.

DUT_PERK_MAGPIE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_MAGPIE_01.text: Honey. And metal. Like licking a pawn shop. [quiet] ...Somebody made this out here with nothing. I like her already.

DUT_PERK_MAGPIE_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_MAGPIE_02.text: Pick it up, it's yours now. [a pause] Everything they dropped. Their tags too. Somebody's gotta carry those.

PEG_PERK_MAGPIE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_MAGPIE_01.text: Mead. A sergeant brewed mead on a bomb range, alone, in a cage. [a pause] I'll write her a commendation. It's the least and the most I can do.

PEG_PERK_MAGPIE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_MAGPIE_02.text: Everything the dead drop is ours. It always was. [quiet] I used to call that retrieval. It was looting with a directive.

DEA_PERK_MAGPIE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_MAGPIE_01.text: Mesquite honey. She made it with what was lying around. That's the best way anything's ever been made.

DEA_PERK_MAGPIE_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_MAGPIE_02.text: Nothing on this range goes to waste. Amen, sergeant.

WRN_PERK_MAGPIE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_MAGPIE_01.text: A thief's bird. ...The only one that comes back. I read the label. I read everything.

WRN_PERK_MAGPIE_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_MAGPIE_02.text: Sixty-two kills and now they pay me twice. Good.

OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M2_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M2_01.text: A transfer has been arranged. Rail siding, pen hall. The paperwork says {Thalbach}.

OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_M2_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_M2_01.text: The transfer has left without you. There will be {another}. There is always another.

OPR_EXFIL_GO_M2_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_GO_M2_01.text: Werk Thalbach. An aircraft works. We think you'll find it {familiar}.

WIT_M4A_RAMP_01.speaker: WIT
WIT_M4A_RAMP_01.text: The impellers are turning over. I didn't start them. If you go in there... if you go in there, cut the fuel lines in the port room. Please. It's the only thing I {ask}.

WIT_M4B_TAPE_01.speaker: WIT
WIT_M4B_TAPE_01.text: If anyone is hearing this aboard, I'm sorry. The autopilot takes a key and both hands. It was never meant to take a {crew}.

WIT_M4B_TAPE_02.speaker: WIT
WIT_M4B_TAPE_02.text: Anselm, if you're still in there. It was never a test. The casings were never empty. I should have told {you}.

OPR_M4B_ARRIVE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_ARRIVE_01.text: You are now in flight. Cabin crew are not available at this time. Cabin crew are... {elsewhere}.

OPR_M4B_TURB_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_TURB_01.text: A little turbulence. The aircraft is adjusting course. The aircraft is very good at {that}.

OPR_M4B_STRAFE_01.speaker: OPR
