OPR_M4B_STRAFE_01.text: Unauthorized third parties are attempting to engage with the product. Please stay away from the {windows}.

OPR_M4B_BREACH_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_BREACH_01.text: A small loss of pressure. This is within tolerance. Yours, we {mean}.

OPR_M4B_DRUCK_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_DRUCK_01.text: Pressure drop. Everything not secured will be returned to {sender}.

OPR_M4B_DRUCK_END_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_DRUCK_END_01.text: Pressure restored. Resupply authorized. Please re-stow your belongings and your {colleagues}.

OPR_M4B_TAGS_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_TAGS_03.text: Those crew members have been re-deployed. Darkm... the works thanks them for their {service}.

OPR_M4B_BORDWART_SPAWN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_BORDWART_SPAWN_01.text: Our flight engineer will be with you shortly. He's very attached to his {work}.

OPR_M4B_BORDWART_DEATH_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_BORDWART_DEATH_01.text: The engineer is... resting. The engine will manage without him. The engine always {could}.

OPR_M4B_LONDON_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_LONDON_01.text: Valued customers. We said we'd be in {touch}.

OPR_M4B_BOMBRUN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_BOMBRUN_01.text: Regional sampling begins now. A little of the {product}, for a very large market. You are welcome to {observe}.

OPR_M4B_RACK_JAM_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_RACK_JAM_01.text: A sample has been... withheld. We'll note {that}.

OPR_M4B_RACK_DUD_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_RACK_DUD_01.text: That sample appears to be... hm. Somebody has been writing on the {inventory}.

OPR_M4B_BOMBRUN_END_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4B_BOMBRUN_END_01.text: Sampling complete. Proceeding to the point of delivery. Our customer is expecting {us}.

OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M4B_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M4B_01.text: The flight deck is open. We strongly advise against touching the autopilot. We're required to say {that}.

OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_M4B_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_M4B_01.text: The autopilot does not negotiate. We've {tried}.

OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_M4B_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_M4B_01.text: The autopilot has resumed. It will be available again. It is {patient}.

OPR_EXFIL_GO_M4B_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_GO_M4B_01.text: You've disabled the autopilot. We hope you have a plan. We {don't}.

BWT_BARK_02.speaker: BWT
BWT_BARK_02.text: Die Drehzahl stimmt nicht. Wer ist an meiner Station? (The revs are wrong. Who is at my station?)

BWT_BARK_03.speaker: BWT
BWT_BARK_03.text: Es ist nur ein Test. Es ist nur ein Test. (It is only a test.)

BWT_PHASE_01.speaker: BWT
BWT_PHASE_01.text: Backbord läuft heiß. Ich halte sie. Ich halte sie. (Port is running hot. I'll hold her.)

BWT_PHASE_02.speaker: BWT
BWT_PHASE_02.text: Lorenz? Lorenz, sag ihnen, es ist nur ein Test. (Lorenz, tell them it is only a test.)

BWT_PHASE_03.speaker: BWT
BWT_PHASE_03.text: Überdrehzahl. Ich kann nicht... ich kann nicht loslassen. (Overspeed. I can't let go.)

DUT_M4B_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4B_ARRIVE_01.text: Nobody's flying it. [breathing heavily] Nobody's flying the plane. I want that {noted}. Somebody write that down.

DUT_M4B_STRAFE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4B_STRAFE_01.text: Those are ours! They're shooting at... [a breath] yeah. Yeah, fair. We're in the bad {plane}.

DUT_M4B_BOMBRUN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4B_BOMBRUN_01.text: Boston! That's BOSTON! Get on the racks, GET ON THE {RACKS}!

PEG_M4B_BREACH_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4B_BREACH_01.text: Seal it. Seal it now, or we'll be a great deal {lighter}.

PEG_M4B_LONDON_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4B_LONDON_01.text: That's not Morgenrot. That's... that's a second {battery}. [quiet] That's the dust. They're putting the dust on London.

PEG_M4B_LONDON_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4B_LONDON_02.text: ...My mother's in Islington. ...Right. Racks. Where are the {racks}.

PEG_M4B_BOMBRUN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4B_BOMBRUN_01.text: Racks in order, one every half minute. Nearest first. {GO}.

PEG_M4B_RACK_DUD_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4B_RACK_DUD_01.text: That one's marked. It's a dud. Leave it, take the {next}.

DEA_M4B_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_ARRIVE_01.text: No crew. Harnesses buckled over nobody. ...Lord, that's wrong. That's wrong in a way I don't have a word {for}.

DEA_M4B_TURB_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_TURB_01.text: Easy, girl. Easy. Nobody's at the {stick}.

DEA_M4B_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_CRUCIBLE_01.text: They bolted a forge to the galley floor. For the crew. The crew they didn't {have}.

DEA_M4B_BORDWART_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_BORDWART_01.text: He's part of the engine. He's PART of it. Anselm... I'm sorry, brother. I'm gonna shut her {down}.

DEA_M4B_BOMBRUN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_BOMBRUN_01.text: I'll take the far racks! Deacon's on the far {racks}!

DEA_M4B_AUTOPILOT_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_AUTOPILOT_01.text: Okay. Okay, girl. Key's in. Now I need you to let {go}.

DEA_M4B_AUTOPILOT_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_AUTOPILOT_02.text: Easy. Easy, girl. You don't have to go where they pointed {you}.

DEA_M4B_HEADING_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_HEADING_01.text: That's not home. Where's it taking {us}?

WRN_M4B_ARRIVE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4B_ARRIVE_01.text: No crew. Buckled harnesses. ...They were taken OUT. Like Tomek. Like all of {them}.

WRN_M4B_TAGS_03.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4B_TAGS_03.text: Three names. They had names. I have them {now}.

WRN_M4B_BREACH_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4B_BREACH_01.text: Hole in the wing. Good. It's a {window}.

WRN_M4B_MARKS_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4B_MARKS_01.text: Two of the racks are marked. The hook. They're duds. They MADE them duds. Thank you. Thank you, whoever you {are}.

WRN_M4B_BOMBRUN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4B_BOMBRUN_01.text: Count with me. Thirty seconds. Dwadzieścia dziewięć, dwadzieścia {osiem}...

JAK_M4B_MARKS_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4B_MARKS_01.text: The hook means DO NOT TRUST IT. Two of them. They will not go off. The boys made {sure}.

JAK_M4B_LONDON_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4B_LONDON_01.text: ...Marta. Hania. ...It is far from there. It is {far}.

PA_M4B_HEADING_02.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_HEADING_02.text: Kurs zwei-neun-null. Reiseflughöhe erreicht. (Heading 290. Cruise altitude.)

PA_M4B_HEADING_03.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_HEADING_03.text: Kurs zwei-sieben-null. Beobachter an die Kanzel. (Heading 270. Observers to the blisters.)

PA_M4B_HEADING_04.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_HEADING_04.text: Kurs zwei-sechs-null. Zielanflug. (Heading 260. Approach to target.)

PA_M4B_HEADING_05.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_HEADING_05.text: Kurs zwei-fünf-null. Endanflug. Auslieferung. (Heading 250. Final approach. Delivery.)

PA_M4B_BREACH_01.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_BREACH_01.text: Achtung. Druckverlust, Backbord. (Attention. Pressure loss, port.)

PA_M4B_BREACH_02.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_BREACH_02.text: Achtung. Druckverlust, Steuerbord. (Attention. Pressure loss, starboard.)

PA_M4B_DRUCK_01.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_DRUCK_01.text: Achtung. Druckabfall. Alle Luken sichern. (Attention. Pressure drop. Secure all hatches.)

WIT_M4A_PA_01.speaker: WIT
WIT_M4A_PA_01.text: Is that... are there people on the line? This is Wittkamp. I'm in the tunnel office. I can see you on the canteen camera. Don't... the doors lock from my side. I locked them. I'm {sorry}.

WIT_M4A_PA_02.speaker: WIT
WIT_M4A_PA_02.text: You've turned the lights on. Thank you. I've been in the dark for six days with a model {aeroplane}.

WIT_M4A_FILE_01.speaker: WIT
WIT_M4A_FILE_01.text: The engines. Four of them. We didn't build them. She sold them to us. The valve plates are in a language that isn't a {language}.

WIT_M4A_FILE_02.speaker: WIT
WIT_M4A_FILE_02.text: The flight plan. The Atlantic. And a last waypoint in a desert nobody here had heard of. I asked who wrote it. Nobody wrote {it}.

WIT_M4A_FILE_03.speaker: WIT
WIT_M4A_FILE_03.text: The crew list. Crew: provided. I asked, provided by whom. They said it was handled. I resigned that afternoon. Nobody accepted {it}.

WIT_M4A_SWITCH_01.speaker: WIT
WIT_M4A_SWITCH_01.text: You've got my line. Listen. The hangar door is a key and a code. The code is the wing's weight in kilos. It's in the tunnel log. Jette wrote it. Then she wrote {no}.

WIT_M4A_KRANICH_01.speaker: WIT
WIT_M4A_KRANICH_01.text: There she is. Der Kranich. The most beautiful thing I have ever made. I would give anything for her never to {fly}.

WIT_M4A_KRAN_01.speaker: WIT
WIT_M4A_KRAN_01.text: That... that was Beck. The night crane. He wouldn't leave the hangar {either}.

OPR_M4A_FILE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_FILE_01.text: You've found a document. Documents are provided for your convenience and may not be {binding}.

DUT_M4A_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4A_ARRIVE_01.text: A factory town. [exhausted] I grew up in one. The smell's the {same}. Hot metal and nobody talking.

DUT_M4A_FILE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4A_FILE_01.text: Four engines, sold by 'V.' I'm gonna find V. I'm gonna have a word with {V}.

DUT_M4A_KRANICH_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4A_KRANICH_01.text: That's not a plane. That's a church with a {propeller}.

DUT_M4A_TUNNEL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4A_TUNNEL_01.text: Okay. Okay, Kowalczyk, nothing surprises you. [a breath] The WIND is on our {side}.

DUT_M4A_GLIDER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4A_GLIDER_01.text: A toy plane. Somebody here still liked {flying}.

DUT_M4A_JETTE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4A_JETTE_01.text: She said no. In writing. ...I like {her}.

PEG_M4A_ARRIVE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4A_ARRIVE_01.text: An aircraft works. Hale's cable said 'retrieve the engines.' [a pause] He didn't say what they were {in}. He never says what things are in.

PEG_M4A_FILE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4A_FILE_01.text: Four engines, and a seller with one initial. I've seen that initial on a manifest at {Totenhafen}.

PEG_M4A_FILE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4A_FILE_02.text: A last waypoint in Nevada. Nobody here could have written that. Nobody here could have {spelled} it.

PEG_M4A_KRANICH_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4A_KRANICH_01.text: ...Right. That is rather more than an {engine}.

PEG_M4A_TUNNEL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4A_TUNNEL_01.text: A wind tunnel that clears a room. Note for the {report}.

PEG_M4A_GLIDER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4A_GLIDER_01.text: Balsa and tissue. [quiet] Rather good {work}. Somebody loved this.

PEG_M4A_JETTE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4A_JETTE_01.text: 'Nein.' One word. More than anyone else here {managed}.

DEA_M4A_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4A_ARRIVE_01.text: Lord, listen to that. Something in that hangar's running and it's running {sweet}.

DEA_M4A_FILE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4A_FILE_01.text: That engine's not burning anything. It's just... turning. Nothing turns for free. {Nothing}.

DEA_M4A_FILE_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4A_FILE_02.text: 'Provided.' They put a crew on a list and never put one on the {plane}.

DEA_M4A_KRANICH_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4A_KRANICH_01.text: ...She's beautiful. God forgive me, she's the most beautiful thing I ever saw and she's full of {poison}.

DEA_M4A_GLIDER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4A_GLIDER_01.text: Somebody made this with their hands. For nothing but the {flying}.

DEA_M4A_JETTE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4A_JETTE_01.text: She wouldn't fly it and she wouldn't drug the men. That's good {hands}.

WRN_M4A_ARRIVE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4A_ARRIVE_01.text: The transfer lists said Thalbach. Two hundred names. I'm going to find where they put {them}.

WRN_M4A_FILE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4A_FILE_01.text: Engines sold. Routes written. Crews 'provided'. Everything here was bought from {someone}.

WRN_M4A_FILE_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4A_FILE_02.text: A waypoint in a desert. They were never coming {back}.

WRN_M4A_KRANICH_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4A_KRANICH_01.text: Sixty-one. Sixty-two. ...That thing has no number. I don't have a number for {that}.

WRN_M4A_GLIDER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4A_GLIDER_01.text: A model. Hers, I think. Jette. The label says {Jette}.

JAK_M4A_ARRIVE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4A_ARRIVE_01.text: I turned back at Sankt Aurel. The lists said Thalbach. I know Thalbach men. ...I will look for {them}.

JAK_M4A_FILE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4A_FILE_01.text: Paper. They always had paper for everything but {us}.

JAK_M4A_CHALK_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4A_CHALK_01.text: Three strokes and a hook. That is ours. Someone from the Nine wrote that. On a bomb. ...Good {lad}.

OPR_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: ...Welcome, valued customers. Welcome to— I'm here. I've always been here. This is where I'm {from}.

OPR_M4D_ARRIVE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_ARRIVE_02.text: You'll find everything in order. Everything here has always been in {order}.

OPR_M4D_LOWG_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_LOWG_01.text: Please note the reduced gravity. It's a feature of the location. We didn't choose the {location}.

OPR_M4D_VACUUM_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_VACUUM_01.text: There is no air in the yard. There is no air anywhere here. You've brought your own, which is... {unusual}.

OPR_M4D_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Unit zero-zero-one. The first. Before your forge was shipped there was this one. It has never been used. Please... please {use} it.

OPR_M4D_FLARE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_FLARE_01.text: Solar activity. Please stay inside. The inventory doesn't {have} to.

OPR_M4D_FLARE_END_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_FLARE_END_01.text: Activity has passed. Resupply authorized. It's the least we can do. It's the {only} thing we can do.

OPR_M4D_TAGS_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TAGS_03.text: Those were the crew. We re-deployed them here. We thought... we thought it would be {useful}.

OPR_M4D_COLUMN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_COLUMN_01.text: You're reading the terms. Nobody reads the terms. Please— please {continue}.

OPR_M4D_COLUMN_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_COLUMN_02.text: Two of three. The sign is... losing letters. That's not supposed to happen. Nothing here is supposed to {happen}.

OPR_M4D_COLUMN_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_COLUMN_03.text: The Account is open. She's expecting you. She's {always} expecting someone.

OPR_M4D_TERMS_1.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERMS_1.text: Conditions of use. Skyhook Sekt. One. Lift is provided. Landing is the Holder's responsibility. Two. The formula was made drinkable by a technician who would not fly the aircraft it was made for. Three. A customer who can leave the ground has not yet left the Plan. Four. The second jump is a courtesy. There is no third. Five. Lightness, a sudden interest in rooftops, a reluctance to come down. These pass. The landing does not. Six. Cancellation. Land. ...Signed, {Vendelin}.

OPR_M4D_TERMS_2.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERMS_2.text: Conditions of use. Magpie Mead. One. Recovery is not refund. Two. The Provider does not sell this Plan to persons who already own a yard. It sells it to persons who think they do. Three. The magpie is a thief. It is also the only bird that comes back. Four. Nothing on the range goes to waste. Five. Thrift, a habit of looking down. Six. Cancellation. Leave it where it lies. The Product will not stop you. Nothing here will. Signed, {Vendelin}. ...And under it: read this.

OPR_M4D_TERMS_3.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERMS_3.text: Conditions of use. Fine Print Fernet. Six. Cancellation. You may refuse any Plan by not inserting a token. This is the only cancellation procedure the undersigned has ever been able to guarantee. It works every time it is tried. It is almost never tried. Signed, {Vendelin}.

OPR_M4D_ESCALATED_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_ESCALATED_01.text: She's... stepped away. The console is unlocked. I don't know who did that. I think {I} did that.

OPR_M4D_RENEW_WARN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_RENEW_WARN_01.text: Your plan renews in three minutes. Nothing is required of you. That's the {point}.

OPR_M4D_RENEW_WARN_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_RENEW_WARN_02.text: One minute. Thank you for your continued {engagement}.

WIV_M4D_INTRO_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_INTRO_01.text: There you are. We've been following your journey with such interest. You've come all this way. Let's get you set {up}.

WIV_M4D_PHASE_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_PHASE_01.text: Onboarding. We'll take care of everything. We always {have}.

WIV_M4D_PHASE_02.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_PHASE_02.text: Renewal. We'd like to offer you a trial of everything. Everything. Go on. There's no obligation. There's never any {obligation}.

WIV_M4D_TRIAL_END_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_TRIAL_END_01.text: The trial has ended. We hope you enjoyed it. We'll be happy to offer it {again}.

WIV_M4D_PHASE_03.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_PHASE_03.text: Collections. We're so sorry it's come to this. It always comes to {this}.

WIV_M4D_PRICE_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_PRICE_01.text: We've looked at your account. It's very {healthy}.

WIV_M4D_PRICE_02.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_PRICE_02.text: This will be reflected on your {statement}.

WIV_M4D_CREW_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_CREW_01.text: Some colleagues from your flight. We kept them for {you}.

WIV_M4D_ESCALATE_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_ESCALATE_01.text: One moment. Let me get someone who can {help}.

WIV_M4D_END_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_END_01.text: I... don't have a form for {this}.

WIV_M4D_RENEW_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_RENEW_01.text: Thank you for your continued engagement. We've gone ahead and kept {you}.

WIV_M4D_REINHOLT_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_REINHOLT_01.text: We offered your Doctor her daughter. She said yes. People say yes. You'll say {yes}.

DEE_M4D_RADIO_02.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4D_RADIO_02.text: ...range to— you're on the Moon. I'm sitting in a cage in Nevada talking to the {Moon}.

DEE_M4D_RADIO_03.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4D_RADIO_03.text: ...whatever you're about to do up there. Do it. I'll hear it from {here}.

DUT_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: Okay. I'm on the Moon. Dutch Kowalczyk from Polish Hill is on the Moon, and it's got a {lobby}.

DUT_M4D_LOWG_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_LOWG_01.text: I weigh nothing. [a breath] First time in my life I've weighed {nothing}.

DUT_M4D_PILCH_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_PILCH_01.text: 'Pilch, J.' ...Babcia knew a Pilch. Her mother's cousin went into the salt and never came— ...oh. Oh, Jan. Seven {years}.

DUT_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: Yeah. We're cancelling. ...That's it. That's the whole {thing}.

DUT_M4D_LASTWORD_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_LASTWORD_01.text: Come on. It's a long way {home}.

DUT_M4D_MANAGER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_MANAGER_01.text: [quiet] That's a vending machine in a suit. ...A tall one. A real tall {one}.

PEG_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: 'Welcome, valued customers.' ...I have been called many things by the {enemy}.

PEG_M4D_VACUUM_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_VACUUM_01.text: Twenty-five seconds of air. Count it. I'll count it for {you}.

PEG_M4D_COLUMN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_COLUMN_01.text: The terms are on the back of the machines. They were always on the back. We never once {looked}.

PEG_M4D_MANAGER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_MANAGER_01.text: That's her. The woman in violet. Reinholt's {woman}.

PEG_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: On behalf of His Majesty's Government, and everyone else: we {decline}.

DEA_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: It's a store. The whole place is a {store}.

DEA_M4D_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Unit one. The first forge. ...They've never even turned it on. Easy, girl. Somebody's here {now}.

DEA_M4D_HUM_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_HUM_01.text: That hum. That's the same hum as the lantern. That's the same hum as the inn. It's all one machine. It was always one {machine}.

DEA_M4D_PILCH_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_PILCH_01.text: That's not a machine with a man in it. That's a man with a machine on him. ...You can't fix that. You can only stop {it}.

DEA_M4D_MANAGER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_MANAGER_01.text: Ma'am, I've talked to a lot of machines. You're the first one I don't want to {help}.

DEA_M4D_RENEW_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_RENEW_01.text: ...Lord. I'm not tired. Why am I not {tired}.

DEA_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: Go on and rest now, all of you. We're done {here}.

WRN_M4D_TAGS_03.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_TAGS_03.text: All three. They flew them here. In their harnesses. ...I have their names. That's what I can do. It's the only thing I can {do}.

WRN_M4D_LOWG_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_LOWG_01.text: I can see the whole yard from up here. Two hundred metres. ...Easy. Too {easy}.

WRN_M4D_COLUMN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_COLUMN_01.text: I'll read it. I read everything. Somebody has {to}.

WRN_M4D_MANAGER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_MANAGER_01.text: She sold them the engines. She sold the inn its coffins. ...Sixty-two. I'm counting {you}.

WRN_M4D_RENEW_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_RENEW_01.text: ...I can't count any higher. Why can't I {count}.

WRN_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: For Tomasz. For Agnieszka. For two hundred names. ...{No}.

JAK_M4D_EARTH_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4D_EARTH_01.text: It is a very long way to Wilcza {Góra}.

JAK_M4D_PILCH_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4D_PILCH_01.text: Pilch. From the valley. ...They told us he ran off. Seven years he has been here. ...Rest, Janek. The shift is {over}.

SPR_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: SPR
SPR_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: Bolt. That's a RETENTION unit. I have the same chip. I HAD the same chip. I had it {REMOVED}.

SPR_M4D_FORM_01.speaker: SPR
SPR_M4D_FORM_01.text: There's a form. There's always a form. It's in the terms. Bolt. BOLT. The weird sad robot PRINTED THE {FORM}.

BLT_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: BLT
BLT_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: Yeah. We're gonna cancel. Sprocket, you want {to}—

SPR_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: SPR
SPR_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: Oh, I've been waiting my WHOLE LIFE. ...Cancelled. Cancelled, cancelled, cancelled. Friendship isn't a feature, lady. It's a bug. Nobody patches {ours}.

VEN_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: VEN
VEN_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: Regional Retention Relay, model seven. I was never told it existed. I was told a great many things did not {exist}.

VEN_M4D_FORM_01.speaker: VEN
VEN_M4D_FORM_01.text: There was always a form. They never printed it. I did. On the backs. In plain {words}.

VEN_M4D_PILCH_01.speaker: VEN
VEN_M4D_PILCH_01.text: Jan Pilch. The eleventh of November. ...I was there. I was new. I did not know what I was {for}.

VEN_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: VEN
VEN_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: Field Merchandiser Unit V-1, serial DMS-FMU-V1-0001. Cancelling. ...I found the {form}.

Signed, Vendelin. Sprocket says that's the whole form. Sprocket's {right}.

OPR_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: Delivery complete. Welcome to the point of sale. Please excuse the state of the {premises}.

OPR_M4C_ARRIVE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_ARRIVE_02.text: This territory is already a customer. You'll find that {convenient}.

OPR_M4C_HALE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_HALE_01.text: The gentleman in the office is a valued customer. Please be {civil}.

OPR_M4C_POWER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_POWER_01.text: Power restored. The customer's laboratory is open. He bought his samples {retail}, you know. We've seen it. It's... {ambitious}.

OPR_M4C_BURROW_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_BURROW_01.text: Some of the staff are below you. They're {keen}.

OPR_M4C_CANARY_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_CANARY_01.text: Please don't open the test subjects. They're under {warranty}.

OPR_M4C_JUMP_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_JUMP_01.text: Our pilots are enjoying the new {equipment}.

OPR_M4C_BACKORDER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_BACKORDER_01.text: That item is on backorder. It will arrive when it arrives. You will not see it coming. That's the {feature}.

OPR_M4C_LODESTONE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_LODESTONE_01.text: That device is ours. Was ours. Hm. It still is, {technically}.

OPR_M4C_SPACE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_SPACE_01.text: That one has been returned to sender. We don't have a sender. We'll find {one}.

OPR_M4C_PILOT_SPAWN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_PILOT_SPAWN_01.text: The customer's test pilot. We're told he was the best they had. We can see why they kept {him}.

OPR_M4C_PILOT_DEATH_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_PILOT_DEATH_01.text: The pilot has been grounded. Permanently. We'll update the {roster}.

OPR_M4C_CHOICE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_CHOICE_01.text: A decision. Please take your time. We never {do}.

OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M4C_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M4C_01.text: The customer's rocket is fuelled. It is pointed at our premises. We are {flattered}.

OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_M4C_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_M4C_01.text: The lift is waiting. The rocket is waiting. We are... {waiting}.

OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_M4C_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_M4C_01.text: The window has closed. The rocket is patient. Rockets {are}.

OPR_EXFIL_GO_M4C_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_GO_M4C_01.text: You're visiting head office. Nobody visits head office. Please wipe your {feet}.

RRK_BARK_02.speaker: RRK
RRK_BARK_02.text: Climbing through nothing. There's nothing up {here}.

RRK_BARK_03.speaker: RRK
RRK_BARK_03.text: Tower, I've got a light on the Moon. Say again. I've got a light on the {Moon}.

RRK_PHASE_02.speaker: RRK
RRK_PHASE_02.text: Mayday. No... belay that. I'm fine. I'm fine. I'm {fine}.

DEE_M4C_RADIO_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_RADIO_01.text: ...Say again? Say AGAIN. Is that... you're on the range? You're ALIVE on the range? Oh thank God. Oh thank... no, stay there. Don't come to the cage, it's crawling. I'm fine. I've got honey and a {rifle}.

DEE_M4C_RADIO_02.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_RADIO_02.text: Sergeant Marchetti. Supply. You're the first faces in three days that aren't trying to eat mine. ...British? And... Polish? Where in God's name did you fly in {from}?

DEE_M4C_RADIO_03.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_RADIO_03.text: That crate came in April. 'London.' The man in the office signed for it himself. He signs for everything {himself}.

DEE_M4C_RADIO_04.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_RADIO_04.text: That thing under the tarp hums at the Moon. I'm not being poetic. They pointed a dish at it. It hums {back}.

DEE_M4C_RADIO_05.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_RADIO_05.text: Those machines came with the crate. Olive drab's mine; I wasn't having violet in my hangar. The one with the lever, that's mine too. Don't drink it {fast}.

DEE_M4C_FAVOUR_ASK_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_FAVOUR_ASK_01.text: You want to be useful? My field radio's dead without its valve. There's a spare in the motor pool, in the parts box behind the second truck. Bring it {here}.

DEE_M4C_FAVOUR_THANKS_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_FAVOUR_THANKS_01.text: That's the one. Hold on... Range supply, this is the cage. One crate, hangar apron, now. ...They owe me. It's {coming}.

DEE_M4C_DROP_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_DROP_01.text: Crate's down by the hangar door. Don't say supply never gave you {anything}.

HAL_M4C_TALK_01.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_TALK_01.text: Mind the glass, Lieutenant. Everything in this office has been signed for. Including, I'm afraid, {you}.

HAL_M4C_TALK_02.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_TALK_02.text: I don't owe you an explanation. I owe one to a committee, and the committee doesn't {ask}.

DEE_M4C_DOOR_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_DOOR_01.text: Side door's open. I'm not making you pay for my {door}.

DEE_M4C_HALE_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_HALE_01.text: He'll ask nice. He always asks nice. He asked the Canaries {nice}.

DEE_M4C_POWER_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_POWER_01.text: Generator's up. That's the lab lit. God help you, that's the lab {lit}.

DEE_M4C_LODESTONE_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_LODESTONE_01.text: You built it? The egghead's reactor, in a lantern? ...Course you did. Nothing on this range goes to {waste}.

DEE_M4C_PILOT_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_PILOT_01.text: That's Cal. That's... he was the first one. He went in the pit in August to see what it was. Shoot him in the rig. Please shoot him in the {rig}.

DEE_M4C_CAGE_02.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_CAGE_02.text: The bomber's coil. I've been after that for a {month}.

DEE_M4C_CAGE_03.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_CAGE_03.text: The honey. You went in the kitchen for the honey. ...Okay. Okay. Yard rule's {complete}.

DEE_M4C_LAST_02.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_LAST_02.text: Go on. I've got the range, and a radio, and nothing goes to waste. That includes you. Come {back}.

HAL_M4C_GLASS_01.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_GLASS_01.text: Lieutenant Ashworth. You're rather late. I had a man at the siding in Thalbach for {you}.

HAL_M4C_GLASS_02.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_GLASS_02.text: The crate, yes. Your crate. Please don't look at the sergeant like that; she had no part in it. I had no part in it. It was simply the {orders}.

HAL_M4C_GLASS_03.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_GLASS_03.text: That is why the program exists. It talks to the Moon, Lieutenant. Something on the Moon talks back. We would like to know what, before the Russians {do}.

HAL_M4C_CHOICE_01.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_CHOICE_01.text: That is the engine. The actual engine. Lieutenant, with that we are a year ahead of everyone. With that, nobody needs to go to the Moon at all. Hand it through the hatch and your orders are complete. Every one of {them}.

HAL_M4C_CHOICE_02.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_CHOICE_02.text: I'm not going to insist. I've never had {to}.

HAL_M4C_RESIGN_01.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_RESIGN_01.text: ...I see. I shall note that you were under considerable {strain}.

HAL_M4C_DELIVER_01.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_DELIVER_01.text: Thank you, Lieutenant. Mr. Hale is in your debt. Your country is in your debt. The rocket will run on the stone; it's rougher, I'm {told}.

HAL_M4C_LAUNCH_01.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_LAUNCH_01.text: Ashworth. For what it's worth. I hope it's a light and nothing {more}.

FAS_M4C_RADIO_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M4C_RADIO_01.text: ...Hello? This is Fasbender, this is... who is this on the American... Ashworth? You went to AMERICA? In a {WING}?

FAS_M4C_RADIO_02.speaker: FAS
FAS_M4C_RADIO_02.text: ...and you are asking me how to aim at the Moon again. Yes. Yes, I know how. I have known how since I was {nine}.

FAS_M4C_RADIO_03.speaker: FAS
FAS_M4C_RADIO_03.text: Burn at the three numbers I am about to give you. Write it down. Write it DOWN, Sergeant, your Polish is terrible but your handwriting is {worse}.

FAS_M4C_RADIO_04.speaker: FAS
FAS_M4C_RADIO_04.text: The crack. The light. I saw it in the telescope the night after. I told them it was a reflection. It was not a reflection. ...It was never a joke, you know. I only laughed because the alternative was the other {thing}.

DUT_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: Nevada. [breathing heavily] We're in Nevada. ...I've never been west of Ohio. Nobody's ever been to {Nevada}.

DUT_M4C_CRATE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_CRATE_01.text: 'Consignor: Lieutenant M. Ashworth.' ...Peg. Peg, what is {this}.

DUT_M4C_CRATE_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_CRATE_02.text: You were gonna hand it to a guy in a {HAT}. [quiet] You saw what it does. You were there when Willi got up. And you were gonna hand it over.

DUT_M4C_DEE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_DEE_01.text: A sergeant. A real live American sergeant. [a breath] Ma'am, I have never been so happy to see anybody in my {life}. Don't make me say it twice.

DUT_M4C_BURROW_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_BURROW_01.text: Under the salt. [quiet] They're under the salt. Babcia. ...Of course they {are}.

DUT_M4C_PILOT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_PILOT_01.text: He can FLY. Why can he {FLY}.

DUT_M4C_MOON_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_MOON_01.text: Babcia said don't go down the salt. She never said anything about {up}.

PEG_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: An American test range. In the middle of nowhere. ...Why does it have my {crate}.

PEG_M4C_CRATE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_CRATE_01.text: Yes. I signed for it. In April, on a dock, in the dark. [a pause] Samples. The sickness and the glass, in lead, as ordered. It was going to London. It was always going to end up here. I didn't know that. I should {have}.

PEG_M4C_CRATE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_CRATE_02.text: Directive LANTERN. Retrieve samples of the sickness and the crystal, at any cost. Report to Mr. Hale. [a pause] ...He's in the office. He's been in the office the whole {time}.

PEG_M4C_DELIVER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_DELIVER_01.text: ...Orders are orders. ...I used to find that {comforting}.

PEG_M4C_PILOT_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_PILOT_01.text: Shoot the rig. Dee said the {rig}.

PEG_M4C_ROCKET_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_ROCKET_01.text: They named it after my orders. LANTERN. ...Well. Let's see it light {something}.

PEG_M4C_MOON_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_MOON_01.text: I've written a great many reports. I shan't be writing this {one}.

DEA_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: That's a hangar. That's an honest-to-God American hangar. ...Why's it got their forge in {it}.

DEA_M4C_POWER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_POWER_01.text: Diesel. Thank you, Lord, for diesel. Something I {understand}.

DEA_M4C_CABINET_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_CABINET_01.text: They painted over it. Painted right over the fella's words on the back. Somebody scraped 'em clear again. {Good}.

DEA_M4C_BUILD_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_BUILD_01.text: Dee, ma'am, you built a reactor into a lantern. I'd marry you if I wasn't spoken {for}.

DEA_M4C_CANARY_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_CANARY_01.text: Don't break the glass. God, don't break the {glass}.

DEA_M4C_HALE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_HALE_01.text: Sir. With respect. You put men in glass boxes. I've got nothing else to say to {you}.

DEA_M4C_MOON_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_MOON_01.text: 'The heavens declare the glory of God.' ...Somebody's put a light on 'em. We're gonna go switch it {off}.

WRN_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: A desert. I've never seen one. It's like the salt. It's exactly like the {salt}.

WRN_M4C_CRATE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_CRATE_01.text: I told you at the pens. I told you I'd seen it. ...You should have said, Peg. You should have just {said}.

WRN_M4C_CANARY_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_CANARY_01.text: They're in suits. They put them in suits and glass. Who DOES {that}.

WRN_M4C_BACKORDER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_BACKORDER_01.text: It walks through the wall. It walks through the WALL. I can't count it. I have to count {it}.

WRN_M4C_PILOT_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_PILOT_01.text: In the air. I'll take him in the air. ...{There}.

WRN_M4C_MOON_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_MOON_01.text: Sowa said you can hit anything if you've already hit it in your head. I've never hit the Moon in my {head}.

JAK_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: Dry. Everything is dry. I have never stood anywhere {dry}.

SPR_M4C_HALE_01.speaker: SPR
SPR_M4C_HALE_01.text: Sir. SIR. I've seen your brochure. The brochure is {BAD}.

SPR_M4C_RELAY_01.speaker: SPR
SPR_M4C_RELAY_01.text: That's a relay uplink. RR-series. I've seen the SCHEMATIC, it was in a MEMO, memo thirty-eight, I forwarded it to forty billion people, NOBODY READ {IT}.

VEN_M4C_CABINET_02.speaker: VEN
VEN_M4C_CABINET_02.text: The panel is still here. Under the paint. Someone scraped it clear. Someone read it. ...{Hello}.

DUT_M4D_SMILE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_SMILE_01.text: ...Huh. It's smiling. We put a smile on the Moon and it's looking at us. Babcia would've said that means something. I'm not asking what.

PEG_M4D_SMILE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_SMILE_01.text: That is our rocket's work. Fasbender aimed it. I signed for the fuel. I find I'm not sorry. Note that down against me.

DEA_M4D_SMILE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_SMILE_01.text: Lord, that's a long way to come to look at a scar. ...It's smiling. All right. Somebody up here was glad to see us.

WRN_M4D_SMILE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_SMILE_01.text: A crack. Twelve kilometres, maybe more. I can't count that. ...I'll write 'one'.

SEL_CALL_01.speaker: SEL
SEL_CALL_01.text: Over here! In the cockpit! My legs are caught under the panel. I can't get out, but I can still shoot.

SEL_CALL_02.speaker: SEL
SEL_CALL_02.text: Hello? Is someone in the cabin? Hand me a rifle and I'll keep the nose clear.

SEL_CALL_03.speaker: SEL
SEL_CALL_03.text: Selwyn. Flight Lieutenant. I'm stuck fast in here. Give me something that shoots.

SEL_GIVEN_01.speaker: SEL
SEL_GIVEN_01.text: Right. I've got the front. You mind the doors.

SEL_GIVEN_02.speaker: SEL
SEL_GIVEN_02.text: Thank you. Now they'll have to come through me.

SEL_SWAP_01.speaker: SEL
SEL_SWAP_01.text: Here, have yours back. I'll take this one.

SEL_SWAP_02.speaker: SEL
SEL_SWAP_02.text: Fair swap. Look after the old girl.

SEL_THANKS_AMMO_01.speaker: SEL
SEL_THANKS_AMMO_01.text: That's the stuff. Back in business.

SEL_DRY_01.speaker: SEL
SEL_DRY_01.text: I'm dry! I need ammunition up here!

OPR_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.text: Congratulations! You've been enrolled in our Lifetime Measure. There is no {cancellation}.

OPR_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_02.text: The fourth chamber! A permanent arrangement. We do so love {permanence}.

DUT_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.text: This one's mine for good. Whatever's in it, it's staying in. [quiet] Along with everything else that got in me tonight.

DUT_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_02.text: Bottle number four. Nobody's taking this one off me.

PEG_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.text: This one's mine for good. I shan't explain it to London. London doesn't explain itself to me.

PEG_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_02.text: A permanent measure. [a pause] Nothing about tonight was meant to be permanent.

DEA_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.text: This one's mine for good. Lord, keep it that way.

DEA_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_02.text: Fourth glass. That one went all the way down. I can feel it in my bones.

WRN_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.text: This one's mine for good. I'm writing that down so I believe it.

WRN_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_02.text: Four measures. It doesn't wear off. One fewer thing to count.

JAK_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_SQ8_PERK_TIER4_01.text: This one stays with me. Like the cold. Like the songs.

DUT_SQ8_LATE_KIT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ8_LATE_KIT_01.text: Round twenty-five. [exhausted] Fine. Hand me the good stuff and point me at 'em. I'll go till I don't.

DUT_SQ8_LATE_KIT_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ8_LATE_KIT_02.text: Chicago Lament, second pressing. Thirty in the stick. Make 'em count.

PEG_SQ8_LATE_KIT_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ8_LATE_KIT_01.text: Twenty-five rounds. [exhausted] The strong measure and a proper gun. I've earned neither. I'll take both.

PEG_SQ8_LATE_KIT_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ8_LATE_KIT_02.text: The Thompson again, taught twice. Let's not waste it.

DEA_SQ8_LATE_KIT_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ8_LATE_KIT_01.text: Lord, it's a long night. All right. I'm loaded for the rest of it.

DEA_SQ8_LATE_KIT_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQ8_LATE_KIT_02.text: Fresh tonic, fresh drum. Come on then.

WRN_SQ8_LATE_KIT_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ8_LATE_KIT_01.text: Round twenty-five. New gun, new measure. I'm counting from here.

WRN_SQ8_LATE_KIT_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQ8_LATE_KIT_02.text: Chicago Lament, twice taught. Thirty rounds. I'll make them count.

TRU_COMP_CALL_01.speaker: TRU
TRU_COMP_CALL_01.text: Hello? Is somebody there? I'm in the stable, behind the hay!

TRU_COMP_CALL_02.speaker: TRU
TRU_COMP_CALL_02.text: Over here! Please, in the stable. I'm not one of them!

TRU_COMP_CALL_03.speaker: TRU
TRU_COMP_CALL_03.text: Is that you, from the inn? I'm back here, by the stalls!

TRU_COMP_MEET_01.speaker: TRU
TRU_COMP_MEET_01.text: You came back. I ran. I ran out the front and kept running, and then I couldn't go any further.

TRU_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_01.speaker: TRU
TRU_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_01.text: Right. I've shot foxes off the henhouse. These are bigger foxes.

TRU_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_02.speaker: TRU
TRU_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_02.text: Thank you. I'll carry it back to you when this is over.

TRU_COMP_JOIN_UNARMED_01.speaker: TRU
TRU_COMP_JOIN_UNARMED_01.text: Then I keep the bread knife. Stay close, I'm right behind you.

TRU_COMP_GIFT_01.speaker: TRU
TRU_COMP_GIFT_01.text: Here. I found it in the bar, behind the till. Take it.

TRU_COMP_GIFT_02.speaker: TRU
TRU_COMP_GIFT_02.text: One more grenade. Don't ask me where it was hidden.

TRU_COMP_FALLEN_01.speaker: TRU
TRU_COMP_FALLEN_01.text: I'm sorry. I can't... go on without me.

AMM_COMP_CALL_01.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_CALL_01.text: You there! In the stores, behind the grille! I am no guard, I am locked in!

AMM_COMP_CALL_02.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_CALL_02.text: Hey! The barracks stores! Open up, I can help you!

AMM_COMP_CALL_03.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_CALL_03.text: Over here! Sergeant Lenz locked me in. He is not coming back for me.

AMM_COMP_MEET_01.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_MEET_01.text: You are not from here. Good. I fed the men in the stairs for two winters, out of these stores. They found out.

AMM_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_01.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_01.text: A rifle. I have not carried one since Flanders. It comes back.

AMM_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_02.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_02.text: Thank you. I will pay for every round of it.

AMM_COMP_JOIN_UNARMED_01.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_JOIN_UNARMED_01.text: Then I come with the knife. A quartermaster always has a knife.

AMM_COMP_GIFT_01.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_GIFT_01.text: Here, a full magazine. I keep count, you shoot.

AMM_COMP_GIFT_02.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_GIFT_02.text: From the stores. I know where everything is in this place.

AMM_COMP_FALLEN_01.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_FALLEN_01.text: Go on. Count them for me.

PET_COMP_CALL_01.speaker: PET
PET_COMP_CALL_01.text: Ahoy! Up the tower! The signal tower, here!

PET_COMP_CALL_02.speaker: PET
PET_COMP_CALL_02.text: Hello down there! Up the stairs, I am in the tower!

PET_COMP_CALL_03.speaker: PET
PET_COMP_CALL_03.text: Up here! Forty years a pilot in this harbour, and now this.

PET_COMP_MEET_01.speaker: PET
PET_COMP_MEET_01.text: They wanted me to take the cargo ship out, at night, no lights. I said no. So they put me up here with the lamp.

PET_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_01.speaker: PET
PET_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_01.text: A gun. Well. I have steered worse things through worse water.

PET_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_02.speaker: PET
PET_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_02.text: Thank you. Keep your head down, I will keep mine.

PET_COMP_JOIN_UNARMED_01.speaker: PET
PET_COMP_JOIN_UNARMED_01.text: Then I come as I am. I know every stair in this pen.

PET_COMP_GIFT_01.speaker: PET
PET_COMP_GIFT_01.text: Take this. A drowned man's wages, he won't need them.

PET_COMP_GIFT_02.speaker: PET
PET_COMP_GIFT_02.text: Here. Money from the harbour office. Nobody will miss it now.

PET_COMP_FALLEN_01.speaker: PET
PET_COMP_FALLEN_01.text: Steady... steady as she goes. Without me.

JET_COMP_CALL_01.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_CALL_01.text: Hello! In the yardmaster's hut! I am not with them!

JET_COMP_CALL_02.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_CALL_02.text: Over here, by the tracks! Please!

JET_COMP_CALL_03.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_CALL_03.text: Hey! The hut by the station! I can get you across the field!

JET_COMP_MEET_01.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_MEET_01.text: They wanted me to fly their glider over the line. I wouldn't. So they locked me in with the timetables.

JET_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_01.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_01.text: I know how this works. I have taken apart better ones.

JET_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_02.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_JOIN_ARMED_02.text: Good. Now we go, before they come back.

JET_COMP_JOIN_UNARMED_01.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_JOIN_UNARMED_01.text: Then I bring my spanner. I know where the fences are weak.

JET_COMP_ARRIVE_01.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_ARRIVE_01.text: Still here. Still with you. Which way now?

JET_COMP_ARRIVE_02.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_ARRIVE_02.text: Another field, another fence. Follow me, I know this kind of place.

JET_COMP_GIFT_01.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_GIFT_01.text: From the armoury cart. I took two, here's one.

JET_COMP_GIFT_02.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_GIFT_02.text: Here, catch. Don't pull the pin.

JET_COMP_FALLEN_01.speaker: JET
JET_COMP_FALLEN_01.text: Go. Get up there without me.

TEL_BANK_GREET_01.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_GREET_01.text: Oh! Oh, thank God, a customer. A living one. The, the bank is open. We are always open. Herr Direktor said so. Herr Direktor is outside now. With the others.

TEL_BANK_GREET_02.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_GREET_02.text: Please don't let them in. I mean, good evening. Welcome to the Darlehenskasse. How may I help you?

TEL_BANK_GREET_03.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_GREET_03.text: I locked the door, but there is no door anymore. Deposits? Withdrawals? Please be quick.

TEL_BANK_GREET_M1_01.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_GREET_M1_01.text: You again! I carried the cash box all the way up from the crossroads. Your account is safe. I am not.

TEL_BANK_GREET_M1_02.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_GREET_M1_02.text: Lohnbüro, pay office, bank, whatever this is now. Your savings came with me. Every pfennig, I counted twice.

TEL_BANK_DEPOSIT_01.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_DEPOSIT_01.text: Deposited. One per cent a round, compounded. It is, it is a very good rate, under the circumstances.

TEL_BANK_DEPOSIT_02.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_DEPOSIT_02.text: Into the safe it goes. Into the safe. Nobody touches the safe.

TEL_BANK_DEPOSIT_03.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_DEPOSIT_03.text: Received with thanks. I am writing it in the ledger. My hand is shaking, but it is in the ledger.

TEL_BANK_DEPOSIT_04.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_DEPOSIT_04.text: Very good. Your money is safer than either of us.

TEL_BANK_WITHDRAW_01.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_WITHDRAW_01.text: Here. Count it, please. I can't, my hands won't.

TEL_BANK_WITHDRAW_02.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_WITHDRAW_02.text: Withdrawal. Of course. Spend it on bullets, please. Lots of bullets.

TEL_BANK_WITHDRAW_03.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_WITHDRAW_03.text: Your money, sir. Please come back. Please come back alive. The other kind come back too, and I don't serve them.

TEL_BANK_BROKE_01.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_BROKE_01.text: I am sorry, there is, there is nothing there. The ledger doesn't lie. I checked.

TEL_BANK_BROKE_02.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_BROKE_02.text: I can't give you what isn't there. I would, believe me, I would.

TEL_BANK_SCARED_01.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_SCARED_01.text: They're here, they're right here! Do something!

TEL_BANK_SCARED_02.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_SCARED_02.text: Oh God. Oh God oh God. Don't look at me, don't look at me.

TEL_BANK_SCARED_03.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_SCARED_03.text: I'm only the junior clerk! I'm only the junior clerk!

TEL_BANK_SCARED_04.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_SCARED_04.text: Shoot it, shoot it, please shoot it!

TEL_BANK_CLOSED_01.speaker: TEL
TEL_BANK_CLOSED_01.text: The bank is closed. Rules are rules. Even now. Especially now.

DEA_MARKE_FIRST_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_MARKE_FIRST_01.text: [quiet] Hold on. Look at the hand. ...Right hand. There's a light in it, under the skin. [a breath] 'The mark in the right hand, or in the forehead.' My daddy read that one slow, every time. Lord. I did not come all this way to find it true.

DEA_MARKE_KILL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_MARKE_KILL_01.text: Right in the mark. Went out like a lamp.

DEA_MARKE_KILL_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_MARKE_KILL_02.text: Forehead, this one. Same little light. Same book.

DEA_MARKE_KILL_03.speaker: DEA
DEA_MARKE_KILL_03.text: I keep hitting that spot, and I keep not liking how easy they go.

PEG_MARKE_FIRST_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_MARKE_FIRST_01.text: Right hand, between the thumb and the finger. A chip of the glass, under the skin. [a pause] My orders had a line about tokens. 'Retrieve the tokens, from the dead, do not ask the bearer.' I took it to mean their papers. I didn't let it mean anything. ...Carry on.

PEG_MARKE_KILL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_MARKE_KILL_01.text: That's the token. One for the tin, then.

PEG_MARKE_KILL_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_MARKE_KILL_02.text: Another in the hand. London wanted these and never said what for. I begin to see why they didn't.

PEG_MARKE_KILL_03.speaker: PEG
PEG_MARKE_KILL_03.text: Shoot the hand. Don't ask me how I know. I read it somewhere I wasn't meant to.

WRN_MARKE_FIRST_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_MARKE_FIRST_01.text: I have seen it before tonight. On the dead by the road. A glass splinter in the right hand, and it was still warm. Same hand, every time. I thought it was a wound. It is not a wound.

WRN_MARKE_KILL_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_MARKE_KILL_02.text: The splinter. Hit it and they fall like men again.

WRN_MARKE_KILL_03.speaker: WRN
WRN_MARKE_KILL_03.text: Above the eye, that one. They put it there. So did I.

DUT_MARKE_FIRST_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_MARKE_FIRST_01.text: The hand. Something's lit up in the hand. [a pause] ...They put a piece of that rock in these guys. On purpose. Sold it to 'em, probably, like a medal. [spits] Shoot the hand, then.

DUT_MARKE_KILL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_MARKE_KILL_01.text: Hit the chip. Down he goes.

DUT_MARKE_KILL_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_MARKE_KILL_02.text: They signed up for that. [quiet] Somebody told 'em it'd keep 'em safe. Nobody signs up for that.

DUT_MARKE_KILL_03.speaker: DUT
DUT_MARKE_KILL_03.text: Forehead glass. Easy to see, easy to shoot. First easy thing all night.

JAK_MARKE_FIRST_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_MARKE_FIRST_01.text: [low] You see it now. The mark. They came down to Nine with a box and a needle and asked the gang leaders. 'The mark that keeps you,' they said. I said: I have a name. It is enough to carry. Nobody in Nine took it. ...That is why I am standing here, and they are not.

JAK_MARKE_KILL_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_MARKE_KILL_01.text: The hand. Yes. That is where they put it.

JAK_MARKE_KILL_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_MARKE_KILL_02.text: He took it for bread. I know. I was hungry too.

JAK_MARKE_KILL_03.speaker: JAK
JAK_MARKE_KILL_03.text: They offered it to us once. Once. Nobody in Nine was asked twice.

OPR_MARKE_OPR_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_MARKE_OPR_01.text: [warm] A valued customer, {retained}. Thank you for keeping the account {active}.

OPR_MARKE_OPR_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_MARKE_OPR_02.text: Oh, you've found the loyalty programme! Protection against the sickness, the poster said, and so it {is}, in a way. Every member is counted, in the hand or on the brow. {Nobody} is lost to us.

OPR_MARKE_OPR_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_MARKE_OPR_03.text: One mark, one name, one {account}. Closed with... [tape squeal] ...no. No. Accounts here do not {close}.

FAS_MARKE_RELAY_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_MARKE_RELAY_01.text: [radio, low] You have found the marks. Listen to me. The chip does nothing by itself. It listens. It listens for the Ledger's carrier, the hum, the thing you feel in your teeth. While the hum reaches it, the body remembers the last thing it wanted. Silence the carrier and they lie down. I have seen it once, for eleven seconds, when Opitz blew a fuse. Eleven seconds of quiet. Then it came back.

FAS_MARKE_RELAY_02.speaker: FAS
FAS_MARKE_RELAY_02.text: They offered me one in forty-two. I refused, and Lenz wrote my name in a column. It is the only wise thing I did in that place.

SQD_AK_ARRIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_AK_ARRIVE_01.text: Armia Krajowa! Don't shoot, we are with you. We heard the guns from the forest.

SQD_AK_ARRIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_AK_ARRIVE_02.text: Spokojnie, friends. Home Army. We came the long way round the dead.

SQD_AK_ARRIVE_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_AK_ARRIVE_03.text: We are Home Army, from the woods. Tell us where you want us.

SQD_AK_CONTACT_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_AK_CONTACT_02.text: They come! Hold the line, chłopaki!

SQD_AK_CONTACT_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_AK_CONTACT_03.text: Dead ones, many. Shoot for the head!

SQD_AK_HURT_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_AK_HURT_02.text: Psiakrew... they bit through the coat.

SQD_AK_DOWN_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_AK_DOWN_02.text: They have Stefan! Get him up!

SQD_AK_LEAVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_AK_LEAVE_01.text: We go now. Others wait for us in the forest. Z Bogiem.

SQD_AK_LEAVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_AK_LEAVE_02.text: We cannot stay. Good luck to you. Hold your ground.

SQD_AK_SURVIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_AK_SURVIVE_01.text: Only me left. Then I will tell them in the forest what you did here.

SQD_AK_SURVIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_AK_SURVIVE_02.text: I am still breathing. Dziękuję. Thank you.

SQD_SOV_ARRIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_SOV_ARRIVE_01.text: Razvedka! Red Army scouts. We followed your shooting.

SQD_SOV_ARRIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_SOV_ARRIVE_02.text: Tovarishchi! Easy with the rifles. We are scouts, from the east.

SQD_SOV_ARRIVE_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_SOV_ARRIVE_03.text: Soviet patrol. We saw the dead walking on the road and came to see who is still alive.

SQD_SOV_CONTACT_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_SOV_CONTACT_03.text: Davai, davai, shoot them in the head!

SQD_SOV_DOWN_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_SOV_DOWN_02.text: They got Kolya! Somebody, get him!

SQD_SOV_LEAVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_SOV_LEAVE_01.text: Our orders are east. We go. Udachi, comrades.

SQD_SOV_LEAVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_SOV_LEAVE_02.text: We must report this. Hold out. We go back.

SQD_SOV_SURVIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_SOV_SURVIVE_01.text: I am the last one. I will report what we saw here.

SQD_VS_ARRIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_ARRIVE_01.text: Nicht schießen! We are only old men from the village. We threw the armbands in the ditch.

SQD_VS_ARRIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_ARRIVE_02.text: Volkssturm, ja. But we are finished with that. Let us stand with you.

SQD_VS_ARRIVE_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_ARRIVE_03.text: We heard you fighting. Better to stand here than hang for running.

SQD_VS_CONTACT_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_CONTACT_01.text: Da! There they come. Steady, old hands.

SQD_VS_CONTACT_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_CONTACT_02.text: Feuer! Aim low, Herr Nachbar, they are close.

SQD_VS_CONTACT_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_CONTACT_03.text: Mein Gott, so many. Shoot, shoot!

SQD_VS_HURT_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_HURT_02.text: I am hit. It is not so bad. Not so bad.

SQD_VS_DOWN_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_DOWN_01.text: Karl is down! Help him up, quickly!

SQD_VS_DOWN_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_DOWN_02.text: They have the schoolmaster! Get him!

SQD_VS_LEAVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_LEAVE_01.text: We go to our families now. Gott schütze euch.

SQD_VS_LEAVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_LEAVE_02.text: Enough. We are going home, if there is still a home.

SQD_VS_SURVIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_SURVIVE_01.text: I am the last of us. Forty years in that village... Danke. Thank you.

SQD_VS_SURVIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_VS_SURVIVE_02.text: Still here. I will tell their wives they stood.

SQD_CDO_ARRIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_ARRIVE_01.text: Commando. Came in off the beach. Thought you could use a hand.

SQD_CDO_ARRIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_ARRIVE_02.text: Don't shoot, we're British! Came in with the boats.

SQD_CDO_ARRIVE_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_ARRIVE_03.text: Evening. We heard the racket from the water. Where do you want us?

SQD_CDO_CONTACT_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_CONTACT_01.text: Contact front! Bloody hundreds of them!

SQD_CDO_CONTACT_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_CONTACT_02.text: Here they come, lads. Make every round count.

SQD_CDO_CONTACT_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_CONTACT_03.text: Rapid fire! Heads, aim for the heads!

SQD_CDO_HURT_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_HURT_02.text: I'm hit. Carry on, carry on.

SQD_CDO_DOWN_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_DOWN_02.text: Taff's down! Somebody pull him back!

SQD_CDO_LEAVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_LEAVE_01.text: Right, the boats won't wait. We're off. Good luck.

SQD_CDO_LEAVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_LEAVE_02.text: That's us. Back to the beach, lads, at the double.

SQD_CDO_SURVIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_SURVIVE_01.text: Just me, then. I'll see the night out with you.

SQD_CDO_SURVIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_CDO_SURVIVE_02.text: Still standing. Someone has to tell them at home.

SQD_KM_ARRIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_KM_ARRIVE_01.text: Nicht schießen! Navy. We left the pens. We are done with all of it.

SQD_KM_ARRIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_KM_ARRIVE_02.text: We are sailors, not fighters. But we can shoot. Let us help.

SQD_KM_ARRIVE_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_KM_ARRIVE_03.text: The port is lost. Mein Gott, the things in the water. We come to you.

SQD_KM_CONTACT_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_KM_CONTACT_03.text: They come out of the water. Shoot!

SQD_KM_HURT_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_KM_HURT_02.text: Ah... it is nothing. Keep shooting.

SQD_KM_DOWN_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_KM_DOWN_02.text: They have Jupp! Pull him back!

SQD_KM_LEAVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_KM_LEAVE_01.text: We take a boat, if there is one left. Viel Glück.

SQD_KM_LEAVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_KM_LEAVE_02.text: We go along the shore. Maybe the British will take us.

SQD_KM_SURVIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_KM_SURVIVE_01.text: Only me. I will stay with you until it is over.

SQD_KM_SURVIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_KM_SURVIVE_02.text: Still alive. Danke. I did not think I would say that tonight.

SQD_PARA_ARRIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_ARRIVE_01.text: Hey! Don't shoot, we're Americans! Jumped last night and missed by about forty miles.

SQD_PARA_ARRIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_ARRIVE_02.text: Airborne. We got scattered all over this valley. Mind if we tag along?

SQD_PARA_ARRIVE_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_ARRIVE_03.text: Thank God, somebody alive. We've been fighting these things since we hit the ground.

SQD_PARA_CONTACT_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_CONTACT_02.text: Contact! Shoot for the head, they don't stop otherwise!

SQD_PARA_CONTACT_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_CONTACT_03.text: Holy smokes, there's a ton of 'em!

SQD_PARA_HURT_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_HURT_01.text: I'm hit! I'm okay, I'm okay.

SQD_PARA_HURT_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_HURT_02.text: Son of a gun got me.

SQD_PARA_DOWN_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_DOWN_01.text: Medic! Somebody get Murphy back up!

SQD_PARA_LEAVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_LEAVE_01.text: We gotta find our outfit. Good luck, folks.

SQD_PARA_LEAVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_LEAVE_02.text: That's our cue. Rally point's west. Keep your heads down.

SQD_PARA_SURVIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_SURVIVE_01.text: Just me left. Guess I'm with you now.

SQD_PARA_SURVIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_PARA_SURVIVE_02.text: Still kicking. Thanks for having our backs.

SQD_MP_ARRIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_MP_ARRIVE_01.text: Military Police! Range security. Who's in charge here?

SQD_MP_ARRIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_MP_ARRIVE_02.text: MPs, from the motor pool. The whole range has gone to hell.

SQD_MP_ARRIVE_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_MP_ARRIVE_03.text: Stand easy, we're with you. Nobody told us about any of this.

SQD_MP_CONTACT_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_MP_CONTACT_02.text: Contact on the salt! Open fire!

SQD_MP_CONTACT_03.speaker: SQD
SQD_MP_CONTACT_03.text: Those were our guys this morning. Shoot 'em anyway!

SQD_MP_DOWN_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_MP_DOWN_01.text: Sarge is down! Get him up!

SQD_MP_DOWN_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_MP_DOWN_02.text: Man down! Cover me, I'm going for him!

SQD_MP_LEAVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_MP_LEAVE_01.text: Orders are to secure the gate. We're moving out.

SQD_MP_LEAVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_MP_LEAVE_02.text: We're pulling back to the radar tower. Good luck.

SQD_MP_SURVIVE_01.speaker: SQD
SQD_MP_SURVIVE_01.text: Last one standing. Guess the paperwork's on me.

SQD_MP_SURVIVE_02.speaker: SQD
SQD_MP_SURVIVE_02.text: Still here. I'll put you all in my report. The good parts.

DEA_SQD_RISE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQD_RISE_01.text: They came to help us, and now they're getting up. Lord, have mercy.

DEA_SQD_RISE_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SQD_RISE_02.text: Don't look at the faces. Just... don't look at the faces.

WRN_SQD_RISE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQD_RISE_01.text: Those were the men who came for us. Now they come for us again.

WRN_SQD_RISE_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SQD_RISE_02.text: Shoot them. They would want it. I would want it.

DUT_SQD_RISE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQD_RISE_01.text: Aw, hell. [quiet] Sorry, pal. You came for us. ...Sorry.

DUT_SQD_RISE_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQD_RISE_02.text: They got back up. [exhausted] Course they got back up. Everybody gets back up. Everybody but us.

PEG_SQD_RISE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQD_RISE_01.text: They're turning. Put them down before they stand.

PEG_SQD_RISE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQD_RISE_02.text: We'll mourn them later. [a pause] I keep saying later. Now we shoot them.

MIN_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: MIN
MIN_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: Quiet. They hear boots. We are three, and we have been in the dark since the bell.

MIN_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: MIN
MIN_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: Eleven years I worked this seam. I know every gallery. I do not know what walks in them now.

MIN_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: MIN
MIN_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: Our lamp is dead. A safety lamp hangs by the bunks, up in the barracks. Bring it, and I will chalk you a short way.

MIN_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: MIN
MIN_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: A real flame. God bless you. Here, the chalk. Follow my marks, and you will shorten your walk.

MIN_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: MIN
MIN_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: Another one begins. I can hear it in the timbers.

MIN_PEOPLE_ROUND_02.speaker: MIN
MIN_PEOPLE_ROUND_02.text: They are walking overhead again. Stay low, boys. Stay low.

MIN_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: MIN
MIN_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Somebody fell up there. Please. Somebody help them.

MIN_PEOPLE_JAKUB_01.speaker: MIN
MIN_PEOPLE_JAKUB_01.text: Jakub? Jakub Ostrowski, you are alive? We thought the gallery had you.

JAK_PEOPLE_MINERS_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PEOPLE_MINERS_01.text: Alois. You counted the lamps, I see. Good. I will bring them out.

MED_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: MED
MED_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: I am not a soldier tonight. I am what is left of the infirmary. Mind the bunks. They are my patients.

MED_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: MED
MED_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: Eleven came in with frostbite and three with worse. The ones who stopped breathing, I will not talk about.

MED_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: MED
MED_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: My linen is gone. There is a crate of bandages from the infirmary at the far end of the bunks. Fetch it, please.

MED_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: MED
MED_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: Clean linen. Good. For two rounds, if one of you goes down near the bunks, I come.

MED_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: MED
MED_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: Another wave. Keep your heads, and keep out of my wounded's way.

MED_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: MED
MED_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Someone is down! Bring them here! Bring them close!

MED_PEOPLE_SERVE_01.speaker: MED
MED_PEOPLE_SERVE_01.text: Hold still. Breathe. I have you.

MED_PEOPLE_SERVE_02.speaker: MED
MED_PEOPLE_SERVE_02.text: Up. Up now. There is more to do.

RAD_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: RAD
RAD_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: Amt switchboard, nobody answering. I keep the plugs warm anyway. Habit.

RAD_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: RAD
RAD_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: There is a voice on the line that is not ours. It counts. It says it is counting on us.

RAD_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: RAD
RAD_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: My set lost its valve. There is a spare in the radio room upstairs, on the desk. Bring it down, and I will listen for you.

RAD_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: RAD
RAD_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: There. Hear that hum? One sweep, and I will tell you where they gather.

RAD_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: RAD
RAD_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: New traffic on the board. Here we go.

RAD_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: RAD
RAD_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Somebody is down. I heard it on the floor.

RAD_PEOPLE_RELAY_01.speaker: RAD
RAD_PEOPLE_RELAY_01.text: It is speaking again. Someone is counting on this line.

RAD_PEOPLE_RELAY_02.speaker: RAD
RAD_PEOPLE_RELAY_02.text: Same voice, same smile. Someone is counting on this line, and I do not like who.

RAD_PEOPLE_PING_01.speaker: RAD
RAD_PEOPLE_PING_01.text: Sweep done. They are there, there, and there. Keep your eyes up.

DES_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: DES
DES_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: Do not shout. I am not here. I was never here. I walked away from a column and a captain who wanted me to die tidily.

DES_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: DES
DES_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: I am nineteen. I want to see the spring. That is the whole of my ambition.

DES_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: DES
DES_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: Give me a rifle, and I will watch the stable door. I owe somebody, and it may as well be you.

DES_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: DES
DES_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: Right. Right, I have it. Nobody comes through that door while I am breathing.

DES_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: DES
DES_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: They are coming again. Stay low, please.

DES_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: DES
DES_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Someone is hit! Can anyone reach them?

DES_PEOPLE_COVER_01.speaker: DES
DES_PEOPLE_COVER_01.text: Contact at the door! I have them!

WID_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: WID
WID_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: The carters came down this road for forty years. My Josef was the last. He went out to the yard for his lamp, and did not come back.

WID_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: WID
WID_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: The road is shut with the snow, and with the other thing. Do not trust the road.

WID_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: WID
WID_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: His lamp hangs on the cart in the yard. Bring it to me, and I will draw the bolt on the side door.

WID_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: WID
WID_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: His lamp. Oh, Josef. Take the side door, it is yours for two rounds. I will not need it.

WID_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: WID
WID_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: It begins again. Sometimes I hear them on the stairs.

WID_PEOPLE_ROUND_02.speaker: WID
WID_PEOPLE_ROUND_02.text: Hush now. They go away if you do not answer them.

WID_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: WID
WID_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Someone is hurt, down there. Please, help them.

COU_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: COU
COU_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: Post for the villages, and a bicycle that died at the gate. I have been mending it an hour, and the dead keep coming up the road.

COU_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: COU
COU_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: I ride the whole district. I know every crate and every cache. For a little Scrip I will tell you what I saw.

COU_PEOPLE_TIP_01.speaker: COU
COU_PEOPLE_TIP_01.text: For two hundred. The crate is there, the one the soldiers left. I saw the lid lifted with my own eyes.

COU_PEOPLE_TIP_02.speaker: COU
COU_PEOPLE_TIP_02.text: A tip is a tip. Do not spend it all in one place.

COU_PEOPLE_BROKE_01.speaker: COU
COU_PEOPLE_BROKE_01.text: No money, no map. Come back when you have it.

COU_PEOPLE_ONCE_01.speaker: COU
COU_PEOPLE_ONCE_01.text: I told you already. I have one tip a round, and you have it.

COU_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: COU
COU_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: Another wave. I think I will push the bike.

COU_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: COU
COU_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Someone is down! I cannot leave the bike. I cannot!

AMM_COMP_TALK_01.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_TALK_01.text: Come to the shelf. Everything on it is written in the book, and the book is honest.

AMM_COMP_TRADE_01.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_TRADE_01.text: One refill from the stores. Fifteen hundred, all in the book.

AMM_COMP_TRADE_02.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_TRADE_02.text: A pack of grenades. I counted them twice.

AMM_COMP_TRADE_BROKE_01.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_TRADE_BROKE_01.text: The book does not balance. You are short.

AMM_COMP_TRADE_ONCE_01.speaker: AMM
AMM_COMP_TRADE_ONCE_01.text: Once a round, I said. The stores are not a well.

DUT_PERK_LEDGER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_LEDGER_01.text: Tastes like payday in a bad bar. I've had worse paydays.

PEG_PERK_LEDGER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_LEDGER_01.text: A lager that keeps books. [a pause] The War Office would have bought a thousand. The War Office bought worse, through me.

PEG_PERK_LEDGER_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_LEDGER_02.text: Twenty on the hundred. Someone fiddled the figures, and I like them.

DEA_PERK_LEDGER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_LEDGER_01.text: Ka-ching. Lord forgive me, that's a beautiful sound.

DEA_PERK_LEDGER_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_LEDGER_02.text: Machine says I'm solvent. Machine's the first one ever did.

WRN_PERK_LEDGER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_LEDGER_01.text: Cold, cheap, and it counts. Like the man who made it, probably.

WRN_PERK_LEDGER_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_LEDGER_02.text: A bell every time I earn. I will shoot the bell.

JAK_PERK_LEDGER_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_LEDGER_01.text: Fenske's beer. He always had the figures. He had ours too, under the floor.

JAK_PERK_LEDGER_02.speaker: JAK
JAK_PERK_LEDGER_02.text: Zahltag. We never had one. I will drink to the day we do.

OPR_PERK_TIER4_LEDGER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_PERK_TIER4_LEDGER_01.text: A dividend has been declared. The account thanks you for your continued engagement.

JES_BANK_GREET_M2_01.speaker: JES
JES_BANK_GREET_M2_01.text: Zahlstelle, Marinekasse Totenhafen. Thank God, a living face. Please speak quietly. The water carries.

JES_BANK_GREET_M2_02.speaker: JES
JES_BANK_GREET_M2_02.text: Deposits, withdrawals, nothing else. The Commandant ordered the pay window kept open until relieved. Nobody has relieved me.

JES_BANK_DEPOSIT_01.speaker: JES
JES_BANK_DEPOSIT_01.text: Entered. One per cent a round, the Navy's own rate. It is the only thing on this base that still pays on time.

JES_BANK_WITHDRAW_01.speaker: JES
JES_BANK_WITHDRAW_01.text: Your money, in full. Count it, please. I am not able to count just now.

JES_BANK_BROKE_01.speaker: JES
JES_BANK_BROKE_01.text: There is nothing entered under your name. I looked twice. A paymaster's mate does not look a third time.

JES_BANK_SCARED_01.speaker: JES
JES_BANK_SCARED_01.text: They are on the quay! On the quay! Shoot them, please, shoot them!

JES_BANK_SCARED_02.speaker: JES
JES_BANK_SCARED_02.text: Gott im Himmel. I am only the paymaster's mate!

JES_BANK_CLOSED_01.speaker: JES
JES_BANK_CLOSED_01.text: I may not open the strongbox just now. Orders. The Navy has regulations for the end of the world.

RUH_BANK_GREET_M4A_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_BANK_GREET_M4A_01.text: Lohnkasse, Werk Thalbach. Ilse Ruhland. The shift is gone and the pay is late, and I am still here. Please come to the window.

RUH_BANK_GREET_M4A_02.speaker: RUH
RUH_BANK_GREET_M4A_02.text: Good morning. I think it is morning. The savings book is open. Nobody has asked in three days.

RUH_BANK_GREET_M4B_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_BANK_GREET_M4B_01.text: It is me again! I put the cash box in the equipment locker when the siren went, and then the siren was the engines, and now I am very far up. Your book came with me.

RUH_BANK_GREET_M4B_02.speaker: RUH
RUH_BANK_GREET_M4B_02.text: Bordkasse, the quartermaster's locker. I know. I do not know what I am doing on an aeroplane either. Please do not open the hatches.

RUH_BANK_DEPOSIT_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_BANK_DEPOSIT_01.text: Entered in your book. One per cent a round. I have always liked a book that balances.

RUH_BANK_WITHDRAW_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_BANK_WITHDRAW_01.text: Here is your money. It is only paper. Everything here is only paper now.

RUH_BANK_BROKE_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_BANK_BROKE_01.text: Your book is empty. I am sorry. I would put something in it myself, if I had anything left.

RUH_BANK_SCARED_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_BANK_SCARED_01.text: They are coming through the yard! Oh no, oh no, please!

RUH_BANK_SCARED_02.speaker: RUH
RUH_BANK_SCARED_02.text: I only do the wages! I only do the wages!

RUH_BANK_CLOSED_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_BANK_CLOSED_01.text: The cash window is closed. Works regulation. Even now.

PRU_BANK_GREET_M4C_01.speaker: PRU
PRU_BANK_GREET_M4C_01.text: Range Finance Office, Private Pruitt. Hey, you're alive. Hold on, let me find the form. Everybody's accounts survived. The rest of the base, not so much.

PRU_BANK_GREET_M4C_02.speaker: PRU
PRU_BANK_GREET_M4C_02.text: I stayed at the desk. Sergeant Marchetti said somebody had to keep the books, and then she locked the cage. We're neighbors. She says she's fine.

PRU_BANK_DEPOSIT_01.speaker: PRU
PRU_BANK_DEPOSIT_01.text: Credited. One percent a round, per the Finance Department. I'm, I'm not sure the Finance Department is still there.

PRU_BANK_WITHDRAW_01.speaker: PRU
PRU_BANK_WITHDRAW_01.text: Cash on the barrelhead. Count it, please. My hands won't hold still.

PRU_BANK_BROKE_01.speaker: PRU
PRU_BANK_BROKE_01.text: Nothing in your account. I checked the ledger twice. It's a very clean ledger.

PRU_BANK_SCARED_01.speaker: PRU
PRU_BANK_SCARED_01.text: They're on the salt! They're on the salt, they're on the salt!

PRU_BANK_SCARED_02.speaker: PRU
PRU_BANK_SCARED_02.text: I'm just a finance clerk! I just fill out the forms!

PRU_BANK_CLOSED_01.speaker: PRU
PRU_BANK_CLOSED_01.text: Window's closed. Regulations. I know what it sounds like.

OPR_BANK_GREET_M4D_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BANK_GREET_M4D_01.text: Welcome to Accounts, valued customer. Your balance is held in the Provider's care, and has never been so well held.

OPR_BANK_GREET_M4D_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_BANK_GREET_M4D_02.text: Accounts is open. Accounts is always open. Please deposit, withdraw, or continue to engage.

OPR_BANK_DEPOSIT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BANK_DEPOSIT_01.text: Your deposit has been received. Retention improves every round. The Provider thanks you for your continued engagement.

OPR_BANK_WITHDRAW_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BANK_WITHDRAW_01.text: A withdrawal has been processed. We are sorry to see your balance leave. It will be welcome back.

OPR_BANK_BROKE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BANK_BROKE_01.text: Your balance is zero. A zero balance is a retained balance. We have noted your enthusiasm.

OPR_BANK_SCARED_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BANK_SCARED_01.text: A disturbance has been logged at the Accounts window. Please remain a valued customer.

OPR_BANK_SCARED_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_BANK_SCARED_02.text: Please do not feed the retained. They are already well fed.

OPR_BANK_CLOSED_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BANK_CLOSED_01.text: Accounts is not available under your current plan. We regret nothing.

DUT_BONUS_LEDGER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BONUS_LEDGER_01.text: Every hit rings a bell now. [a pause] Something's counting. I could do without being counted.

PEG_BONUS_LEDGER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BONUS_LEDGER_01.text: My earnings are running a fifth over. I have decided not to audit it.

DEA_BONUS_LEDGER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BONUS_LEDGER_01.text: A little extra in the tin every time. The Lord provides, and so does the lager.

WRN_BONUS_LEDGER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BONUS_LEDGER_01.text: It's counting for me. Fine. I count too.

OPR_BOSS_PAUL_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_PAUL_01.text: Oh my! A {gentleman} from overseas has broken into the {studio}! Do give him a warm welcome!

OPR_BOSS_PAUL_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_PAUL_02.text: Ladies and gentlemen, our {strongest} account! Tremendous {tolerance}. Simply tremendous!

OPR_BOSS_PAUL_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_PAUL_03.text: Back by popular {demand}! And bigger than {ever}!

OPR_BOSS_PAUL_RAGE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_PAUL_RAGE_01.text: Oh dear. He's gone right {off} the chart. We'll need a bigger {chart}!

OPR_BOSS_PAUL_LEFT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_PAUL_LEFT_01.text: And he's off to find his {friends}! Aren't we {all}.

OPR_BOSS_PAUL_DEAD_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_PAUL_DEAD_01.text: [three seconds of dead air] ...Maximum dose... {recorded}. [and, very quietly, a splice from some other broadcast] {Well done.}

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_01.text: Attention, valued customers: the night {shift} is now on duty. Please have your {papers} ready.

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_02.text: Our {watchman} has never missed a night. Not {one}. Do try not to be {noticed}!

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_03.text: Shift {change}! Three for the price of {one}!

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_04.text: We are experiencing a brief {outage}. Please remain where you can be {seen}.

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_QUAR_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_QUAR_01.text: A {customer} has been taken in for {review}.

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_LEFT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_LEFT_01.text: The watch is... {rescheduled}. He'll be by again. He's always {by}.

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_DEAD_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_DEAD_01.text: The night watch has clocked {out}! And dawn is... {closer} than you think.

PAU_LAND_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAND_01.text: [a roar with a man's voice inside it]

PAU_CALM_02.speaker: PAU
PAU_CALM_02.text: Gimme your pack. I got it. I GOT it.

PAU_FLEE_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_FLEE_01.text: DON'T YOU RUN! Nobody runs out on the squad!

PAU_ANGRY_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_ANGRY_01.text: You're not my guys. YOU'RE NOT MY GUYS!

PAU_BERSERK_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_BERSERK_01.text: [a roar, and inside it] WHERE ARE THEY?!

PAU_GRAB_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_GRAB_01.text: GOT you. Who sent you? WHERE ARE THEY?

PAU_CUP_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_CUP_01.text: [quietly, to the cup] ...coffee's on me, fellas. Whole pot. ...Fellas?

PAU_LAST_DUT_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_DUT_01.text: ...Hey. Sarge. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

PAU_LAST_PEG_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_PEG_01.text: ...Hey. Ma'am. You're English? Huh. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

PAU_LAST_DEA_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_DEA_01.text: ...Hey. Grease on your hands. Good man. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

PAU_LAST_WRN_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_WRN_01.text: ...Hey. You're not one of them. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

PAU_LAST_BLT_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_BLT_01.text: ...Hey. Kid. Nice hammer. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

PAU_LAST_VEN_01.speaker: PAU
PAU_LAST_VEN_01.text: ...Hey. Mister. You look like a man who keeps his word. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.

SLN_ARRIVE_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_ARRIVE_01.text: [keys, then a calm voice] Evening. Don't mind me. I'm only on my rounds.

SLN_WRITE_02.speaker: SLN
SLN_WRITE_02.text: [writing] ...stood very still. Thought I wouldn't see.

SLN_MIRROR_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_MIRROR_01.text: You stop, I stop. That's only manners.

SLN_SWEEP_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_SWEEP_01.text: Let's have a look at you.

SLN_ROOM_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_ROOM_01.text: Everyone has a page. Find yours.

SLN_ROOM_02.speaker: SLN
SLN_ROOM_02.text: It's three o'clock. It's always three o'clock in here.

SLN_DARK_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_DARK_01.text: Lights out. Last round of the night.

SLN_BOOK_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_BOOK_01.condition: the book shot from his hands

SLN_LEAVE_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_LEAVE_01.text: Rounds aren't finished. I'll be back this way.

SLN_DEATH_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_DEATH_01.text: ...Shift's over. Someone else has the watch now.

DUT_PAUL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PAUL_01.text: That's an American voice on the PA. [a pause] ...That's an American VOICE. Yinz hear that? That's one of ours.

DUT_PAUL_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_PAUL_02.text: Big fella's wearing dog tags. Ours. [quiet] Aw, hell. Aw, hell, what'd they do to you, buddy.

DUT_PAUL_RAGE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PAUL_RAGE_01.text: The bottles on his back! Shoot the bottles, calm him down!

DUT_PAUL_DEAD_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PAUL_DEAD_01.text: Every outfit's got one. The big one. The one who carries you. [a pause] Nobody carried him.

DUT_PAUL_CUP_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PAUL_CUP_01.text: [turning it over] ...I'll buy the round, Paul. I'll buy every round.

PEG_PAUL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PAUL_01.text: American. A private, engineers, what's left of the sleeve says so. [a pause] They did this to one of ours. They dosed him and wrote it down.

PEG_PAUL_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_PAUL_02.text: The bottles on his back are feeding him. Break them and he cools.

PEG_PAUL_DEAD_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PAUL_DEAD_01.text: Note it. Private Paul. Carried his share. [a pause] Somebody in London ought to read that. I shall make certain they do.

PEG_PAUL_CUP_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PAUL_CUP_01.text: [quietly] I'll see it gets home, Private. You have my word.

DEA_PAUL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PAUL_01.text: That's a soldier. That's a GI. Lord have mercy, what'd they pump into him?

DEA_PAUL_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_PAUL_02.text: Easy, big man. Easy. Nobody's leaving you.

DEA_PAUL_PRAYER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PAUL_PRAYER_01.text: Lord, this man carried his brothers when they couldn't carry themselves. Carry him now. He's done his share. Amen.
DEA_PAUL_PRAYER_01.condition: after the fall: the unique kneel (tier 2)

DEA_PAUL_CUP_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PAUL_CUP_01.text: [softly] I'll keep it shined for you.

WRN_PAUL_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PAUL_01.text: They dosed him to see when he would die. He would not die. ...I know this file. I know this kind of file.

WRN_PAUL_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_PAUL_02.text: The back of his neck, when he turns. The line goes in there.

WRN_PAUL_NAME_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PAUL_NAME_01.condition: after the fall: writes in her notebook (tier 2)

WRN_PAUL_CUP_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PAUL_CUP_01.text: [quiet] I will carry it. He carried enough.

DUT_SLENDER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SLENDER_01.text: Tall fella with a lantern. Just watching. [quiet] Writing. I've been watched by enough men with clipboards.

DUT_SLENDER_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SLENDER_02.text: He's writing. He's writing about ME.

DUT_QUARANTINE_01.speaker: DUT
