DUT_QUARANTINE_01.text: Room full of books and a clock that don't move. [breathing heavily] ...I'm out. I'm out. Don't let him take me in there again.

PEG_SLENDER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SLENDER_01.text: He only bleeds in the light. Bring him to the floodlights. [a pause] Carefully.

PEG_SLENDER_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SLENDER_02.text: Three of him. Watch the lanterns. The steady one's real.

PEG_QUARANTINE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_QUARANTINE_01.text: A clerk's office with no clerk. [a breath] I've been questioned in worse rooms. Never by anything like that.

PEG_SLENDER_DEAD_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SLENDER_DEAD_01.text: A man who kept his post when everyone else ran. I've known worse men in better uniforms.

DEA_SLENDER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SLENDER_01.text: He's just doing his rounds. Lord, he's been doing his rounds this whole time.

DEA_SLENDER_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SLENDER_02.condition: his keys fall silent near Deacon

DEA_QUARANTINE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_QUARANTINE_01.text: Clock stopped at three. Mama always said nothing good happens after three.

DEA_SLENDER_DEAD_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SLENDER_DEAD_01.text: Rest easy, watchman. We'll keep the lights on.

WRN_SLENDER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SLENDER_01.text: He stops when I stop. He turns when I turn. ...Good. I can count on him.

WRN_SLENDER_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SLENDER_02.text: The book! Shoot the book out of his hands!

WRN_QUARANTINE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_QUARANTINE_01.text: My page was neat. He has better handwriting than me.

WRN_SLENDER_DEAD_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SLENDER_DEAD_01.text: He wrote everything down. Every hour. ...I understand him.

RADIO_UBOAT_01.speaker: UBR
RADIO_UBOAT_01.text: [radio] To all boats. Harbour Commander Totenhafen. The harbour is closed. I say again: the harbour is closed.
RADIO_UBOAT_01.speech: An alle Boote. Hier Hafenkommandant Totenhafen. Der Hafen ist gesperrt. Ich wiederhole: Der Hafen ist gesperrt.

RADIO_UBOAT_02.speaker: UBR
RADIO_UBOAT_02.text: [radio] U-1047, report your position. U-1047, come in, please.
RADIO_UBOAT_02.speech: U tausendsiebenundvierzig, melden Sie Ihre Position. U tausendsiebenundvierzig, bitte kommen.

RADIO_UBOAT_03.speaker: UBR
RADIO_UBOAT_03.text: [radio] Convoy in grid square A-N four-zero-one-seven. Destroyer in sight. We are diving. Out.
RADIO_UBOAT_03.speech: Geleitzug im Quadrat Anton Nordpol vierzig siebzehn. Zerstörer in Sicht. Wir tauchen. Ende.

RADIO_UBOAT_04.speaker: UBR
RADIO_UBOAT_04.text: [radio] Relayed from Basel, for U-1047: the cargo sails on the next tide. No queries.
RADIO_UBOAT_04.speech: Weitergeleitet aus Basel, an U tausendsiebenundvierzig: Die Ladung läuft mit der nächsten Tide aus. Keine Rückfragen.

RADIO_UBOAT_05.speaker: UBR
RADIO_UBOAT_05.text: [radio] This is U-1047, the chief engineer. The captain has gone down to the pump deck. He is not coming back up.
RADIO_UBOAT_05.speech: Hier U tausendsiebenundvierzig, der leitende Ingenieur. Der Kommandant ist zum Pumpendeck hinunter. Er kommt nicht wieder herauf.

RADIO_UBOAT_06.speaker: UBR
RADIO_UBOAT_06.text: [radio] Weather for Totenhafen: wind north-west, force nine. Sea state seven. Spring tide in the night. Out.
RADIO_UBOAT_06.speech: Wetter für Totenhafen: Wind Nordwest, Stärke neun. Seegang sieben. Springflut in der Nacht. Ende.

OPR_RAID_M2_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_RAID_M2_01.text: [the tannoy rattles with every hit, the bulbs swinging] Oh, now really. Bombers? Tonight? This was not on the {schedule}. Somebody up there has not read the timetable, and I shall be writing to their superiors.

OPR_M4D_TERM_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERM_01.text: The terminator is now passing over you. Please remain where you are. Darkness is included in your {plan}.

OPR_M4D_TERM_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERM_02.text: Another part of the relay has entered its evening. Your suit heater will do its best. That is all we {promise}.

OPR_M4D_TERM_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERM_03.text: We are experiencing scheduled darkness. Valued customers may notice a slight {chill}.

OPR_M4D_TERM_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERM_04.text: The day is ending in this sector. It will end in every sector. We planned it that {way}.

OPR_M4D_TERM_05.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERM_05.text: Cold is a temporary condition. Retention is {permanent}.

OPR_M4D_TERM_06.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERM_06.text: The whole relay is in shadow now. It's quieter like this. Don't you {think}?

OPR_M4D_GLARE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_GLARE_01.text: The Sun is unfiltered out here. Your visor is provided free of charge. Please lower {it}.

OPR_M4D_HEATERS_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_HEATERS_01.text: Heaters engaged. Thank you for upgrading your comfort. The difference will appear on your {statement}.

OPR_M4D_PAD_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_PAD_01.text: Launch plates are for authorised personnel. You are now authorised. Please enjoy the {view}.

OPR_M4D_ORBIT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_ORBIT_01.text: That customer has been relocated. Off-site. Permanently. We will update the {records}.

OPR_M4D_ORBIT_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_ORBIT_02.text: Another one leaving us. We never lose a customer. We only... {misplace} them.

OPR_M4D_ORBIT_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_ORBIT_03.text: Please stop throwing our inventory into {space}.

OPR_M4D_METEOR_WARN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_METEOR_WARN_01.text: Attention. Scheduled maintenance will begin in the yard in ten seconds. Please shelter in a module. Maintenance is not {optional}.

OPR_M4D_METEOR_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_METEOR_01.text: Maintenance is in progress. Debris is part of the {service}.

OPR_M4D_METEOR_END_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_METEOR_END_01.text: Maintenance is complete. The yard is safe again. {Statistically}.

OPR_M4D_SHAFT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_SHAFT_01.text: The vent is open. Anything standing on it will be returned to {sender}.

OPR_M4D_EARTH_DIM_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_EARTH_DIM_01.text: The signal is weaker over the Atlantic. That is a... temporary {fault}.

OPR_M4D_EARTH_DIM_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_EARTH_DIM_02.text: Stop. Stop that. You are cancelling. Nobody... nobody {cancels}.

WRN_M4D_EARTH_DIM_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_EARTH_DIM_01.text: Look at the Earth. The violet. It's pulling back.

WRN_M4D_EARTH_DIM_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_EARTH_DIM_02.text: London is dark again. Good. Dark is good.

WRN_M4D_EARTH_SPREAD_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_EARTH_SPREAD_01.text: It's spreading over the Earth. Every round, a little more.

JAK_M4D_CONSOLE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4D_CONSOLE_01.text: Read them all out. Every name. In the mine we said the names at the end of every shift. Nobody gets left down here.

OGP_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: OGP
OGP_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: Pohl. Obergefreiter Pohl, wireless operator, the Kranich. They hung me up with the others, and I... didn't go to sleep.

OGP_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: OGP
OGP_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: Riedl and Haas are in the next bays. Don't try to wake them. I tried. I don't think they can be woken.

OGP_PEOPLE_TALK_03.speaker: OGP
OGP_PEOPLE_TALK_03.text: I kept the set warm the whole way up. Nobody answered. Only the voice, and it only ever said thank you.

OGP_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: OGP
OGP_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: My tag is on the hanger. Will you take it to their console and read it in? Out loud. So it says Pohl. Not bay six.

OGP_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: OGP
OGP_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: Pohl. That's right. That's my name. ...Thank you.

OGP_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: OGP
OGP_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: They're coming down the aisles again. I'll keep still. Mind the racks.

OGP_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: OGP
OGP_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Get up. Please get up. They'll put you on a hanger.

PA_M4B_WING_01.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_WING_01.text: Achtung. Backbordfläche beschädigt. Sicherungsleine benutzen. (Attention. Port wing damaged. Use the safety line.)

PA_M4B_DECOMP_01.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_DECOMP_01.text: Achtung! Druckabfall im Rumpf. Festhalten! (Attention! Pressure drop in the hull. Hold on!)

PA_M4B_POWER_01.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_POWER_01.text: Hilfssammelschiene: ein. Alle Stationen, melden. (Auxiliary bus: on. All stations, report.)

PA_M4B_BAYDOORS_01.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_BAYDOORS_01.text: Bombenklappen öffnen. Abstand halten. (Bay doors opening. Stand clear.)

PA_M4B_LASTCALL_01.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_LASTCALL_01.text: Hier Kranich, Bordmechaniker Riedl. Testflug, zweite Nacht. Die Besatzung meldet... die Besatzung meldet nicht. (Kranich here, flight engineer Riedl. Test flight, second night. The crew reports... the crew does not report.)

PA_M4B_LASTCALL_02.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_LASTCALL_02.text: Haas an Riedl. Da sind Leute im Werk, die wir nicht kennen. Sie zählen uns. (Haas to Riedl. There are people in the works we don't know. They are counting us.)

PA_M4B_LASTCALL_03.speaker: PA
PA_M4B_LASTCALL_03.text: Pohl. Wenn jemand das hört: wir sind nicht verloren gegangen. Wir wurden abgeholt. Ende. (Pohl. If anyone hears this: we were not lost. We were collected. Out.)

DEA_M4B_WING_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_WING_01.text: The panel's gone. That's a way out onto the wing. In flight. Clip in or don't {go}.

PEG_M4B_WING_FALL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4B_WING_FALL_01.text: Note to self: clip in. Underline {clip}.

DEA_M4B_WING_FALL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_WING_FALL_01.text: Lord, I saw the sea. Haul me in, I'm {done}.

WRN_M4B_WING_FALL_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4B_WING_FALL_01.text: I am not writing that one {down}.

DUT_M4B_ROSTER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4B_ROSTER_01.text: Three names on the roster, rubbed out. Write 'em back in, {somebody}.

PEG_M4B_ROSTER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4B_ROSTER_01.text: Riedl, Haas, Pohl. The roster had them in pencil. Someone took an eraser to three {men}.

DEA_M4B_ROSTER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_ROSTER_01.text: There. Their names are back where they belong. The tape deck's got a reel with the same three {names}.

WRN_M4B_ROSTER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4B_ROSTER_01.text: Riedl. Haas. Pohl. I'm writing them back in. In ink this {time}.

WRN_M4B_LASTCALL_REPLY_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4B_LASTCALL_REPLY_01.text: Collected. Like my brother. They knew, at the end. They {knew}.

RUH_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: I was not supposed to be on this aeroplane. I was supposed to be counting the wages. I am still counting the {wages}.

RUH_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: RUH
RUH_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: The cash box is the Werk's. The ledger is the Werk's. I am, apparently, also the {Werk's}.

RUH_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: The Bordkasse's ledger went forward with the paymaster's satchel. The flight deck. Bring it to me and I can make the sums come out {honest}.

RUH_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: Thank you. There: a fifth over, on every page. It was never my arithmetic. Take this, it was owed to {somebody}.

RUH_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: They are coming up from the bay again. I will stay behind the {counter}.

RUH_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: RUH
RUH_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Someone is down! Get them up, get them {up}!

DUT_M4B_FORMATION_DOWN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4B_FORMATION_DOWN_01.text: One of the formation's going down. Burning all the way. [quiet] Nobody's getting out of {that}. ...Nobody was in it. Tell me nobody was in it.

PEG_M4B_FORMATION_DOWN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4B_FORMATION_DOWN_01.text: Flak got the one on our wing. [a pause] That could have been {us}. One rather wishes it had been something that simple.

DEA_M4B_FORMATION_DOWN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4B_FORMATION_DOWN_01.text: Lord keep them. Whoever's in it. If anybody {is}.

WRN_M4B_FORMATION_DOWN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4B_FORMATION_DOWN_01.text: Empty, I bet. Like this one. Flying for {nobody}.

RDL_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: RDL
RDL_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: Engine room here. Riedl. Who is that on the line? Report, please.

RDL_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: RDL
RDL_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: This is a test flight. Only a test flight. The crew is to report to their stations.

RDL_PEOPLE_TALK_03.speaker: RDL
RDL_PEOPLE_TALK_03.text: Haas? Pohl? The kettle is still warm. Where have you gone?

RDL_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: RDL
RDL_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: The engine is singing again. I cannot shut it off. I have tried.

RDL_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: RDL
RDL_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Is someone hurt back there? Report!

RDL_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: RDL
RDL_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: My engine log. I left it in the galley with my coffee. Read me the last entry, would you? I cannot leave the engine.

RDL_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: RDL
RDL_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: Crew: provided. Provided by whom. Thank you. I will listen to the wing for you.

RDL_PEOPLE_PING_01.speaker: RDL
RDL_PEOPLE_PING_01.text: Something in the port wing. Several. Moving forward. I can hear them on the spar.

WDL_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: WDL
WDL_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: Down here, quick. My wife and the girls are behind the blanket. They don't need to see you.

WDL_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: WDL
WDL_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: Twelve years I riveted wings in Hall One. Never once asked where they were going.

WDL_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: WDL
WDL_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: The stove's dead and the little one's coughing. There's coal spilled by the platform in the yard. One sack. Bring it and I lift the bar on the side door.

WDL_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: WDL
WDL_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: Coal. Thank you. Here, the side door, I'll take the bar off. Use it.

WDL_PEOPLE_DOOR_01.speaker: WDL
WDL_PEOPLE_DOOR_01.text: Side door's open. In through the cellar and out the other side, if they're on your heels.

WDL_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: WDL
WDL_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: Sirens again. Stay low, girls. Stay low.

WDL_PEOPLE_ROUND_02.speaker: WDL
WDL_PEOPLE_ROUND_02.text: They walk past the window now. They don't stop. Not yet.

WDL_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: WDL
WDL_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Get up! Somebody get him up!

BRK_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: BRK
BRK_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: Thirty-one years on this yard. The last train I let in, I wish I'd sent back.

BRK_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: BRK
BRK_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: Lead boxes from the coast. Heavy as sin. They hummed in the cold.

BRK_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: BRK
BRK_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: There's one train still on the line, an ammunition run nobody stopped. The signal's at danger. Pull the lever by the goods shed and she'll come in.

BRK_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: BRK
BRK_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: Signal's off. She comes in when she comes. I'll see the crates get to you.

BRK_PEOPLE_TRAIN_01.speaker: BRK
BRK_PEOPLE_TRAIN_01.text: There she is. A crate off the second wagon, in the yard. Take it.

BRK_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: BRK
BRK_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: Hear that? Rails are cold. Nothing moves tonight but them.

BRK_PEOPLE_ROUND_02.speaker: BRK
BRK_PEOPLE_ROUND_02.text: Keep off the line. Old habit.

OPR_M4A_RAID_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_RAID_01.text: Attention, valued staff. An unscheduled delivery is arriving from above. Please proceed to the {cellars}.

OPR_M4A_RAID_WARN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_RAID_WARN_01.text: Assembly Hall Two is undergoing an unplanned restructuring. Please vacate the area. You have ten {seconds}.

OPR_M4A_RAID_DOWN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_RAID_DOWN_01.text: Restructuring complete. A new route to the apron has been {provided}. Free of charge.

OPR_M4A_RAID_CLEAR_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4A_RAID_CLEAR_01.text: All clear. The fires are a {feature}. Please enjoy them responsibly.

DUT_M4A_RAID_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4A_RAID_01.text: Roof's down in Hall Two. We go round by the hole they made.

PEG_M4A_RAID_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4A_RAID_01.text: The bombers did us a favour. There's a breach through to the test stands.

DEA_M4A_RAID_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4A_RAID_01.text: Lord, that was close. Nobody under it. Good.

WRN_M4A_RAID_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4A_RAID_01.text: Old door's buried. New hole, west side. Move.

OPR_TIDE_SPRING_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_TIDE_SPRING_01.text: Spring tide! The harbour authority regrets the inconvenience. The harbour authority is {me}. Keep to the piers.

OPR_TIDE_SPRING_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_TIDE_SPRING_02.text: The moon has filed a complaint, and the aprons are going under. Stand on something {tall}.

OPR_TIDE_SPRING_WARN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_TIDE_SPRING_WARN_01.text: Shipping forecast, special bulletin. Spring tide {next round}. Sea state: very hungry.

OPR_PUMP_CRANK_START_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_PUMP_CRANK_START_01.text: Manual pumping. How quaint. Thirty seconds of honest {labour}, then.

OPR_PUMP_CRANK_DONE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_PUMP_CRANK_DONE_01.text: The pumps are pulling. The sea will be back. It is {very} punctual.

OPR_BALLAST_LOAD_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_BALLAST_LOAD_02.text: Another unit on the hook. Five hundred Scrip. You see? {Cooperation} pays.

OPR_BALLAST_DUMP_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_BALLAST_DUMP_02.text: Overboard. I'll note it in your file. In {red}.

DUT_BALLAST_LOAD_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BALLAST_LOAD_01.text: [quiet] That's a man in there. Was. Easy with him.

PEG_BALLAST_LOAD_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BALLAST_LOAD_01.text: Crane's got it. Don't ask me to feel good about it.

DEA_BALLAST_LOAD_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BALLAST_LOAD_01.text: Lord, keep him. Wherever they're taking him.

DUT_BALLAST_DUMP_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BALLAST_DUMP_01.text: Down you go, friend. Better the sea than them.

DEA_BALLAST_DUMP_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BALLAST_DUMP_01.text: Lord, forgive me, that's the only burial they get.

WRN_BALLAST_DUMP_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BALLAST_DUMP_01.text: Rest easy. Nobody's selling you now.

PEG_BALLAST_DUMP_THIRD_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BALLAST_DUMP_THIRD_01.text: That's three. That's enough to make it a choice.

DUT_WONDER_UNDERTOW_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_WONDER_UNDERTOW_01.text: A fishing pole. For what's down there.

PEG_WONDER_UNDERTOW_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_WONDER_UNDERTOW_01.text: Pressure's good. Don't point the sharp end at me.

DEA_WONDER_UNDERTOW_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_WONDER_UNDERTOW_01.text: Lord, it's humming. They all hum.

WRN_WONDER_UNDERTOW_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_WONDER_UNDERTOW_01.text: Line and hook. I was taught the same with a rifle.

OPR_SEARCHLIGHT_ON_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SEARCHLIGHT_ON_01.text: The tower light is manned. Do try not to blind the {customers}.

KLH_CARGO_01.speaker: KLH
KLH_CARGO_01.text: Die Fracht bleibt hier. (The cargo stays here.)

KLH_BRECHT_01.speaker: KLH
KLH_BRECHT_01.text: Brecht… du hast es aufgeschrieben. (Brecht… you wrote it down.)

KLH_DEATH_01.speaker: KLH
KLH_DEATH_01.text: Dann fahrt. Fahrt sie raus. (Then sail. Take her out.)

OPR_BOSS_KIELHOLER_SPAWN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_KIELHOLER_SPAWN_01.text: A retained captain is surfacing in the pen hall. Kapitänleutnant Lenz. He has {opinions} about the cargo. Please don't share them.

OPR_BOSS_KIELHOLER_DEATH_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_KIELHOLER_DEATH_01.text: Captain Lenz has resigned his command. Collect the key, please. The boat is company property. So is the {cargo}.

OPR_KIELHOLER_GRAB_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_KIELHOLER_GRAB_01.text: The harbour is reclaiming personnel at the pier edges. Personnel are {advised} to resist.

DUT_BOSS_KIELHOLER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BOSS_KIELHOLER_01.text: That's her captain. Went down with her and he's still standing watch.

DUT_BOSS_KIELHOLER_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_BOSS_KIELHOLER_02.text: Rest easy, skipper. We'll take her from here.

PEG_BOSS_KIELHOLER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BOSS_KIELHOLER_01.text: Diving dress, captain's cuffs. That's Lenz. [a pause] The man who opened a coffin and wouldn't sail. He knew what the dust was for.

PEG_BOSS_KIELHOLER_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_BOSS_KIELHOLER_02.text: He said take her out. All right, Kapitän. We will.

DEA_BOSS_KIELHOLER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BOSS_KIELHOLER_01.text: Lord, he's still guarding that boat. Let's give the man his rest.

DEA_BOSS_KIELHOLER_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_BOSS_KIELHOLER_02.text: Go on home, Captain. Your watch is over.

WRN_BOSS_KIELHOLER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BOSS_KIELHOLER_01.text: Behind the helmet glass. Same violet. Break the glass, aim for the light.

WRN_BOSS_KIELHOLER_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_BOSS_KIELHOLER_02.text: He let go at the end. Didn't fight it.

RAD_M2_CODE_01.speaker: RAD
RAD_M2_CODE_01.text: [radio, German] Hafen, Hafen. Spruch eins von drei. Gruppe folgt. Ende. (Harbour, harbour. Message one of three. Group follows. Out.)

RAD_M2_CODE_02.speaker: RAD
RAD_M2_CODE_02.text: [radio, German] Hafen, Hafen. Spruch zwei von drei. Gruppe folgt. Ende. (Harbour, harbour. Message two of three. Group follows. Out.)

RAD_M2_CODE_03.speaker: RAD
RAD_M2_CODE_03.text: [radio, German] Hafen, Hafen. Spruch drei von drei. Gruppe folgt. Ende. (Harbour, harbour. Message three of three. Group follows. Out.)

OPR_LF_START_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_START_01.text: The pumps are running and someone has been reading the boat's paperwork. That boat is {scheduled}. I'd prefer you didn't.

OPR_LF_HINT_HOOK_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_HINT_HOOK_01.text: Housekeeping. The crane on the east apron is still waiting for its ballast. One lead box off the pallets, onto the hook, and the pumps may {run}.
OPR_LF_HINT_HOOK_01.condition: Map 2, round 2+, the crane hook still empty (LetzteFahrtGuide)

OPR_LF_HINT_HOOK_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_HINT_HOOK_02.text: The pumps are still dry, I see. The cargo will not carry {itself}. A coffin. The crane hook. It isn't difficult.
OPR_LF_HINT_HOOK_02.condition: Map 2, round 4+, the crane hook still empty (LetzteFahrtGuide)

OPR_LF_HINT_RADIO_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_HINT_RADIO_01.text: Three radios in this harbour are keying the same traffic. The cannery, the workshop, the boat. Please don't {listen} to them.
OPR_LF_HINT_RADIO_01.condition: Map 2, after the power, no radio heard yet (LetzteFahrtGuide)

OPR_LF_HINT_STAIRS_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_HINT_STAIRS_01.text: A reminder. Ballast goes on the crane. Not over the side at the sea stairs. Never over the {side}.
OPR_LF_HINT_STAIRS_01.condition: Map 2, after the power, Letzte Fahrt's three dumps not done (LetzteFahrtGuide)

OPR_LF_HINT_LOG_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_HINT_LOG_01.text: Should anyone find loose pages from a captain's log, they are company property. The cabin, the radio room, the crane office, the pump deck. Hand them {in}.
OPR_LF_HINT_LOG_01.condition: Map 2, round 5+, no log page found yet (LetzteFahrtGuide)

OPR_LF_CIPHER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_CIPHER_01.text: The teletype is talking to strangers again. Please disregard anything it prints. Especially the {depth}.

OPR_LF_CIPHER_WRONG_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_CIPHER_WRONG_01.text: Wrong setting. The machine is {embarrassed} for you.

OPR_LF_CIPHER_WRONG_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_CIPHER_WRONG_02.text: No. Try listening to the radios. They repeat themselves. {Everything} here does.

OPR_LF_DIESEL_START_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_DIESEL_START_01.text: Unauthorised maintenance on a scheduled vessel. I'm writing this {down}.

OPR_LF_DIESEL_START_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_DIESEL_START_02.text: That is company machinery. You are not on the {maintenance} roster.

DEA_LF_DIESELS_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_LF_DIESELS_01.text: There she is. Listen to that. Somebody built that to be quiet. Now she's loud.

DEA_LF_LOG_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_LF_LOG_01.text: Somebody built that boat to be quiet. I'd like to hear it loud, once. Brecht wrote down how.

OPR_LF_KEY_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_KEY_01.text: That key was assigned to a captain. The captain has been {reassigned}. I'll allow it. Once.

OPR_LF_CURTAIN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_CURTAIN_01.text: The curtain is open and the weather is coming in. That boat goes where the {schedule} says. Doesn't it?

OPR_LF_SAIL_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_LF_SAIL_01.text: She's moving. Excellent. Do keep to the {charted} route. The one I charted.

PET_LF_HELM_01.speaker: PET
PET_LF_HELM_01.text: I said I'd never take a boat out of here at night. I lied to the wrong people.

PET_LF_TRAPPED_01.speaker: PET
PET_LF_TRAPPED_01.text: Up here! The stair's the only dry thing left. Give me something that shoots and I'll hold the tower.

DUT_LF_CUT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_LF_CUT_01.text: Everybody below. Hatches shut. Yinz too, down the ladder. [quiet] Let's give them the deep water. Let the sea keep what the Reich was selling.

PEG_LF_TELEGRAM_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_LF_TELEGRAM_01.text: Basel. Hale. On the next tide. [a pause] My orders said retrieve the samples. The sickness, the glass, the tokens. ...I'm keeping this instead.

JES_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: JES
JES_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: Zahlmeistersmaat Jessen. The window is open, the books are kept. I was told to keep the pay window until relieved, and I keep what I am told.

JES_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: JES
JES_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: The harbour master drew the last pay before he went down to the pens. He took the ledger page with him, and I cannot close the week without it.

JES_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: JES
JES_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: The harbour master's ledger page. He left it in his hut on the quay, by the chart. Bring it to me and I can close the week, and pay out what is owed.

JES_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: JES
JES_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: The page. Thank you. ...There. The week is closed, the sums agree. What the harbour owes you, I can pay. Count it, please.

JES_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: JES
JES_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: They are on the apron again. I shall stay at the window. The window is my post.

JES_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: JES
JES_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Somebody is down out there! Get them up, I cannot leave the strongbox!

JES_PEOPLE_REACT_BALLAST_01.speaker: JES
JES_PEOPLE_REACT_BALLAST_01.text: You put the Navy's cargo over the side. Three units. I have entered it as lost at sea. ...I did not enter who lost it.

JES_PEOPLE_REACT_KEY_01.speaker: JES
JES_PEOPLE_REACT_KEY_01.text: That is the Kapitaenleutnant's key. He signed for her in this book. If she sails, I shall sign her out. It is the last thing in this port that can still be done properly.

HRM_PEOPLE_TALK_01.speaker: HRM
HRM_PEOPLE_TALK_01.text: Night shift, line two. When the doors were chained we were still on the line. I got under the clerk's desk. The others ran for the pens. ...Don't go down to the pens.

HRM_PEOPLE_TALK_02.speaker: HRM
HRM_PEOPLE_TALK_02.text: Seventy-one hours and five Scrip to show for it. My boy is up in the town with my mother. If the bell rings up there, they are alive. Listen for it.

HRM_PEOPLE_ASK_01.speaker: HRM
HRM_PEOPLE_ASK_01.text: The lamp from the infirmary. The nurse kept a storm lantern by the end cot. With a light I can see the hall, and I know every sound in it. Bring it and I will tell you where they are.

HRM_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.speaker: HRM
HRM_PEOPLE_THANKS_01.text: Thank you. Keep your head down a moment. ...Hear that? The belt rattles when they cross it. There. And there.

HRM_PEOPLE_PING_01.speaker: HRM
HRM_PEOPLE_PING_01.text: Quiet now. Listen. The line is talking. They are coming along the belt, and from the brine tanks.

HRM_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.speaker: HRM
HRM_PEOPLE_ROUND_01.text: They are coming through the hall again. I will keep still. I am very good at keeping still.

HRM_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.speaker: HRM
HRM_PEOPLE_DOWN_01.text: Someone is down on the floor! Get them up, please, get them up!

JAK_M2_FLOOD_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M2_FLOOD_01.text: The water is coming in. In the mine we ran from water too. ...Only there was never anywhere to run to. Here there are stairs. Use them.

JAK_M2_SAIL_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M2_SAIL_01.text: A boat. I am on a boat. ...Marta would not believe it. Hania would. Hold on to something, the sea is not a coal wagon.

SER_LZS_01.speaker: SER
SER_LZS_01.text: I won't give you the keys. They aren't mine. I only hold them.
SER_LZS_01.speech: Ключи я вам не отдам. Не мои они. Я их только держу.

SER_LZS_02.speaker: SER
SER_LZS_02.text: Get up, get up, my dears. Not for them, your knees. Go home. Take the children.
SER_LZS_02.speech: Встаньте, встаньте, родные. Не перед ними на колени. Домой идите. Детей уведите.

SER_LZS_03.speaker: SER
SER_LZS_03.text: Young man. Take the silver. Take the bell. Only don't go down into the crypt.
SER_LZS_03.speech: Молодой человек. Берите серебро. Берите колокол. Только в подклет не ходите.

SER_LZS_04.speaker: SER
SER_LZS_04.text: There is nothing down there that you need. And there is something there that you don't.
SER_LZS_04.speech: Там нет ничего, что вам нужно. А есть то, что вам не нужно.

SER_LZS_05.speaker: SER
SER_LZS_05.text: What was closed on the fourth day, let no one open.
SER_LZS_05.speech: Еже затворися въ четвертый день, никтоже да не отверзетъ.

SER_LZS_06.speaker: SER
SER_LZS_06.text: Arkady. Son. I am asking you. Not for God's sake. For your own.
SER_LZS_06.speech: Аркадий. Сынок. Прошу тебя. Не ради Бога — ради тебя самого.

SER_LZS_08.speaker: SER
SER_LZS_08.text: [sung under the breath] Confirming the general resurrection before Thy Passion, Thou didst raise Lazarus from the dead, O Christ God.
SER_LZS_08.speech: Общее воскресение прежде Твоея страсти уверяя, из мертвых воздвигл еси Лазаря, Христе Боже.

SER_LZS_09.speaker: SER
SER_LZS_09.speech: Вот и всё. Теперь ждите. Четыре дня.

VOL_LZS_01.speaker: VOL
VOL_LZS_01.text: Citizen Lebedev? Volkov, OGPU plenipotentiary. Here is the warrant. The keys.
VOL_LZS_01.speech: Гражданин Лебедев? Уполномоченный ОГПУ Волков. Вот предписание. Ключи.

VOL_LZS_02.speaker: VOL
VOL_LZS_02.text: No roughness. These people aren't enemies, they're ignorance. The bell comes down, the tower comes down, the silver goes on the inventory. That's all.
VOL_LZS_02.speech: Без грубости. Эти люди не враги, они — темнота. Колокол снимаем, колокольню валим, серебро — по акту. Всё.

VOL_LZS_03.speaker: VOL
VOL_LZS_03.text: A crypt? There's no crypt on the inventory. So that's where they keep the silver.
VOL_LZS_03.speech: Подклет? В описи никакого подклета нет. Значит, там и держат серебро.

VOL_LZS_04.speaker: VOL
VOL_LZS_04.text: Church Slavonic. 'What was closed on the fourth day...' Well, well.
VOL_LZS_04.speech: Церковнославянский. „Что затворено в четвёртый день...“ Ну-ну.

VOL_LZS_05.speaker: VOL
VOL_LZS_05.text: Everyone, look. Here is your holy relic. I'll show you now that there is nothing inside it.
VOL_LZS_05.speech: Смотрите все. Вот ваша святыня. Сейчас я покажу вам, что внутри ничего нет.

VOL_LZS_06.speaker: VOL
VOL_LZS_06.text: [breathing heavily] The seal... wax. Old wax. There.

VOL_LZS_08.speaker: VOL
VOL_LZS_08.text: Paint. It's paint! Priests have done worse than this. Inventory it and box it.
VOL_LZS_08.speech: Краска. Это краска! Попы и не на такое способны. Описать и в ящик.

VOL_LZS_09.speaker: VOL
VOL_LZS_09.text: [exhausted] Three. The ones who handled the vessel. Doctor, what is this? Typhus?
VOL_LZS_09.speech: Трое. Те, кто брал сосуд в руки. Доктор, что это? Тиф?

VOL_LZS_10.speaker: VOL
VOL_LZS_10.text: Write: typhus. District quarantine. The village... there is no village. Understood? There is no village.
VOL_LZS_10.speech: Пишите: тиф. Карантин по всему району. Село... села нет. Понятно? Села нет.

VOL_LZS_11.speaker: VOL
VOL_LZS_11.text: [whispers] I wasn't bitten. I wasn't bitten. I wasn't...
VOL_LZS_11.speech: Меня не укусили. Меня не укусили. Меня не...

BRG_LZS_01.speaker: BRG
BRG_LZS_01.text: Citizens! By resolution of the district executive committee, the church of the village of Chetverodnevo is closed.
BRG_LZS_01.speech: Граждане! Постановлением районного исполнительного комитета церковь села Четвероднево закрывается.

BRG_LZS_02.speaker: BRG
BRG_LZS_02.text: The bells are surrendered to the needs of industrialization. Go back to your homes.
BRG_LZS_02.speech: Колокола сдаются на нужды индустриализации. Расходитесь по домам.

BRG_LZS_03.speaker: BRG
BRG_LZS_03.text: The struggle against religion is the struggle for socialism!
BRG_LZS_03.speech: Борьба против религии — борьба за социализм!

BRG_LZS_04.speaker: BRG
BRG_LZS_04.text: Religion is opium for the people.

BRG_LZS_05.speaker: BRG
BRG_LZS_05.text: Church valuables are subject to requisition. Resistance will be treated as a counter-revolutionary act.
BRG_LZS_05.speech: Церковные ценности подлежат изъятию. Сопротивление будет рассматриваться как контрреволюционное выступление.

BRG_LZS_06.speaker: BRG
BRG_LZS_06.text: Comrade peasants! Get up off your knees. Do not obstruct the brigade's work.
BRG_LZS_06.speech: Товарищи крестьяне! Встаньте с колен. Не мешайте работе бригады.

BRG_LZS_07.speaker: BRG
BRG_LZS_07.text: [shouting] Away from the bell tower! Away! There will be a blast!
BRG_LZS_07.speech: Отойти от колокольни! Отойти! Будет взрыв!

BRG_LZS_08.speaker: BRG
BRG_LZS_08.text: Priest Lebedev! Hand over the keys voluntarily.

SVR_FTD_01.speaker: SVR
SVR_FTD_01.text: [radio] 'Birch', this is 'Don'. Has Moscow's instruction been received? Over.

VOL_FTD_01.speaker: VOL
VOL_FTD_01.text: Received. The batteries are loaded with the special rounds. We begin on the signal.
VOL_FTD_01.speech: Получено. Батареи заряжены особыми. Начинаем по сигналу.

SVR_FTD_02.speaker: SVR
SVR_FTD_02.text: [radio] Fire when ready. The specials: three salvoes, no more. Over.
SVR_FTD_02.speech: Огонь по готовности. Особых — три залпа, не больше. Приём.

VOL_FTD_02.speaker: VOL
VOL_FTD_02.text: No. They aren't supposed to burst. They only need to open.
VOL_FTD_02.speech: Нет. Они и не должны рваться. Им нужно только раскрыться.

VOL_FTD_03.speaker: VOL
VOL_FTD_03.text: Blood. Volunteers'. More than that you are not cleared to know, Comrade Colonel.
VOL_FTD_03.speech: Кровь. Добровольцев. Большего вам знать не положено, товарищ полковник.

SVR_FTD_03.speaker: SVR
SVR_FTD_03.text: [radio] 'Don', this is 'Birch'. The enemy is not answering. The line is empty. Over.
SVR_FTD_03.speech: „Дон“, я „Берёза“. Противник не отвечает. Линия пуста. Приём.

SVR_FTD_04.speaker: SVR
SVR_FTD_04.text: [radio] All stations. Our dead... are getting up. This is not panic. I can see them. Over.
SVR_FTD_04.speech: Всем станциям. Наши убитые... встают. Это не паника. Я их вижу. Приём.

SVR_FTD_05.speaker: SVR
SVR_FTD_05.text: [radio] This is 'Don'. Cease transmission. Not one word of this on the air. Write: an epidemic among the enemy. Out.
SVR_FTD_05.speech: Я „Дон“. Прекратить передачу. В эфире об этом — ни слова. Писать: эпидемия у противника. Конец связи.

VOL_FTD_04.speaker: VOL
VOL_FTD_04.text: [exhausted] The fourth day. Always the fourth.

VOL_FTD_05.speaker: VOL
VOL_FTD_05.text: They don't know whose they are. They just walk. West.
VOL_FTD_05.speech: Они не знают, чьи они. Они просто идут. На запад.

REI_STB_01.speaker: REI
REI_STB_01.text: Fineness twelve microns. Through the mill once more. The dust must float, not fall.
REI_STB_01.speech: Feinheit zwölf Mikron. Noch einmal durch die Mühle. Der Staub muss schweben, nicht fallen.

REI_STB_02.speaker: REI
REI_STB_02.text: Near the Heart it no longer waits four days. Minutes. Write it down: minutes.
REI_STB_02.speech: In der Nähe des Herzens wartet es keine vier Tage mehr. Minuten. Schreiben Sie: Minuten.

REI_STB_03.speaker: REI
REI_STB_03.text: The canisters go east. Return to sender. That was the General Staff's phrase, not mine.
REI_STB_03.speech: Die Kanister nach Osten. Zurück zum Absender. So hat es der Generalstab formuliert, nicht ich.

REI_STB_05.speaker: REI
REI_STB_05.text: [whispers] No. No, not today. Not tonight.
REI_STB_05.speech: Nein. Nein, nicht heute. Nicht heute Nacht.

REI_STB_06.speaker: REI
REI_STB_06.text: Liesl. Mama is here. Count to a hundred.
REI_STB_06.speech: Liesl. Mama ist hier. Zähl bis hundert.

PA_STB_01.speaker: PA
PA_STB_01.text: [PA] Attention. Dust mill two, canning begins. Masks on. Masks on.
PA_STB_01.speech: Achtung. Staubmühle zwei, Abfüllung beginnt. Masken auf. Masken auf.

PA_STB_02.speaker: PA
PA_STB_02.text: [radio] Weather station to control. Wind from the west, three metres a second, steady. Clear to proceed.
PA_STB_02.speech: Wetterwarte an Leitstand. Wind aus West, drei Meter pro Sekunde, beständig. Freigabe.

PA_STB_03.speaker: PA
PA_STB_03.text: [PA] Launch in sixty seconds. Clear the north ramp.
PA_STB_03.speech: Abschuss in sechzig Sekunden. Nordrampe räumen.

PA_STB_04.speaker: PA
PA_STB_04.text: [radio] [shouting] Control, weather station. The wind is turning. East. Wind from the east, rising. Control, abort! Abort!
PA_STB_04.speech: Leitstand, hier Wetterwarte. Der Wind dreht. Ost. Wind aus Ost, zunehmend. Leitstand, abbrechen! Abbrechen!

PA_STB_05.speaker: PA
PA_STB_05.text: [PA] Attention. Dust alarm. Close all doors. This is not a drill.
PA_STB_05.speech: Achtung. Staubalarm. Alle Türen schließen. Dies ist keine Übung.

PA_STB_06.speaker: PA
PA_STB_06.text: [radio] ...Control, please answer. Control. The lights in Wilcza Góra are... Control?
PA_STB_06.speech: ...Leitstand, bitte antworten. Leitstand. Die Lichter in Wilcza Góra sind... Leitstand?

RTN_CLOSE_05.speaker: RTN
RTN_CLOSE_05.speech: Семёнов. Семёнов Иван. Тысяча девятьсот двадцать...

RTN_CLOSE_07.speaker: RTN
RTN_CLOSE_07.text: Where are my boots? Where are the boots...

RTN_CLOSE_11.speaker: RTN
RTN_CLOSE_11.text: Lord, have mercy. Lord... have mercy.

RTN_CLOSE_12.speaker: RTN
RTN_CLOSE_12.text: The letter. The letter's in my pocket... send it...

RTN_CLOSE_13.speaker: RTN
RTN_CLOSE_13.text: Dark. Why is it so dark?

RTN_CLOSE_14.speaker: RTN
RTN_CLOSE_14.text: But we won. We... won, didn't we?
RTN_CLOSE_14.speech: Мы же победили. Мы же... победили?

RTN_CLOSE_16.speaker: RTN
RTN_CLOSE_16.text: Don't shoot. It's me. It's me...
RTN_CLOSE_16.speech: Не стреляй. Это я. Это же я...

SVR_M0_01.speaker: SVR
SVR_M0_01.text: [radio] 'Birch-three'. The tanks have stopped at the woods. What's ahead of us isn't Germans. Over.
SVR_M0_01.speech: Я „Берёза-три“. Коробочки встали у леса. Впереди — не немцы. Приём.

SVR_M0_02.speaker: SVR
SVR_M0_02.text: [radio] All stations: the Returned are not to come within fifty metres. Hit the wound. The wound, not the head. Over.
SVR_M0_02.speech: Всем станциям: вернувшихся ближе пятидесяти не подпускать. Бить в рану. В рану, не в голову. Приём.

SVR_M0_03.speaker: SVR
SVR_M0_03.text: [radio] How do you read? I repeat: our dead from Second Battalion are walking through our positions. West. Don't fire on our own... cancel that. Fire.
SVR_M0_03.speech: Как слышно? Повторяю: наши убитые из второго батальона идут через наши позиции. На запад. По своим не стрелять... отставить. Стрелять.

SVR_M0_04.speaker: SVR
SVR_M0_04.text: [radio] Commissar, no speeches. They don't listen any more.
SVR_M0_04.speech: Политрук, не надо речей. Они уже не слушают.

SVR_M0_05.speaker: SVR
SVR_M0_05.text: [radio] Flares every five minutes. While we can see, they can't come up on us unseen. Over.
SVR_M0_05.speech: Осветительные — каждые пять минут. Пока видно, они не подойдут незаметно. Приём.

SVR_M0_06.speaker: SVR
SVR_M0_06.text: [radio] 'Don', 'Birch'. The village ahead is burning. We lit it. Our own... we were burning our own. Over.
SVR_M0_06.speech: „Дон“, я „Берёза“. Деревня впереди горит. Сами подожгли. Своих... жгли своих. Приём.

SVR_M0_07.speaker: SVR
SVR_M0_07.text: [radio] No burials. Do you hear? Bury no one. Stack them and burn them.
SVR_M0_07.speech: Хоронить запрещаю. Слышите? Никого не хоронить. Складывать и жечь.

SVR_M0_08.speaker: SVR
SVR_M0_08.text: [radio] Semyonov, is that you? Semyonov, answer... [static]

SVR_M0_09.speaker: SVR
SVR_M0_09.text: [radio] They told us: an epidemic among the enemy. The enemy! So who is that walking across the field, Comrade Major?
SVR_M0_09.speech: Нам сказали — эпидемия у противника. У противника! А кто идёт по полю, товарищ майор?

SVR_M0_10.speaker: SVR
SVR_M0_10.text: [radio] [whispers] Quiet. Quiet on the net. They come to a voice.
SVR_M0_10.speech: Тише. Тише в эфире. Они идут на голос.

SVR_M0_11.speaker: SVR
SVR_M0_11.text: [radio] Four days. Remember it: four days. Whoever was killed yesterday gets up the day after tomorrow.
SVR_M0_11.speech: Четыре дня. Запомните: четыре дня. Кого вчера убило — послезавтра встанет.

SVR_M1_01.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_01.text: [radio] 'Pine'. The Germans are trucking away bodies. Ours. By the lorry-load, west. What do they want with our dead? Over.
SVR_M1_01.speech: Я „Сосна“. Немцы вывозят трупы. Наших. Грузовиками, на запад. Зачем им наши трупы? Приём.

SVR_M1_02.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_02.text: [radio] Repeat for HQ: the Germans are collecting the Returned. Not destroying them. Collecting them. Over.
SVR_M1_02.speech: Повторяю для штаба: немцы собирают вернувшихся. Не уничтожают — собирают. Приём.

SVR_M1_03.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_03.text: [radio] Violet light in the west. Third night running. What is it, 'Don'? Over.
SVR_M1_03.speech: Фиолетовый свет на западе. Третью ночь. Что это, „Дон“? Приём.

SVR_M1_04.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_04.text: [radio] Laboratory Four is never to be mentioned on the air. Never. That is an order.
SVR_M1_04.speech: Четвёртую лабораторию в эфире не упоминать. Никогда. Это приказ.

SVR_M1_05.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_05.text: [radio] They've stopped walking west. They're standing. All of them turned... toward the mountains.
SVR_M1_05.speech: Они уже не идут на запад. Они стоят. Все повернулись... к горам.

SVR_M1_06.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_06.text: [radio] The prisoner says: 'Staub'. Dust. He says they will make dust. I don't understand. Over.
SVR_M1_06.speech: Пленный говорит: „Штауб“. Пыль. Говорит, они сделают пыль. Не понимаю. Приём.

SVR_M1_07.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_07.text: [radio] Operator, keep tuning. Up at twelve hundred someone's talking German and laughing. I don't like that laugh.
SVR_M1_07.speech: Радист, крути дальше. Там, на тысяча двести, кто-то говорит по-немецки и смеётся. Не нравится мне этот смех.

SVR_M1_08.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_08.text: [radio] It's snowing. Violet. Report it? ...How do I report that?
SVR_M1_08.speech: Снег идёт. Фиолетовый. Доложить? ...Как я это доложу?

SVR_M1_09.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_09.text: [radio] Volkov is here. Volkov himself, from Moscow. They say he's known about this since 'thirty. Since 'thirty!
SVR_M1_09.speech: Волков здесь. Сам Волков, из Москвы. Говорят, он с тридцатого года про это знает. С тридцатого!

SVR_M1_10.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_10.text: [radio] Retreat? Retreat where, when our dead outnumber our living?
SVR_M1_10.speech: Отступать? Куда отступать, если своих мёртвых больше, чем живых?

SVR_M1_11.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_11.text: [radio] Order: in the report, 'an epidemic among the enemy'. Carry it out. Carry it out!
SVR_M1_11.speech: Приказ: в сводке — „эпидемия у противника“. Выполняйте. Выполняйте!

SVR_M1_12.speaker: SVR
SVR_M1_12.text: [radio] Do you believe in God, Misha? ...I didn't either, before.
SVR_M1_12.speech: Ты в Бога веришь, Миша? ...Я тоже раньше не верил.

SEL_GL1_01.speaker: SEL
SEL_GL1_01.text: [intercom] Pilot to passengers. We've crossed the Silesian border, twenty-three ten. Forty minutes to the drop. Stay strapped in, there's weather.

SEL_GL1_02.speaker: SEL
SEL_GL1_02.text: [intercom] Navigator says that's the front below us. Those are their flares, not ours. Have a look if you like. Then don't.

SEL_GL1_03.speaker: SEL
SEL_GL1_03.text: [intercom] Someone with glasses tell me what those columns are. On the snow. Walking west. Nobody down there is shooting at them.

SEL_GL1_04.speaker: SEL
SEL_GL1_04.text: [intercom] Light ahead, bearing oh-four-oh. Violet. That's no flare.

SEL_GL1_05.speaker: SEL
SEL_GL1_05.text: [intercom] Both engines— ...Both engines gone. Instruments dead. Hold on to something, chaps. I'm going to put her down.

SEL_GL1_06.speaker: SEL
SEL_GL1_06.text: [intercom] [shouting] There's a building. Lit windows. I'll take the field beside it. Brace. Brace. Brace!

SEL_GL1_07.speaker: SEL
SEL_GL1_07.text: [faint] [exhausted] ...Is anyone... I can't move my legs. Get out. Get out before she burns.

SEL_GL1_08.speaker: SEL
SEL_GL1_08.text: [faint] Co-pilot's gone. Leave me. Go on. ...God bless.

DUT_GL1_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_GL1_01.text: [shouting over engines] That ain't a parade down there. Those are people. Hundreds of them. Where the hell are they going?

DUT_GL1_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_GL1_02.text: Hang on. Hang on, hang on—

PEG_GL1_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_GL1_01.text: [shouting over engines] Soviet greatcoats. Walking west, no formation, no weapons. Pilot, those men are walking through their own artillery.

PEG_GL1_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_GL1_02.text: Nobody breathe. Heads down, hands on the frame.

DEA_GL1_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_GL1_01.text: [whispers] Yea, though I walk through the valley... Lord, they are walking. Look at them walk.

DEA_GL1_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_GL1_02.text: Hold my hand, if you want to. I don't mind.

WRN_GL1_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_GL1_01.text: [shouting over engines] Russians. Hundreds. Walking into German guns and the guns are not firing. ...Nothing about this is right.

WRN_GL1_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_GL1_02.text: Count with me. Jeden, dwa, trzy... it helps. Cztery...

SER_DIARY_MAP00_01.speaker: SER
SER_DIARY_MAP00_01.text: Lazarus Saturday, the thirtieth of March. They came at nine, in a truck, with a paper. They took the bell down at noon. She came down the last of the way on her own and cracked on the frozen ground; I will hear that note until I die. At three they blew the tower. Then they wanted silver, and there is no silver, and they went down into the crypt. The lamp was lit. The young one in the good coat, Volkov, broke the wax on the altar step to show them there was nothing in it. There was. It was wet. Red, not black. A thousand years, and red. I kept the lamp forty years, not to know, but to keep. Now I will keep this book instead.
SER_DIARY_MAP00_01.speech: [quietly] Лазарева суббота, тридцатое марта. Приехали в девять, на грузовике, с бумагой. Колокол сняли в полдень. Последние сажени он прошёл сам и треснул о мёрзлую землю; этот звук я буду слышать до смерти. В три взорвали колокольню. Потом искали серебро, а серебра нет, и они сошли в склеп. Лампада горела. Молодой, в хорошем пальто, Волков, сломал воск на ступени алтаря, чтобы показать: там ничего нет. Там было. Оно было мокрое. Красное, не чёрное. Тысяча лет, и красное. Я сорок лет хранил лампаду, не чтобы знать, а чтобы хранить. Теперь буду хранить эту тетрадь.

SER_DIARY_MAP01_01.speaker: SER
SER_DIARY_MAP01_01.text: Palm Sunday. No willows this year; nobody went for them. Three of them are sick: the two who carried it up the stairs, and the one who caught Volkov's glove. The fever came in the night. They shake, and they are thirsty past any thirst I have seen in a man. At first light the brigade left for Staryi Brod, the sick under a tarpaulin in the truck bed, Volkov in the cab with his satchel on his knees. He did not look at me. I think he wanted to. Grach and Avdotya Pakhomova sat with the sick all night in my kitchen, because somebody had to, and they were the two who said so. The bell lies in the yard with her mouth in the mud. The children will not go near her.
SER_DIARY_MAP01_01.speech: Вербное воскресенье. Вербы в этом году нет; никто за ней не пошёл. Трое из них больны: двое, что несли это по лестнице, и тот, что поймал перчатку Волкова. Жар пришёл ночью. Их трясёт, и они хотят пить так, как я не видел, чтобы люди хотели пить. На рассвете бригада ушла в Старый Брод, больные под брезентом в кузове, Волков в кабине, с портфелем на коленях. На меня он не смотрел. Думаю, хотел. Грач и Авдотья Пахомова просидели с больными всю ночь у меня на кухне, потому что кто-то должен был, и они двое так и сказали. Колокол лежит во дворе, устами в грязь. Дети к нему не подходят.

SER_DIARY_MAP02_01.speaker: SER
SER_DIARY_MAP02_01.text: Great Wednesday. Grach has the fever. Avdotya has it. The same thirst. I have put them in the house where the others lay, and I sit with them, because now it is my turn to be the one who says so. A carter from Staryi Brod says the three men died on Tuesday in the fever ward, and there is a soldier on the hospital gate. He says typhus. When I told Grach, he said: typhus does not make you thirsty like this. Then he asked what was in the vessel. I said I did not know. He said: you kept it forty years and did not know? I said that was the whole of the keeping. He laughed, and it hurt him.
SER_DIARY_MAP02_01.speech: Великая среда. У Грача жар. У Авдотьи жар. Та же жажда. Я положил их в доме, где лежали те, и сижу с ними, потому что теперь моя очередь быть тем, кто так сказал. Возчик из Старого Брода говорит: трое умерли во вторник в тифозном бараке, и у ворот больницы солдат. Говорит: тиф. Грач, когда я ему сказал, ответил: от тифа так не пьют. Потом спросил, что было в сосуде. Я сказал: не знаю. Он сказал: сорок лет хранил и не знал? Я сказал: в этом и было всё хранение. Он засмеялся, и ему стало больно.

SER_DIARY_MAP04A_01.speaker: SER
SER_DIARY_MAP04A_01.text: Great Friday. Grach died at four in the morning, Avdotya an hour after, holding my hand so hard I have the marks. At noon a boy came over the fields from Staryi Brod, not by the road, because the road has soldiers now. He said that in the night the three dead men in the hospital got up. He said it the way a child says a thing he has seen. He said they bit the orderly. He said the soldiers shot at them and they did not mind. I have not told the village. Nobody will touch Grach and Avdotya. So I will. Tomorrow. Under the tower, where the ground is already broken. The fourth day. I have read that chapter two hundred times, and never once from this side of it.
SER_DIARY_MAP04A_01.speech: [exhausted] Великая пятница. Грач умер в четыре утра, Авдотья через час, держа мою руку так, что остались следы. В полдень через поля, не дорогой, потому что на дороге теперь солдаты, пришёл мальчик из Старого Брода. Он сказал, что ночью те трое в больнице встали. Он сказал это так, как ребёнок говорит о том, что видел. Сказал: они укусили санитара. Сказал: солдаты стреляли, а им было всё равно. Деревне я не сказал. Никто не прикоснётся к Грачу и Авдотье. Значит, я. Завтра. Под колокольней, где земля уже разбита. Четвёртый день. Я читал эту главу двести раз и ни разу с этой стороны.

SER_DIARY_MAP04B_01.speaker: SER
SER_DIARY_MAP04B_01.text: Holy Saturday. I buried them myself under the fallen tower, as deep as one old man can dig in a day, and read over them. At the ford there is a cordon, a machine gun and a board: TYPHUS. The soldiers are boys. One called across the water to ask if we had bread. We have. Pascha. I served it at midnight in the roofless church, and the whole village came, with candles. Christ is risen. I said it and they answered it, and I meant it, and I mean it now, in the morning, with the candles out. Whatever is in the vessel, and whatever lies under the tower, this is still true. I write it down so that I do not lose it. The ground under the tower has not moved. It is the second day.
SER_DIARY_MAP04B_01.speech: Великая суббота. Я похоронил их сам, под упавшей колокольней, так глубоко, как может выкопать за день один старик, и прочитал над ними. У брода кордон, пулемёт и доска: ТИФ. Солдаты — мальчики. Один крикнул через воду: есть ли у нас хлеб. Есть. Пасха. Я служил в полночь в церкви без крыши, и пришла вся деревня, со свечами. Христос воскресе. Я сказал, и они ответили, и я верил, и верю сейчас, утром, когда свечи погасли. Что бы ни было в сосуде и что бы ни лежало под колокольней, это всё равно правда. Записываю, чтобы не потерять. Земля под колокольней не шевелилась. Это второй день.

SER_DIARY_MAP04C_01.speaker: SER
SER_DIARY_MAP04C_01.text: Bright Monday. The fourth day. They came up a little after dark. I was in the church and heard the rope posts fall. I will not write what they look like; whoever reads this will know, or will not need to. I struck the bell where she lies, with the smithy hammer, because a bell is what the village knows to come to, and they came, running, and I barred the doors from inside. Forty-one of us. The children are asleep on the vestment chests. Grach and Avdotya walked round the church all night, slowly, the way the sick walk, and in the morning they stood at the door and did not try it. They do not try doors. They wait. Lord, I buried them with my own hands and I said the words. The words were right. It is not the words that were wrong.
SER_DIARY_MAP04C_01.speech: [quietly] Светлый понедельник. Четвёртый день. Они вышли вскоре после темноты. Я был в церкви и услышал, как упали колышки с верёвкой. Я не стану писать, какие они. Кто прочтёт, тот знает, или ему не нужно. Я ударил молотом по колоколу, где он лежит, потому что на колокол деревня знает, что идти, и они пришли, бегом, и я закрыл двери брусом изнутри. Сорок один человек. Дети спят на сундуках с ризами. Грач и Авдотья всю ночь ходили вокруг церкви, медленно, как ходят больные, а утром стояли у двери и не трогали её. Они не трогают дверей. Они ждут. Господи, я похоронил их своими руками и сказал слова. Слова были верные. Не слова были неверны.

SER_DIARY_MAP04D_01.speaker: SER
SER_DIARY_MAP04D_01.text: The eleventh. Three days in the church. They will not come in: a man with a megaphone said twice that the district is closed for typhus and help is coming, and then the megaphone said nothing more. Pyotr Ilyich keeps the count of the days in chalk on the wall, because the fourth day is the only thing now. Oil in the lamp for one more night. We kept it five hundred years and none of us knew what for, and the ones who opened it were not wicked men. Men with a paper and a truck. It only ever needed that. Whoever finds this: it was not the Lord who did this, and not that poor boy in the good coat either, not all of it. It was that nobody was left to keep watch. Keep watch. I am going down to the crypt to fill the lamp, and then I will open the church door myself, so that none of them has to be the one. Remember, O Lord, Thy servant Serafim, and Matvei, and Avdotya, and all of them, by name.
SER_DIARY_MAP04D_01.speech: [quietly] Одиннадцатое. Три дня в церкви. Они не войдут: человек с рупором сказал дважды, что уезд закрыт по тифу и помощь идёт, а потом рупор замолчал. Пётр Ильич ведёт счёт дням мелом на стене, потому что четвёртый день — это теперь единственное. Масла в лампаде на одну ночь. Мы хранили её пятьсот лет, и никто из нас не знал зачем, а те, кто открыл, были не злые люди. Люди с бумагой и грузовиком. Только этого и было нужно. Кто найдёт это: виноват не Господь, и не тот бедный мальчик в хорошем пальто, не во всём. Виновато то, что некому стало сторожить. Сторожите. Я иду в склеп заправить лампаду, а потом сам открою дверь церкви, чтобы никому из них не пришлось. Помяни, Господи, раба Твоего Серафима, и Матвея, и Авдотью, и всех их, по именам.

OPR_ROUND_START_14.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_14.text: [warmly] Some of tonight's guests have walked here all the way from the {east}. Greatcoats, no boots, through the snow. Do give them a warm welcome. They can't feel it, but {I} can.

OPR_ROUND_START_15.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_15.text: [cheerful] It's the fourth day somewhere, friends! It is {always} the fourth day somewhere.

OPR_ROUND_START_16.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_16.text: A word from the Ledger: we didn't make tonight's guests, friends. We only {found} them. And aren't we glad we did!

OPR_ROUND_END_08.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_END_08.text: And down they go again, bless them. Don't fret over the ones you didn't finish. They'll be {back}. Everyone comes back. That's the whole {programme}.
